jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, Spain)
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €96,846 - €116,215. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Product Designer (AI Products & Platforms)
jobs.excerpt: Kyivstar. Tech is looking for a Product Designer to help shape and develop innovative AI-powered products and experiences.
jobs.description:
Kyivstar.Tech is looking for a Product Designer to help shape and develop innovative AI-powered products and experiences.

We are looking for a designer who goes beyond traditional interface design and takes a proactive, entrepreneurial approach to product development. Someone who deeply understands AI technologies, recognizes opportunities emerging from their capabilities, and can independently turn those opportunities into meaningful product concepts and user experiences.

This is not a role focused on simply translating predefined requirements into interfaces. We expect a designer who actively contributes to product discovery, challenges assumptions, explores emerging technologies, and proposes new ways AI can create value for users and businesses.

A strong understanding of how modern AI systems work is essential. You should be comfortable discussing LLMs, AI agents, orchestration, integrations, and technical constraints with engineers, while keeping your primary focus on product thinking and user experience.

You’ll work closely with Product Owners, engineers, Business Analysts, and other team members, contributing to product direction, exploring new opportunities, and delivering innovative AI-powered experiences.

About us

Kyivstar.Tech is a Ukrainian hybrid IT company and a resident of Diia.City. We are a subsidiary of Kyivstar, one of Ukraine’s largest telecom operators.

Our mission is to transform lives in Ukraine and beyond by creating innovative technological solutions that unleash the potential of businesses while meeting the evolving needs of users.

With over 700 specialists working across diverse domains—from mobile and web solutions to the design, development, support, and maintenance of high-performance systems—we are committed to driving meaningful change.

We embrace an entrepreneurial culture that fosters continuous growth, challenges conventional thinking, and inspires the creation of transformative products.

What you will do

  • Drive AI-powered product innovation: Proactively identify new product opportunities, explore emerging AI capabilities, and propose innovative use cases and experiences that create value for users and businesses.
  • Contribute to product direction: Collaborate with Product Owners, engineers, and stakeholders to shape product concepts, challenge assumptions, and influence product decisions rather than simply executing predefined requirements.
  • Apply technology-driven product thinking: Explore what becomes possible through AI technologies, translating their capabilities and limitations into meaningful product solutions without relying exclusively on established user problems or conventional UX patterns.
  • Understand the technology behind the product: Work closely with engineers to understand LLM capabilities, AI orchestration, agent workflows, APIs, system integrations, and architectural constraints, using this knowledge to inform product and design decisions.
  • Design AI platform experiences: Create intuitive interfaces for configuring, managing, monitoring, and interacting with AI-powered systems, agents, and workflows.
  • Explore new human-AI interaction models: Design conversational experiences, intelligent assistants, embedded AI functionality, and innovative interaction patterns that go beyond traditional graphical interfaces.
  • Develop functional AI prototypes: Independently create working prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions, integrating AI models and APIs when necessary to demonstrate and validate product concepts.
  • Lead proactive product discovery: Independently formulate hypotheses, investigate potential use cases, explore alternative solutions, and identify opportunities even when established user workflows, detailed requirements, or historical analytics are unavailable.
  • Validate ideas through experimentation: Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on product concepts using user research, usability testing, technical experimentation, and qualitative or quantitative feedback.
  • Apply systems thinking: Design coherent, scalable experiences across interconnected products, services, and AI components, considering system behavior, user roles, integrations, and evolving requirements.
  • Integrate AI into everyday design work: Actively use AI-powered tools for research, ideation, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and design-to-development workflows, continuously exploring more effective approaches.
  • Deliver high-quality product experiences: Produce thoughtful UX solutions, polished interfaces, interactive prototypes, and clear design specifications, applying and extending the corporate design system where appropriate.
  • Collaborate throughout implementation: Work closely with developers to ensure product concepts are technically feasible, appropriately implemented, and consistent with the intended user experience.
  • Evaluate and improve product effectiveness: Define meaningful success criteria, analyze user feedback and product performance, and continuously refine solutions based on evidence and emerging opportunities

Qualifications and experience needed

  • Product Design Experience: Proven Product Designer with a strong track record of independently designing and delivering complex digital products and contributing to product-level decisions.
  • Personal AI Projects: Demonstrable experience independently creating AI-powered prototypes, experimental applications, micro-products, or functional product concepts. Candidates must be able to present concrete examples of their own work, demonstrate how AI is used within these solutions, and explain their personal contribution to their design and implementation.
  • Entrepreneurial Product Mindset: Demonstrated ability to proactively identify opportunities, generate product ideas, challenge established approaches, and take initiative without waiting for predefined requirements or detailed instructions.
  • Deep AI Understanding: Strong practical understanding of LLMs, AI agents, AI-powered tools, and the principles behind modern AI applications, including their capabilities, limitations, and potential product applications.
  • Technical Literacy: Ability to understand and discuss AI system architecture, orchestration, APIs, integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies with engineering teams. Software engineering experience is not required.
  • Technology-Driven Innovation: Ability to translate emerging technological capabilities into valuable product concepts, use cases, and user experiences, supported by practical experimentation rather than theoretical knowledge alone.
  • Functional AI Prototyping — Required: Practical ability to build working interactive prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions. Experience connecting prototypes to AI models or APIs and experimenting with actual AI behavior is expected. Professional programming skills are not required.
  • AI-Integrated Design Workflow: Confident, everyday use of AI-powered tools across research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and design production—ability to structure effective AI-assisted workflows and critically evaluate generated outputs.
  • AI Experience Design: Understanding of the distinctive challenges of AI-powered interfaces, including non-deterministic behavior, user control, transparency, error handling, and building trust in AI-assisted interactions.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to understand complex products holistically, identify relationships between components and processes, and design scalable experiences across interconnected systems.
  • Product Discovery & Validation: Experience independently identifying opportunities, framing hypotheses, conducting research, validating concepts, and iterating based on user feedback and experimental results.
  • UX/UI Design Expertise: Strong skills in information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping, with the ability to deliver polished, intuitive experiences for complex digital products.
  • Design Systems & Tools: Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, variables, and interactive prototyping, alongside experience working with and extending established design systems.
  • Mindset: Curious, analytical, experimental, and comfortable with ambiguity. Motivated to explore unfamiliar technologies, challenge assumptions, continuously learn, and independently turn ideas into tangible results.
  • Team Fit: Strong communication and collaboration skills, experience working in cross-functional Agile/Scrum teams, and Intermediate+ proficiency in English and Ukrainian.

A plus would be

  • Commercial AI Product Experience: Previous experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, intelligent assistants, AI agents, conversational interfaces, or enterprise AI platforms.
  • Advanced AI Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with agent orchestration, tool calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, and other architectural approaches used in modern AI applications.
  • Enterprise Integration Experience: Experience working with enterprise platforms, customer support systems, CRM solutions, or products that integrate with multiple internal and external services.
  • Advanced AI Development Workflows: Experience building more sophisticated AI applications, implementing multi-step agentic workflows, integrating multiple AI services, or using AI-assisted development tools to automate complex tasks.
  • B2B SaaS & Platform Design: Experience designing configurable, modular, or API-driven platforms intended for integration into third-party products and services.
  • AI Evaluation & Observability: Familiarity with approaches to evaluating AI behavior, monitoring system performance, and designing interfaces that help users understand and control AI-powered processes.
  • Accessibility & Inclusive Design: Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards and experience applying inclusive design principles to complex digital experiences.

What we offer

  • Office or remote — it’s up to you
  • Remote onboarding
  • Performance bonuses for everyone (annual or quarterly — depends on the role)
  • We train employees, with the opportunity to learn through the company’s library, internal resources, and programs from partners
  • Health and life insurance
  • Wellbeing program and corporate psychologist
  • Reimbursement of expenses for Kyivstar mobile communication

Overview

Ferrellgas was recently recognized by Newsweek as one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for 2025 — and that trust starts with our people.

Ferrellgas is seeking an experienced ERP Systems Analyst to join our dynamic team in a remote capacity. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical resource for Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) 2009 R2, supporting financial operations and business systems primarily utilized by our Blue Rhino business. You will play a critical role in maintaining system accuracy, troubleshooting complex transactions, supporting integrations, and improving business processes. Working closely with Finance, Accounts Receivable, IT, and external technology partners, you'll help ensure reliable system performance and efficient financial operations.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we're committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance

  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D

  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)

  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement

  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support

  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • ERP System Management: Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2009 R2, supporting system functionality, troubleshooting, and ongoing operations.
  • Financial Transaction Support: Investigate and resolve invoicing errors, credit memos, missing orders, and discrepancies between accounts receivable and the general ledger.
  • Financial Reporting & Reconciliation: Partner with Finance and Accounts Receivable teams to support month-end close, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes.
  • SQL Server Development & Maintenance: Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and scheduled jobs supporting reporting, reconciliation, and system integrations.
  • System Integrations: Monitor and troubleshoot data exchanges between NAV and connected applications, including Rhino Net, AtWork handheld systems, and EDI trading partners.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Analyze NAV objects and C/AL code to understand existing business logic, identify root causes, and resolve system issues.
  • Data Management & Configuration: Maintain customer account structures, business codes, tax configurations, and other critical system data.
  • Inventory & Transaction Processing: Support scan-based trading (SBT), inventory reporting, and electronic transaction processing.
  • Process Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, automate manual processes, and improve system efficiency.
  • Reporting & Issue Prevention: Develop exception reports and automated alerts to proactively identify transaction errors and reconciliation discrepancies.
  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams and third-party technology partners to troubleshoot issues and support system enhancements.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and system records while following SOX IT controls and established change management processes.
  • User Support & Project Participation: Provide technical guidance and training to business users and support projects through requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and documentation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Three to five years of experience supporting enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
  • Strong SQL Server skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, SQL Server Agent jobs, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of financial and accounting processes, including accounts receivable, general ledger, invoicing, credit memos, and month-end close.
  • Experience troubleshooting data integrations, reconciling information across systems, and resolving transaction discrepancies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with NAV 2009 R2, including the ability to read and interpret C/AL code and NAV objects, preferred.
  • Experience with electronic data interchange (EDI), including X12 standards, preferred.
  • Familiarity with SOX IT general controls, change management, and user access procedures preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, document technical processes, and communicate solutions effectively.
  • Must be a Citizen or National of the United States, a lawful permanent resident, or have authorization to work in the United States.
  • Applicants must not now, or at any time in the future, require sponsorship for an employment visa.

Work Environment

  • This is a remote position.

  • Occasional travel may be required, less than 10%.

  • The role may require occasional after-hours or on-call support to address business-critical system needs.

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

jobs.description:
The Solution Sales Executive will drive market success for ServiceNow’s Moveworks products. Moveworks is the conversational AI and enterprise search engine behind ServiceNow EmployeeWorks, the AI front door for the enterprise. Employees ask for what they need in Teams, Slack, or a browser, and the work gets done through governed ServiceNow workflows. No portal hunting. No ticket maze. Just answers and action.

Moveworks is now part of ServiceNow Otto, our unified AI experience, and it pairs consumer-grade simplicity with the workflows, data, and governance of the ServiceNow AI Platform. Built in, not bolted on.

This role is for sellers who have lived in both worlds—the scale and structure of enterprise software and the speed and grit of a startup—or who bring transferable muscle from one to the other. You’ll bring deep Moveworks expertise to large enterprise accounts and work shoulder to shoulder with Account Executives, Solution Consultants, partners, and customer success teams to win as one team.

jobs.excerpt: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Technical Success Manager, Threat Services, you will be tasked with being the named SentinelOne owner for customers receiving Threat Services delivered through our expanded global relationship with strategic partners, which brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response. You will turn security-service activity into customer confidence, actionable improvements, and renewal health, helping make this partnership successful for customers as SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results. Your focus is the customer relationship, detection posture, tuning outcomes, and escalation quality; the partner remains responsible for day-to-day MDR operations.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own recurring service reviews, action plans, and customer communications for an assigned Threat Services portfolio.
  • Collaborate with partner MDR analysts and delivery managers to review detection posture, escalation quality, response workflows, and tuning requests.
  • Translate service trends and investigation outcomes into specific technical and operational improvements for each customer.
  • Maintain customer health assessments, documented risks, priorities, stakeholder maps, and renewal-readiness indicators.
  • Coordinate SentinelOne detection engineering, Support, Product, and crisis response when partner issues require platform intervention.
  • Validate that critical customer runbooks, escalation contacts, expectations, and service commitments are reflected in delivery.
  • Proactively identify false-positive fatigue, repeated service defects, or adoption gaps and drive corrective actions to closure.
  • Lead customer-facing explanations during service-quality issues and ensure credible ownership and follow-through.
  • Collaborate with account management and Renewals to protect retention and identify appropriate service expansion opportunities.
  • Deliver the outcomes this role is measured on: stronger MDR customer satisfaction and net promoter feedback; fewer unnecessary escalations and faster completion of tuning actions; clear, current health scores and timely renewal risk identification; improved gross retention and customer trust in Threat Services; and consistent service reviews and closed-loop customer action plans.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5 or more years of experience in technical customer success, technical account management, MDR customer management, SOC services, or a comparable role.
  • Practical knowledge of endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, MDR, SIEM, incident investigation, and security operations, with enough technical fluency to challenge a service review.
  • Experience leading service reviews and converting technical outcomes into executive-ready customer narratives.
  • Strong relationship management with security managers, SOC leaders, and CISOs.
  • Ability to assess service health using escalation, tuning, customer-satisfaction, and retention signals, and the commercial judgment to spot risks before renewal.
  • Strong coordination skills across outsourced operations, engineering, support, and sales teams.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, disciplined follow-through, and resilience under pressure.
  • Experience with SentinelOne Singularity, Purple AI, or managed SIEM is highly desirable.
  • Security credentials such as Security+ or CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise, are highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise security operations or high-priority escalations is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Work Perks & Flexibility

Wellness & Lifestyle

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.excerpt: About QC Servion QC Servion is the strategic operational hub of the QC Ecosystem, an integrated network of six specialized companies spanning the full data center lifecycle, from concept and engineering through infrastructure development, construction, commissioning, and delivery.
jobs.description:
About QC Servion

QC Servion is the strategic operational hub of the QC Ecosystem, an integrated network of six specialized companies spanning the full data center lifecycle, from concept and engineering through infrastructure development, construction, commissioning, and delivery.

Together, DLB Associates, Galtra Solutions, AI2IO, Fluid2Chip, CEQEL Critical Commissioning, and 2AI-DC Integrators deliver comprehensive solutions for hyperscale, AI, and mission-critical data center infrastructure.

QC Servion connects and enables these businesses through centralized people, operational, and business strategies that support growth and execution across the ecosystem.

Position: Talent Acquisition Partner

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Talent Acquisition Partner helps build the teams behind some of the fastest-growing businesses across the QC Ecosystem.

You may be recruiting an engineer, commissioning professional, or technical field hire one week and supporting a project management, accounting, marketing, operations, or completely new position the next. While this role will sit within our overhead/shared-services organization, your recruiting portfolio will evolve based on where the business needs support most.

You don't need to come in having recruited every role we hire for. We're looking for someone who is curious, scrappy, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out. When you're handed an unfamiliar position, we want your instinct to be to ask questions, learn the business, understand what good looks like, dig into the talent market, and build a search strategy.

You'll own the recruiting lifecycle for the teams you support, partnering directly with hiring managers to define what they need, find and assess talent, manage interviews, navigate offers, and keep searches moving. As you build relationships and learn your teams, you'll have the opportunity to become their go-to Talent Acquisition partner and take real ownership of how you support their growth.

This is a great opportunity for someone who likes variety, moves quickly, doesn't need every step mapped out, and wants room to grow alongside an organization that is continuing to evolve.

Essential Functions

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across technical, field-based, project, operational, and corporate/shared-services positions based on evolving business needs.
  • Manage multiple active requisitions simultaneously while understanding which searches and business needs require the most attention.
  • Lead intake and calibration conversations with hiring managers to understand the role, team, business need, candidate profile, level, and interview expectations.
  • Learn unfamiliar roles and functions quickly enough to confidently source, screen, and speak with candidates about the opportunity.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, internal databases, direct outreach, specialized communities, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build pipelines of active and passive candidates rather than relying solely on inbound applicants.
  • Conduct recruiter screens focused on experience, capabilities, communication, career motivations, compensation expectations, and overall alignment with the opportunity.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers throughout the search, providing visibility into pipeline health, candidate feedback, market conditions, compensation expectations, and potential challenges.
  • Recognize when a search isn't producing the right results and use market feedback to recommend changes to the candidate profile, sourcing strategy, level, compensation, or other search parameters.
  • Coordinate interviews and proactively manage scheduling, feedback, and next steps so searches continue moving forward.
  • Maintain thoughtful and consistent communication with candidates throughout the process, including searches with longer or evolving timelines.
  • Gather and synthesize interviewer feedback and help hiring teams reach timely, informed decisions.
  • Manage the offer process from compensation alignment and verbal offer through formal documentation, negotiation, acceptance, and pre-employment handoff.
  • Maintain accurate and current information within the ATS so hiring teams and leadership have clear visibility into recruiting activity and pipeline status.
  • Use recruiting data and market insight to identify bottlenecks, adjust strategies, and improve hiring outcomes.
  • Leverage AI, automation, sourcing technology, and emerging tools to improve research, sourcing, communication, and day-to-day recruiting efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

  • The hiring managers you support view you as their Talent Acquisition partner, not simply someone managing requisitions.
  • You understand your teams well enough to represent their opportunities confidently and provide informed guidance throughout a search.
  • You're comfortable picking up a role you've never recruited before, asking the right questions, and figuring out how to find the talent.
  • You proactively build pipelines rather than waiting for applicants to come to you.
  • Hiring managers have clear visibility into their searches and know what is working, what isn't, and what you recommend doing next.
  • You keep interviews, feedback, decisions, and offers moving without needing someone else to continuously push the process forward.
  • Candidates receive timely, honest, and thoughtful communication throughout their experience.
  • You can move between very different roles, functions, and talent markets based on where the organization needs you.
  • You develop trusted relationships with the leaders and teams you support.
  • As your knowledge and credibility grow, you take greater ownership of your recruiting relationships and increasingly complex hiring needs.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field or equivalent professional experience in recruiting, sourcing, staffing, HR, or another relevant people-focused field.
  • 3+ years of recruiting, sourcing, staffing, or Talent Acquisition experience preferred, with demonstrated ability to independently manage searches and candidate relationships.
  • Experience recruiting technical, engineering, construction, field-based, professional-services, project-based, or corporate talent is helpful; the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar roles and talent markets is equally important.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, targeted outreach, referrals, job boards, databases, and other sourcing methods.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate-assessment skills with the ability to evaluate experience, transferable capabilities, motivations, communication, and overall alignment.
  • Comfortable partnering directly with hiring managers and asking thoughtful questions when hiring requirements are unclear or still evolving.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build credibility with candidates, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple searches, deadlines, candidate conversations, and shifting priorities.
  • Comfortable operating independently, exercising judgment, and moving work forward without having every step mapped out.
  • Experience working within an applicant tracking system; Rippling ATS experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing and recruiting technologies.
  • Comfortable using AI, automation, and emerging technology to improve productivity and recruiting effectiveness.

How You'll Work

We're less concerned with whether you've recruited every role on our org chart and more interested in how you approach something you haven't seen before. You'll probably enjoy this environment if you:

  • Ask good questions and learn quickly.
  • Aren't intimidated by unfamiliar or highly technical positions.
  • Will dig into competitors, adjacent industries, LinkedIn, referrals, and new sourcing channels until you figure out where the talent is.
  • Don't need a perfectly written job description or step-by-step instructions before getting started.
  • Know when to ask for help but are willing to try solving the problem first.
  • Adjust quickly when a search or hiring priority changes.
  • Communicate directly and consistently with candidates and hiring managers.
  • Bring recommendations when something isn't working rather than simply reporting the problem.
  • Build genuine relationships with the teams you support.
  • Are willing to jump in when the business needs help.
  • Want more ownership as you demonstrate you're ready for it.

Why QC Servion

  • The variety and growth here are a big part of the opportunity.
  • You won't be locked into one job family or spend every day recruiting the same profile. While you'll sit within our overhead/shared-services organization, your recruiting portfolio can flex across businesses and functions based on where support is needed.
  • As you work with those teams, you'll have the opportunity to become genuinely embedded in their hiring. You'll learn what they do, understand what makes someone successful there, build relationships with their leaders, and become someone they trust to help them make good talent decisions.
  • And because we're growing, your own path doesn't have to be completely defined on day one. As you demonstrate what you're good at, there may be opportunities to support new teams, take on harder searches, deepen your expertise, expand your relationships across the organization, or grow your responsibilities naturally with the business.
  • You don't need to arrive knowing everything.
  • You do need to be willing to jump in, learn quickly, build trust, and make the role your own.

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through home office.
  • May occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Benefits

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option).
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA).
  • Dental and vision plans.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26.
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option.
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year.
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage.
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional licensing assistance.
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment.

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is QC Servion's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

EEO

QC Servion provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Notice To Third Party Agencies
QC Servion does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to QC Servion in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where QC Servion has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of QC Servion and QC Servion will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

What you’ll do:

Provides intermediate-level cybersecurity risk and compliance analysis for third-party vendors, internal systems, projects, and non-standard technology requests. Independently evaluates cybersecurity controls, regulatory requirements, risk exposure, and potential impact to the organization; prepares written findings and recommendations; and partners with business, technology, vendor management, and Information Security stakeholders to support informed, risk-based decisions. jobs.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Set the Foundation for Time-Critical Order Execution

Airspace moves the shipments that can't be late — for hospitals waiting on an organ, a grounded aircraft waiting on a part, or a production line waiting on a component. As an Operations Specialist I, you're one of the first people to touch a new order, and how well you set it up determines whether everything downstream goes smoothly.

This is where every Airspace Operations career starts. You'll learn the platform, the players (customers, Commanders, and agent service providers), and the judgment calls that come with time-critical logistics. The role is deliberately structured to build your foundation fast, so that by the time you're ready to advance, the fundamentals are second nature.

What You'll Do

Operate the Airspace Platform

  • Set up new orders by adhering to standard work practices and client-specific SOP instructions
  • Apply transit accessorials (e.g., wait time, parking, tolls) in PT as reported — for charges that are not auto-generated by the system
  • Navigate and interpret carrier booking and tracking systems relevant to the order
  • Accurately confirm job milestones are completed correctly and on time
  • Rapidly move between competing priorities without losing accuracy

Solve Problems as They Arise

  • Source driver coverage for any segment of an order
  • Use situational awareness to request or deny additional driver incentives when necessary
  • Update, manage, and/or change shipment documentation as needed
  • Apply training and tenured knowledge to find solutions to common or uncommon issues
  • Follow escalation procedures and guidance from senior team members when a situation exceeds your judgment

Keep Customers Informed

  • Professionally relay delays, issues, and updates through verbal and written communication
  • Anticipate disruptions (weather, traffic, carrier delays) and proactively offer alternatives to meet or beat required delivery times
  • Place orders on behalf of customers who are unable to use the online portal

Stay Responsive Across Channels

  • Timely acknowledgment and action on all email, phone, and text requests
  • Consistently meet minimum metric expectations for phone availability and acceptance
  • Proper use of phone statuses; adherence to All Hands on Deck and Off-Phones guidelines
  • Stay independently informed by reviewing all communications provided throughout company platforms

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS I, you'll be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards appropriate for an entry-level position. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor. Expectations increase with each advancement.

Requirements

  • Prior logistics experience preferred, but not required — we'll train you on the platform, the workflows, and the judgment calls
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable on the phone with customers under time pressure
  • High attention to detail — small errors in time-critical logistics have outsized consequences
  • Ability to multitask and shift rapidly between competing priorities
  • Comfortable following structured processes while also using judgment when a situation falls outside the standard playbook
  • Willingness to obtain any certifications required for your assigned sector (e.g., Dangerous Goods handling, where applicable)
  • Available to work the shift pattern required by your team, including some evenings, weekends, or holidays as the network requires
  • Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

Advancement to Operations Specialist II

Advancement is a gate, not a timeline — tenure alone doesn't move you forward. To advance to OS II, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

  • Minimum of 6 months in the OS I role
  • Consistently meeting or exceeding OS I performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed at your first structured Semi-Annual Review (SAR)
  • Demonstrated proficiency across all OS I responsibilities with minimal supervision
  • Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to independently own the additional judgment calls required at OS II

Your First 90 Days

Get fluent in the Airspace platform, order lifecycle, and the standard work practices that keep time-critical shipments on track. Build working relationships with your team, your supervisor, and the Commanders and agent partners you'll coordinate with daily. By day 90, you should be handling the full OS I workload independently, with escalation as your safety net rather than your default.

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range: $20-23/hr
  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
  • 401K company contribution program
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

jobs.description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Billing Specialist to join the Finance team, to be based in the Philippines.

Why join Sprout’s Finance team?

At Sprout Social, our Finance team powers the strategy behind helping leading brands unlock the value of social intelligence. We act as the company’s fiscal backbone—equipping leaders with insights to make smart decisions while delivering a seamless experience for customers and meeting the demands of a dynamic public company.

You'll join a collaborative team grounded in accuracy and operational excellence, where your work directly impacts Sprout's success. We foster a culture of high standards and continuous learning, giving you the opportunity to grow your expertise while making meaningful contributions.

What you’ll do

  • Coordinate collection efforts for past due invoices documenting communications, discussions, and resolutions to ensure information is available for the broader finance team.
  • Manage customer inquiries and resolve billing issues.
  • Complete vendor set up forms and onboarding in customer billing portals.
  • Work with customers to bring accounts current, collaborating with Sprout team members throughout the organization.
  • Work with the Collections team and Billing leadership to resolve customer questions, concerns, or billing requirements that may prevent timely collection.
  • Report on collections activity and customer account updates to provide greater visibility to progress and challenges.
  • Identify, investigate,and resolve any discrepancies within historical cash applications.
  • Keep accurate records and reporting on collections and cash applications.
  • Liaise with Sales, Success, and Support teams by investigating and resolving invoice/payment disputes or errors and develop improvements to facilitate seamless and continuous service moving forward.
  • Align practices and procedures with Billing team standards and Audit compliance.

What you’ll bring

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 1+ years collection and cash application experience - proven experience utilizing collections tools and strategies.
  • 1-3+ years experience in a customer service or operational role, using several different software systems in tandem.
  • Strong oral & written communication skills, plus the ability to summarize complex situations for understanding and alignment.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Experience with Netsuite, Salesforce and similar software.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and seek support to resolve issues quickly and accurately.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Attend and complete Sprout Social’s two-week new hire training and onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. In these sessions, you will gain a broad understanding of our products and how your role directly impacts the product, overall organization, and our customers.
  • Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, and learn about Sprout’s collections and billing processes.
  • Have a deep understanding of the Finance team’s goals and key objectives and the impact our work has on Sprout’s overall business objectives
  • Get to know your team and begin to build working relationships with co-workers and customers.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Reaching out to customers that are 60+ days past due.
  • Begin learning portal management.
  • Understand the invoicing process and participate in generating new, renewal, and amendment invoices to ensure an organized and timely cash collection process.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Ensuring successful portal billing for customers.
  • Assisting with collections on accounts that need additional attention or require prioritization.
  • Foster rapport and communication across Sprout teams and customers.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Organizing and maintaining billing portal management processes and procedures.
  • Maintaining collections on accounts that do not exceed 60+ days past due and assisting in our overall cash collection goals.
  • Be a go-to Collections contact for all areas of the organization.
  • Continuously improve and maintain the various processes, adapting to changing requirements and ensuring accurate documentation.
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: A 23,299 PHP monthly allowance to cover your health insurance (HMO) needs.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including free coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 24 days of paid leave, 5 sick days, plus regular holidays, special non-working holidays, and company-wide Rest & Recharge days.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): An annual $500 USD fund to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being—from gym memberships to hobbies.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet expenses.
  • Standard Compensation & Pay: We provide a 13th-month salary and adhere to all government-mandated pay premiums, including Night Shift Differential (NSD) and holiday/overtime pay.
  • Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible charitable organizations.
  • High-Quality Equipment: A 13" MacBook and other high-quality equipment to ensure you can do your best work.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: PHP 524,000–PHP 655,000 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

The full base pay range for this role is PHP 524,000 – PHP 786.000.

We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Payments Infrastructure Engineer to take ownership of an existing payments backend and complete its integration, testing, and production deployment.

The role involves working with Rust-based microservices, financial ledgers, digital wallets, cryptocurrency transactions, Fireblocks custody infrastructure, and fiat payment integrations.

Responsibilities include completing payment processing and settlement functionality, implementing transaction reconciliation, managing wallet integrations, ensuring accurate balance accounting, and building reliable transaction recovery and monitoring systems.

The engineer will integrate existing financial services using REST and gRPC, troubleshoot distributed systems, complete end-to-end testing, and ensure the infrastructure is secure, scalable, and production-ready.

Strong experience with backend engineering, financial transaction systems, distributed architecture, and cryptocurrency payments is essential. Experience with Rust, Fireblocks, TigerBeetle, Solana, AWS, and institutional wallet infrastructure is highly desirable.

The ideal candidate can independently understand an existing codebase, resolve integration challenges, and deliver production-ready financial infrastructure without unnecessarily rebuilding completed systems.

  • 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including significant hands-on responsibility for production financial systems, payment infrastructure, cryptocurrency platforms, or digital asset services.
  • Proven experience building and operating financial transaction systems involving payment processing, settlement, reconciliation, and balance management.
  • Strong understanding of double-entry accounting and financial ledger architecture, including transaction consistency, idempotency, auditability, and failure recovery.
  • Production experience with digital wallets and cryptocurrency payments, including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, transaction signing, and secure key management.
  • Experience integrating Fireblocks or comparable institutional custody platforms, including custody APIs, wallet administration, transaction authorization, and security policies.
  • Advanced proficiency in Rust, Go, or another high-performance backend language, with demonstrated ability to work in Rust-based microservices.
  • Expertise in distributed systems, including REST, gRPC, asynchronous processing, concurrency, fault tolerance, and event-driven architectures.
  • Strong database engineering experience, including PostgreSQL or comparable transactional databases, ACID guarantees, concurrency control, and data integrity.
  • Production experience with AWS, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and infrastructure security, including deploying and troubleshooting mission-critical services.
  • Deep understanding of blockchain transaction infrastructure, cryptographic signing, wallet architecture, and secure digital asset transfers.
  • Experience integrating third-party financial services, including payment gateways, banking APIs, fiat on/off ramps, or cryptocurrency exchanges.
  • Strong security engineering knowledge, including encryption, access controls, secrets management, transaction authorization, and financial-system security practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex production systems, investigate unfamiliar codebases, resolve integration problems, and deliver reliable infrastructure without unnecessary redesign.
  • Experience with automated integration and end-to-end testing for financial transactions, including duplicate processing, partial failures, reconciliation discrepancies, and recovery scenarios.
  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills, with demonstrated experience collaborating across backend, infrastructure, blockchain, and financial engineering teams.

Highly Preferred

  • Direct production experience with Fireblocks and TigerBeetle.
  • Hands-on Rust development in financial or high-throughput distributed systems.
  • Experience with Solana, SPL tokens, and blockchain wallet integrations.
  • Experience building cryptocurrency exchanges, payment orchestration platforms, custody infrastructure, or treasury systems.
  • Familiarity with KYC/AML, PCI DSS, and financial services compliance requirements.
  • Evidence of personally engineering and deploying financial infrastructure handling real customer funds at production scale.

Solutions not problems .

  • Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
  • Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
  • An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
  • Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Deferred compensation

This opportunity is designed for entrepreneurial, startup-minded engineers who want to help build a significant global business. This is not free work. Compensation is agreed upon and deferred until funding is secured, at which point it transitions to a competitive, normalized salary plus equity and OleX token ownership. Our entire team, including the founder, operates under this arrangement. This position is intended for individuals who understand the risks of an early-stage startup, are comfortable with uncertain funding timelines, and are motivated by the opportunity to build something substantial while participating in its long-term ownership and success.

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

OleOle is building a global social network and messaging platform for football fans. Our mission is to create a single global community where supporters can follow their club and country, connect with other fans, message and call each other, follow live matches, discover content, and ultimately access a broader ecosystem of football products and services.

OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off.
