We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
The Director of Cybersecurity Advisory will establish, lead, and grow STN One's cybersecurity advisory practice, with primary ownership of the virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) service offering. This is a client-facing, revenue-accountable leadership role that partners closely with sales and business relationships to acquire new accounts, expand recurring advisory engagements, and deliver measurable security outcomes. The director will also support internal STN initiatives involving network security architecture, governance, and enterprise risk reduction.

Key Responsibilities

vCISO Practice Development & Business Growth
  • Build and own the vCISO service practice, including service definition, delivery methodology, scope, packaging, pricing inputs, templates, governance cadence, and standardized customer deliverables.
  • Work proactively with STN sales, account leaders, strategic partners, referral contacts, and executive relationships to identify opportunities, develop qualified pipeline, and win new vCISO accounts.
  • Participate in discovery meetings, executive briefings, proposals, statements of work, and solution presentations; translate customer needs into differentiated, feasible advisory engagements.
  • Own practice growth outcomes, including new customer acquisition, advisory recurring revenue, renewals, client satisfaction, and appropriate expansion into adjacent cybersecurity services.
Security Advisory & Risk Management
  • Deliver or oversee vCISO engagements involving security strategy, executive advisory, risk assessments, security roadmaps, governance, budgeting, policy development, and board-level reporting.
  • Lead assessment and readiness work aligned with relevant customer needs such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and other applicable frameworks.
  • Assess the effectiveness of network security architecture and controls, including perimeter protections, remote access, segmentation, identity integration, visibility, and secure configuration.
  • Support STN internal network security and related initiatives, coordinating with cybersecurity operations, network engineering, infrastructure, and architecture teams on identified risks and remediation plans.
  • Guide customers through security program prioritization, incident readiness, third-party risk, vulnerability governance, control maturity, and practical investment decisions.
Service Delivery & Operational Excellence
  • Develop repeatable advisory deliverables such as maturity assessments, executive scorecards, board presentations, risk registers, roadmaps, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Establish consistent service quality, staffing and delivery expectations, customer communication standards, and processes for managing advisory capacity as the practice scales.
  • Collaborate with SOC, DFIR, penetration testing, and implementation teams to connect advisory findings to realistic, customer-approved security services and technical remediation.
Practice Performance & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Monitor engagement profitability, utilization, account health, renewal risk, and commercial performance; report outcomes and proposed improvements to the Director of Cybersecurity.
  • Represent STN professionally in senior customer discussions, partner conversations, and relevant industry communities; maintain discretion with sensitive client information.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • 8+ years of cybersecurity leadership, security consulting, enterprise security program management, or related experience, with meaningful direct customer advisory responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience selling, expanding, or commercially growing cybersecurity advisory, vCISO, GRC consulting, or professional security services; able to work credibly with sales teams.
  • Ability to independently advise executive stakeholders, conduct security and risk assessments, create multi-quarter roadmaps, and present findings to leadership audiences.
  • Strong working knowledge of network security, enterprise architectures, segmentation, IAM, remote access, security operations, vulnerability management, and control effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge of frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and relevant risk management methods.
  • Experience building repeatable customer-facing services, coordinating cross-functional delivery, and managing the competing demands of growth and service quality.
  • Current CISSP or CISM certification required.
Preferred
  • Direct responsibility for P&L, annual recurring revenue, service pricing, consultative pipeline management, or partner/channel-led growth.
  • Experience within an MSSP, managed services provider, security consultancy, or multi-customer advisory organization.
  • Technical familiarity with Palo Alto Networks security controls, Cortex XSIAM/XDR, SentinelOne, Illumio, Okta or Microsoft Entra ID, and public-cloud security controls.
  • Additional credentials such as CRISC, CCSP, CISA, or relevant network security architecture certifications.

Company Overview:

Avahi is an AI systems integrator helping businesses put Cloud + AI to work.

Our engineers, AI researchers, and cloud specialists work as an extension of your team, taking ownership from strategy through deployment and ongoing support. We help startups, SMBs, and mid-market organizations move quickly from idea to working solution.

We are looking for a seasoned AI Architect to join our growing AI & Cloud practice. You will lead the design and implementation of intelligent systems powered by AWS AI services — with a particular focus on Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, and OpenSearch. You will work closely with clients and cross-functional teams to deliver production-grade AI architectures that are secure, cost-efficient, and enterprise-ready.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Architecture & Design

  • Architect end-to-end AI/ML solutions leveraging AWS Bedrock foundation models (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Titan, Meta Llama, Mistral, etc.)
  • Design multi-agent orchestration systems using Amazon Bedrock Agents, including agent action groups, knowledge bases, and guardrails
  • Define embedding pipelines, vector indexing strategies, and retrieval patterns for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications
  • Establish semantic and lexical search architectures using Amazon OpenSearch Service (including k-NN vector search and hybrid search)
  • Create architecture blueprints, decision records (ADRs), and technical reference designs for AI platforms

AWS Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3, and IAM
  • Integrate Bedrock workflows with AWS data services (Glue, Athena, RDS, DynamoDB) and event-driven pipelines (Kinesis, SQS, EventBridge)

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code practices using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the primary AI/ML architecture advisor to clients, translating business needs into actionable technical roadmaps
  • Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) development for AI features and present findings to engineering and executive stakeholders
  • Mentor development teams on prompt engineering, model evaluation, LLM fine-tuning, and responsible AI practices
  • Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to AWS Well-Architected Framework principles

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and software engineers throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Define and track AI solution KPIs including latency, accuracy, retrieval relevance, cost-per-query, and model hallucination rates
  • Produce detailed technical documentation, runbooks, and client-facing deliverables

Required Qualifications:

Core Experience

  • 8+ years of software engineering or cloud architecture experience, with 3+ years focused on AI/ML or generative AI solutions
  • Proven hands-on expertise with Amazon Bedrock, including model invocation APIs, Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails
  • Deep experience designing and operating Amazon OpenSearch Service clusters, including vector search (k-NN), index management, and relevance tuning
  • Strong proficiency in Python; familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks is a plus
  • Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines integrating foundation models with enterprise data sources

AWS Expertise

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) strongly preferred; AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty is a plus
  • Solid understanding of AWS networking, identity, and security services in the context of AI workloads
  • Experience with multi-account AWS architectures (AWS Organizations, Control Tower) and enterprise-scale deployments

Why Work Here

Remote-First Flexibility:

Enjoy work-life harmony in a remote-first environment that allows you to work from anywhere.

Innovative Culture:

We embrace a startup mindset, encouraging creativity, agility, and growth. Be part of a team that explores cutting-edge technology and drives impactful solutions.

Avahi is committed to your growth, offering mentorship and opportunities to advance your career.

Join us in making a difference. Avahi is dedicated to championing diversity, supporting women in tech, and fostering sustainable practices.

Global Collaboration:

Work alongside a diverse, talented team, sharing insights and collaborating to create innovative solutions that make a real impact.

Accessibility and Inclusivity Statement

At Avahi, we are committed to fostering a workplace that celebrates diversity and inclusivity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, including those from underrepresented communities.

We buy and hold software companies that serve banks, credit unions, lenders, collection agencies and enterprise financial institutions, and we never sell them. Our focus areas are core and digital banking, payments, lending and credit, debt collection and recovery, risk and compliance, and financial operations and analytics. PhoenixWorx, acquired from Finastra in 2026, anchors the group alongside a growing portfolio including WebRecon and CORA Loyalty. Title: M&A Associate

Location: USA or Canada, flexible

Reports to: Vice President, M&A

Start: January 2027

The Associate builds and works our acquisition pipeline. You identify and research software businesses in our verticals, open relationships with founders and owners, qualify opportunities against our investment criteria, and bring the ones that fit to our twice-weekly deal review with a clear thesis. Position Overview

APEX TK is searching for a Programmatic Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support The Marshall Space Flight Center (MSFC) Environmental Control and Life Support Systems (ECLSS).

The desired candidate shall interact with senior project personnel at MSFC, prime contractors, other NASA centers, DoD, industry, and academia as specified. This can be a remote position. The contractor shall serve as a subject matter expert for ECLSS and will provide evaluations and recommendations on proposed ECLSS systems and development activities. The contractor will be expected to lead major ECLSS assignments, including conducting comprehensive technical assessments of the Blue Origin and SpaceX Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) designs to evaluate system maturity, identify critical technical and programmatic risks, and assess realistic development, integration, testing, and certification schedules. Develop evidence-based risk assessments that clearly articulate key challenges, potential impacts, mitigation strategies, and the activities required to achieve system certification. Identify opportunities for technical collaboration, shared risk-reduction activities, and coordinated testing and certification efforts to improve confidence in system readiness and support informed programmatic decision-making.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field
  • 10+ years of direct experience with Environmental Control and Life Support Systems (ECLSS), specifically on both air revitalization and water recovery/management systems
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or leading technical assessments of ECLSS designs across multiple development phases (design, integration, test, certification)
  • Experience interfacing with NASA programs, prime contractors, or DoD customers at a senior/project-lead level
  • Experience conducting risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies for complex space systems
  • Experience developing and evaluating technical and programmatic schedules for life-critical systems
  • Experience with ECLSS certification requirements and verification planning
  • Thorough understanding of ECLSS subsystem architecture including: atmosphere revitalization, CO₂ removal/reduction, oxygen generation, water recovery, thermal control interfaces, and trace contaminant control
  • Familiarity with crew health and safety requirements and life support margins for crewed spaceflight
  • Working knowledge of NASA technical standards and human spaceflight requirements (NASA-STD-3001, NPR 7120.5, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead major technical assignments independently with minimal direction
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to brief senior leadership and produce monthly summary reports on schedule
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance (or currently holds one)
  • Willingness and ability to travel with government approval

Desired Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline
  • PMP certification or equivalent program management credential
  • Prior NASA civil servant, contractor, or FFRDC experience supporting MSFC, JSC, or a crewed spacecraft program (ISS, Orion, Gateway, Artemis)
  • Direct experience with Blue Origin or SpaceX ECLSS development programs or technical evaluation thereof
  • Experience supporting Gateway, Lunar Surface Systems, or Commercial LEO Destinations (CLD) programs
  • Experience conducting Independent Technical Assessments (ITAs), Independent Review Team (IRT) activities, or Technical Review Board (TRB) support
  • Prior experience coordinating cross-agency ECLSS testing or shared risk-reduction activities between NASA centers or with commercial partners
  • Experience with ECLSS analog environments (EVA suits, hyperbaric systems, closed-loop habitats)
  • Familiarity with DoD life support or CBRNE/environmental control system standards and crosswalk to NASA requirements
  • Understanding of ECLSS-adjacent systems integration: thermal control, power, structures/mechanisms, GN&C interfaces
  • Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools applied to ECLSS design and verification
  • Knowledge of ECLSS lessons learned from ISS and Shuttle programs
  • Established professional relationships across the ECLSS community (NASA centers, academia, national labs, commercial providers)
  • Experience contributing to or leading proposal efforts, source selections, or acquisition strategies for ECLSS procurements
  • Familiarity with NASA's Systems Engineering Handbook (SP-2016-6105) and human-rating processes
  • Prior experience as a Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) or technical monitor for ECLSS-related contracts

jobs.excerpt: Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions.
jobs.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

As an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO), you will help get our products authorized and keep them authorized. Supporting our ISSM and government ISSMs, you will own day-to-day security and authorization work across multiple systems, spanning cloud (FedRAMP, DoD IL5) and classified (IL6, Secret, TS/SCI) systems. You will partner with engineering, AppSec, and DevOps to keep packages current, keep controls verifiable, and move our systems toward continuous ATO (cATO). This is a hands-on technical role that directly shapes how quickly our software reaches the mission.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain ATO and IATT packages (SSPs, FIPS 199 / CNSSI 1253 categorization, CRMs, POA&Ms) under NIST SP 800-37, NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, the DoD Cloud Computing SRG, and JSIG.
  • Assess security controls across cloud and on-prem classified systems (IAM, logging, encryption, network segmentation) and document inheritance from cloud and hosting providers.
  • Complete DISA STIG checklists and run vulnerability scans, then drive remediation with engineering.
  • Support cATO and continuous monitoring (NIST SP 800-137): automate evidence collection, review changes for security impact, track POA&Ms, and keep eMASS and Xacta current.
  • Respond to customer security questionnaires and coordinate with government customers and third-party assessors.
  • Monitor deployed systems for unauthorized changes and suspicious activity, and support incident response, audits, and media sanitization.
  • Maintain security policies and procedures aligned to customer and authorization requirements.

What you should have

  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • 4+ years in cybersecurity, including 2+ years as an ISSO, ISSE or in a similar authorization role on DoD, IC, or federal systems
  • Hands-on ATO experience under NIST SP 800-37 and 800-53 in cloud and classified environments
  • Working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on-prem classified systems, plus familiarity with containers and microservices (e.g., Kubernetes) and Git-based change management (e.g., GitHub)
  • Experience with eMASS or Xacta, DISA STIGs, and SCAP/SCC or ACAS scans
  • DoD 8140 compliant certification (Security+ CE or higher)
  • Clear, concise writer who can explain controls to engineers and authorizing officials

Nice to have

  • DoD IL5/IL6, FedRAMP High, or cATO experience
  • AWS GovCloud and cloud security tooling such as Wiz, CrowdStrike, or Splunk
  • Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
  • CISSP, CCSP, or AWS Certified Security Specialty

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 100% remote - work from anywhere in the US
  • 401k matching
  • Mental benefits
  • Flexible work environment - you manage your workday
  • Pet and child care reimbursement during travel
  • Unlimited PTO
Compensation
The salary range for this position is $120,000 - $160,000 + equity + 401K match.

We hire across multiple levels based on experience, technical capabilities, and scope of responsibility. This range reflects the base salaries we typically expect to offer for this role, with individual offers determined by the candidate's qualifications and level.

Equity is offered in addition to base salary.

Vannevar is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't feel like you're a perfect fit. If you're passionate about contributing to our mission, we'd love to hear from you!

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all applicants. Official emails from the company will come from an @vannevarlabs.com domain. Functional leaders remain accountable for service delivery and employee performance; the Operations Enablement Lead provides the standards, methods, content, governance, facilitation, and insights that help teams adopt consistent ways of working.

Operations training strategy: Define and maintain an integrated training and enablement approach across Virtuox Operations, aligned to business priorities, role requirements, quality expectations, and changing processes.

Onboarding programs: Design, implement, and continuously improve role-based onboarding pathways, facilitator guides, learner materials, checkpoints, and readiness criteria for new and transitioning employees.

Learning needs assessment: Partner with functional leaders and subject-matter experts to assess capability gaps, translate operational needs into learning plans, and prioritize training based on risk and business impact.

Knowledge management: Manage and maintain centralized operations knowledge base solution that makes current procedures, job aids, process maps, FAQs, decision guides, and best practices easy to find and use.

SOP governance: Establish standards, templates, ownership, review cycles, version control, approvals, and retirement practices for operations SOPs and related documentation.

Content development: Develop and maintain training materials, knowledge articles, job aids, playbooks, simulations, and other enablement tools in partnership with subject-matter experts.

Continuous improvement: Facilitate process discovery, root-cause analysis, workflow redesign, and improvement initiatives that reduce waste, rework, variation, manual effort, and avoidable customer friction.

Quality enablement: Translate quality findings, audit themes, recurring errors, and operational risks into targeted learning, process controls, documentation improvements, and corrective-action support.

Change readiness and adoption: Create readiness, communication, training, reinforcement, and adoption plans for new systems, products, processes, services, policies, and organization changes.

Cross-training and resilience: Build cross-training approaches, skill matrices, role-readiness criteria, and reinforcement plans that improve operational flexibility, coverage, and continuity.

Measurement and insights: Define and report metrics for onboarding effectiveness, time to readiness, training completion, knowledge usage, process adoption, quality outcomes, and improvement benefits.

Program governance: Maintain a visible roadmap, priorities, risks, decisions, owners, and status reporting for the operations excellence and enablement portfolio.

Consulting and facilitation: Serve as a trusted advisor and facilitator to operational leaders, using expertise and influence to align stakeholders and move complex, cross-functional work forward without direct authority.

jobs.description:
About MedeAnalytics

MedeAnalytics is the Enterprise Healthcare Performance company that delivers AI-driven, cloud-native solutions to help payers, risk-bearing providers and other value- and risk-bearing entities measurably improve performance by reducing costs, improving quality and MLR, optimizing utilization, increasing reimbursement, and elevating care quality across all lines of business. Its enterprise health data management platform—built on its proprietary Health Fabric™—unifies clinical, claims, financial, and social data into a single, scalable source of truth that fuels insights, action, and AI.

As the industry’s healthcare intelligence partner of choice for more than 30 years, MedeAnalytics combines its platform, cross-domain enterprise analytics, AI-powered workflows, and Strategic Advisory™ services to transform intelligence into accountable execution—delivering greater ROI across value-based care, risk and quality, cost and utilization management, and network optimization.

MedeAnalytics empowers organizations to move faster from insight to impact with confidence and measurable results. To learn more, visit medeanalytics.com and follow MedeAnalytics on LinkedIn and Facebook.

About Our Opportunity

Core Requirement

This role requires a proven strategic payer sales leader with demonstrated success selling and expanding enterprise solutions with health plans, primary focus in Medicare Advantage and Medicaid, secondarily in Commercial markets. The ideal candidate understands the distinct business, regulatory, operational, and market dynamics of each line of business and can translate payer priorities into credible executive-level strategies that drive measurable growth.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Payer Growth is responsible for generating new business and expanding strategic health plan relationships within an assigned territory and account portfolio. This leader will develop territory and account strategies, build trusted relationships with payer executives, identify and quantify whitespace, and lead complex enterprise sales opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution.

A key focus of the role is creating a comprehensive growth strategy for an existing portfolio of health plan clients, meaning accelerate cross-sell opportunities; and pursuing new logo opportunities with national, regional, State sponsored, and other risk-bearing payers.

The successful candidate will connect payer priorities—including affordability, healthcare economics, risk and quality performance, value-based care, population health, member engagement, customer and group reporting, AI, and enterprise data strategy to the MedeAnalytics Health Performance Platform and broader solution portfolio. This individual must be equally effective as an enterprise seller, strategic account leader, healthcare advisor, and cross-functional team orchestrator.

Key Responsibilities

New Business and Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a territory growth strategy across Medicare Advantage and Medicaid.
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline through executive relationships, market intelligence, targeted prospecting, partnerships, and industry engagement.
  • Create account-specific strategies for priority health plans, including relationship maps, business hypotheses, solution alignment, and pursuit plans.
  • Lead consultative conversations that connect payer business priorities to MedeAnalytics' data, analytics, AI, workflow, and advisory capabilities.
  • Manage complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery and solution development through executive presentations, RFPs, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed annual new-logo, expansion, ARR, and revenue targets.

Strategic Account Expansion

  • Serve as the commercial growth leader for an assigned portfolio of existing health plan clients.
  • Partner with Account Management to develop and execute strategic growth and success plans for each priority account.
  • Build a deep understanding of each client's strategy, operating model, technology and analytics environment, financial objectives, transformation initiatives, and competitive landscape.
  • Identify and quantify whitespace across the MedeAnalytics portfolio and convert it into actionable near- and long-term opportunities.
  • Expand relationships beyond current users and buyers by developing executive sponsorship across business, clinical, financial, technology, analytics, and operational functions.
  • Lead the commercial strategy for expansions, cross-sells, and upsells, positioning MedeAnalytics as a long-term enterprise partner.
  • Coordinate executive sponsorship and internal resources around the highest-value growth opportunities.

Territory and Market Leadership

  • Maintain a comprehensive territory plan covering current clients, priority prospects, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and revenue potential.
  • Apply a strong understanding of the distinct priorities of Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, dual-eligible, and commercial health plans to shape relevant executive conversations and growth strategies.
  • Monitor payer trends, policy changes, competitive activity, and emerging client needs, translating market intelligence into commercial opportunities.
  • Represent MedeAnalytics at industry conferences, client events, executive meetings, and other payer forums.
  • Establish MedeAnalytics as a strategic thought partner—not solely a technology or analytics vendor—with health plan leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Operating Discipline

  • Serve as the commercial lead for assigned strategic accounts, coordinating Account Management, Product, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Services, Partnerships, and executive leadership.
  • Translate client needs and market intelligence into actionable input for product strategy, partnerships, messaging, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Collaborate with solution and product leaders to develop compelling business cases tied to measurable clinical, financial, operational, and member outcomes.
  • Lead regular account and territory reviews focused on pipeline, client health, revenue risk, whitespace, relationship coverage, and next actions.
  • Maintain disciplined opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, and CRM hygiene.

Measures of Success

  • New-logo ARR and revenue
  • Expansion ARR and revenue from existing clients
  • Qualified pipeline creation, progression, and conversion
  • Growth of MedeAnalytics' footprint within strategic accounts
  • Executive relationship depth and breadth
  • Strategic account and territory plan execution
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Client advocacy and referenceability
  • Achievement of annual territory revenue objectives

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of successful enterprise sales, strategic account growth, or business development experience in healthcare technology, analytics, SaaS, consulting, or related solutions serving health plans.
  • Demonstrated sales and account-expansion success across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plan markets.
  • Strong understanding of the distinct economics, regulatory requirements, operating models, purchasing dynamics, and strategic priorities of government-sponsored and commercial health plans.
  • Proven ability to originate, develop, and close complex, multi-million-dollar enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience developing and expanding relationships with large national, regional, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and/or provider-sponsored health plans.
  • Strong understanding of payer priorities, including affordability, medical cost management, value-based care, risk adjustment, quality, population health, network performance, member engagement, and enterprise analytics.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare data, including medical and pharmacy claims, clinical, financial, eligibility, provider, and social risk data.
  • Ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executives across business, clinical, financial, operational, technology, and analytics functions.
  • Experience navigating complex RFPs, procurement processes, contracting, and enterprise decision-making environments.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
  • Highly self-directed, with the discipline to manage a large territory and portfolio of complex strategic accounts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Established executive relationships within the U.S. payer market.
  • Experience selling enterprise healthcare data platforms, analytics, AI, population health, value-based care, quality, risk, or financial performance solutions.
  • Understanding of modern healthcare data architecture, cloud platforms, interoperability, AI/ML, and enterprise analytics environments.
  • Experience helping health plans unify fragmented data and analytics environments or expand enterprise adoption of a strategic platform.
  • Demonstrated payer-market thought leadership and the ability to represent MedeAnalytics credibly with senior industry executives.

Leadership Profile

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial ownership, strategic thinking, and executive relationship-building skills to manage their territory and account portfolio as a trusted partner to health plan leaders.

Additional Information:

MedeAnalytics believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $195,000 USD + commission opportunities. Please note that actual compensation for all roles may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, relevant work experience, professional achievements/qualifications, skill level, business need, location and will be finalized at the time of offer.

jobs.excerpt: 📍 Remote (U. S. -Based) | Optional hybrid in the Bay Area Reports to: Senior Director, Asynchronous Care Job Type: Full-time W2 Overview Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife - and we're growing fast.
jobs.description:
📍 Remote (U.S.-Based) | Optional hybrid in the Bay Area
Reports to: Senior Director, Asynchronous Care
Job Type: Full-time W2

Overview

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife - and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need to ensure our Medical and Practice Assistants have the training, tools, and feedback they need to consistently deliver high-quality work.

We're looking for a Senior Operations Manager, Performance & Enablement to build and own the programs that help our frontline teams perform at their best.

This person will design, establish, and own the performance measurement, operational QA, and training programs that support Medical and Practice Assistants across Async Operations. You'll set consistent standards across teams, build scalable systems for evaluating frontline execution, and give Managers the tools and insights they need to identify gaps, coach effectively, and drive measurable performance improvements.

This role goes beyond traditional quality assurance or training. You'll connect performance data, quality findings, and frontline observations to diagnose complex performance challenges, distinguish between individual execution and broader operational issues, and develop targeted interventions that lead to sustained improvement.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in frontline quality, performance management, and training, with strong analytical judgment and a track record of building scalable programs. They're comfortable operating independently, influencing leaders across teams, and using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, develop resources, and improve how frontline teams work.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys building programs from the ground up and turning performance insights into meaningful operational improvements.

The goal: Build a consistently high-performing MA workforce that delivers accurate, timely, and high-quality patient support at scale.

You won't just measure frontline performance — you'll build the systems that help our teams continuously improve.

What you'll do

MA Quality & Performance

  • Design and own a scalable framework for evaluating MA performance consistently across Async Operations.
  • Establish performance measurement standards and reporting that give Managers actionable visibility into individual and team performance.
  • Bring together quality, productivity, and adherence metrics to create a comprehensive view of frontline performance.
  • Design and maintain operational QA scorecards, evaluation rubrics, sampling methodologies, and reporting frameworks.
  • Establish consistent approaches for evaluating whether MAs follow established workflows, SOPs, and service standards accurately and effectively.
  • Define and measure performance across accuracy, completeness, responsiveness, communication, resolution, and process adherence.
  • Lead calibration processes across teams to ensure quality standards are interpreted and applied consistently.
  • Identify high performers, recurring performance gaps, and opportunities for targeted coaching and development.
  • Equip Managers with actionable performance insights, coaching frameworks, and resources to drive accountability and improvement.
  • Own the effectiveness of performance measurement and QA programs, continuously refining them based on operational results and frontline feedback.

Training & Frontline Enablement

  • Design, establish, and own scalable onboarding and continuous-learning programs for Medical and Practice Assistants across Async Operations.
  • Develop training strategies, curricula, onboarding materials, job aids, and ongoing learning resources that support consistent frontline execution.
  • Identify recurring knowledge and skill gaps through quality reviews, performance data, and frontline observations.
  • Translate performance gaps into targeted training, retraining, and reinforcement programs.
  • Establish processes to keep training materials current as workflows, SOPs, tools, and expectations evolve.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts to ensure training reflects established operational and clinical standards.
  • Develop tools and resources that enable Managers to reinforce expectations and coach their teams effectively.
  • Build mechanisms for ongoing learning, knowledge retention, and skill development beyond initial onboarding.
  • Define measures of training effectiveness and continuously improve programs based on their impact on frontline quality, consistency, and performance.

Performance Insights & Continuous Improvement

  • Independently analyze complex quality and performance trends to identify recurring execution gaps, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Identify patterns across quality reviews, patient feedback, repeat contacts, escalations, and operational performance.
  • Distinguish between problems caused by knowledge gaps, individual execution, unclear processes, or system limitations, and recommend appropriate interventions. ● Partner with Operations Managers to establish coaching, training, and performance improvement priorities based on data and frontline observations.
  • Identify systemic workflow and technology issues affecting frontline execution and translate findings into actionable recommendations for the appropriate owners. ● Ensure operational changes are reflected in training, quality measurement, and performance expectations.
  • Establish feedback loops between frontline teams, Managers, and operational leaders to drive continuous improvement.
  • Measure the effectiveness of coaching, training, and performance interventions, refining approaches to achieve sustained improvements.
  • Advise Async Operations leadership on frontline performance trends, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and patient experience.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Async Operations Managers, providing the performance frameworks, insights, and enablement resources needed to lead high-performing teams. ● Collaborate with Analytics & Workforce Planning to align performance reporting, productivity measurement, and operational insights.
  • Partner with Operations, Systems Operations, and Product to ensure workflow and technology changes are incorporated into frontline training and performance expectations.
  • Work with Clinical leadership and Clinical Quality to ensure training and evaluation reflect approved clinical protocols and escalation standards.
  • Influence performance and enablement priorities across teams, establishing consistent standards while adapting programs to the needs of different workflows.
  • Communicate complex performance findings and recommendations clearly to operational leaders, helping translate insights into measurable improvements.

What you will need to succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in Operations, Quality Assurance, Training & Enablement, Performance Management, or a related field, including demonstrated experience designing and scaling frontline performance or training programs.
  • Deep expertise in frontline quality assurance, performance measurement, coaching frameworks, and operational accountability.
  • Experience designing and implementing QA scorecards, evaluation rubrics, sampling methodologies, calibration processes, and performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable onboarding, training, and continuous-learning programs for operational teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment and data fluency, with the ability to independently evaluate complex performance trends, identify root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Comfort leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, develop training resources, evaluate performance trends, and improve operational processes.
  • Experience establishing performance standards and measurement frameworks across multiple teams or workflows.
  • Ability to distinguish between individual performance gaps, training needs, process problems, and system limitations.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to connect frontline performance to operational efficiency, service levels, and patient experience.
  • Experience influencing frontline Managers and operational leaders to drive improvements without directly managing their employees.
  • Strong program management skills, with demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and continuously improve complex operational programs.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex expectations and performance findings into clear, actionable training and coaching resources.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where workflows, tools, and organizational needs are evolving.
  • Bias toward action: You don't just identify performance gaps — you build the tools, training, and feedback mechanisms that help teams improve.

Bonus: Experience in healthcare operations, medical practices, customer support, or other high-volume service environments.

This is a full-time W2 position. The base salary range is 130K-160K and will depend on experience. Midi pays a competitive base salary, plus equity and benefits.

Inside Sales Intern (US Market)

Fresh Prints | 100% Remote |

Fresh Prints is a US-headquartered company supplying custom apparel and promotional products to clients across America. We've been named to Inc. 5000's list of fastest-growing companies for six consecutive years, have grown over 60% in the last decade, and are approaching $100 million in annual sales. Our business model runs on a network of entrepreneurial students — which is why campus hiring sits close to the centre of how we operate.

The Role

This is a real sales role, not a shadowing exercise. After structured onboarding, you'll work directly with US-based clients and build your own portfolio of accounts.

What you'll do

  • Close warm inbound leads passed to you by our marketing team
  • Grow and manage the accounts you win
  • Own your pipeline end to end
  • Learn product knowledge, sourcing, negotiation, and customer success
  • Work alongside experienced Inside Sales Managers

Who we're looking for

  • Clear, easily understood spoken and written English — you'll be on calls with American clients daily
  • A proactive, goal-oriented mindset
  • Composure under pressure; rejection is part of sales
  • Self-starting — nobody will be chasing you for updates

What you get

  • 1:1 mentorship from experienced Inside Sales Managers
  • Direct exposure to the full sales cycle and US clients
  • Opportunity for full-time conversion (PPO) based on performance
  • Certificate of Completion

The setup — please read carefully

  • 100% remote, permanently
  • 7:30 PM – 2:00 AM IST, Monday to Friday — these are US client hours, and they are non-negotiable
  • 25–35 hours per week
  • Minimum three weeks, extendable based on performance and mutual interest

We state the hours prominently because they are the single biggest factor in whether this role works for you. We would much rather you self-select honestly now than discover a mismatch in week one.

Eligibility: All years of study are welcome, including final-year students — the full-time conversion path is genuinely open to those graduating soon.

What Happens Next?

Your potential journey:
US Sales Internship → Jr. ISA → ISA Level 1

After the internship, strong performers will be selected to continue with Fresh Prints as a Junior Inside Sales Associate (Jr. ISA).

As a Jr. ISA, you’ll:

  • Work with U.S. clients and gain real-world sales experience
  • Earn 4% uncapped commission on every sale (an average of ~$350/month)
  • Build the skills and experience needed to grow into a full-time sales role
  • Health insurance + mental health benefits

Successful Jr. ISAs can transition into a Full-Time Inside Sales Associate (ISA Level 1) role.

Your compensation would include:

  • ₹8.5–9 LPA fixed CTC(approximately $780/month fixed salary)
  • 4% uncapped commission on sales
  • ₹10–12 LPA estimated total annual earnings, including typical commission/incentives
  • Health insurance + mental health benefits

In simple terms: ₹8.5–9 LPA is the fixed component. With commission and incentives, total annual earnings can reach approximately ₹10–12 LPA, depending on your performance.

Questions?

Bring your eCOA and clinical trials experience to a role where you can take meaningful ownership of study delivery. As an Associate eCOA Manager, you’ll oversee key eCOA vendor deliverables, timelines, risks, budgets, and communications across assigned studies.


You’ll be a central link between eCOA vendors, sponsors, and Worldwide study teams, helping ensure systems and associated activities meet study requirements throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. You’ll join a Clinical Systems Department that works across a broad range of clinical technologies and provides opportunities for mentorship, training, and internal growth.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in US. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

jobs.description:
Riva is looking for a Motion and Visual Designer who loves turning ideas into videos people want to watch and is excited about what AI tools make possible. You’ll create everything from campaign and social videos to explainers and product demos, using AI to work faster and try more ideas.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

You’ll turn ideas and briefs into compelling videos, from writing scripts and developing storyboards to editing footage and adding the motion graphics that bring ideas to life. You’ll also contribute to broader creative projects and help shape how the Content and Creative team uses AI in video production.

This role suits someone who combines creative judgment with strong execution, takes ownership of their work, and is always experimenting with better ways to get things done.

More specifically, your responsibilities will include:

Write and Develop Video Content

  • Develop concepts, write original scripts, and create storyboards that connect the message, visuals, and intended audience.
  • Write strong hooks, clear narratives, natural dialogue or voiceover, and effective calls to action.
  • Translate complex topics into engaging content suited to the channel and intended runtime.
  • Plan videos such as product explainers and demos, day-in-the-life stories, interviews, campaign content, event highlights, and social videos.

Edit Video and Create Motion Graphics

  • Edit footage, audio, graphics, music, and captions into polished final videos.
  • Create 2D animation and motion graphics, including animated explainers, workflow and process flows, typography, diagrams, transitions, and branded graphics.
  • Bring scripts and storyboards to life through clear visual storytelling, timing, pacing, and movement.
  • Combine animation with recorded footage and screen recordings to explain products and ideas, including release demos recorded with the product team.
  • Prepare assets for animation and build reusable motion templates.
  • Adapt finished videos and animations for different channels, formats, and audiences.

Shape How We Use AI in Video

  • Use AI tools across the whole workflow, from concepts, scripts, and storyboards to animation, transcription, editing, and adapting content for new channels.
  • Evaluate and refine AI outputs for accuracy, originality, visual consistency, and brand alignment.
  • Test new AI tools as they emerge, share what works, and turn the best ideas into reusable templates and workflows for the team.
  • Follow company requirements for confidentiality, permissions, and responsible AI use.

Support the Creative Team

  • Help deliver campaign assets, presentation materials, social content, and other creative projects.
  • Adapt existing assets, complete revisions, and prepare files for different formats and channels.
  • Learn shared tools and processes so you can jump in on other creative projects when the team needs it.
  • Maintain organized source files, templates, and clear handoffs.

Own Your Delivery

  • Clarify briefs, identify missing information, and confirm expectations before production.
  • Manage multiple assignments and meet agreed deadlines.
  • Communicate progress and flag delivery risks early.
  • Apply feedback accurately and check your work before submitting it for review.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • A portfolio demonstrating video editing, motion graphics or animation, and scriptwriting.
  • The ability to take a video from brief through script, storyboard, production, and final delivery.
  • Proficiency in professional video editing and animation software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, or equivalent tools.
  • A good eye for motion, typography, composition, audio, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • The ability to animate UI elements, workflows, and diagrams from a storyboard (3D experience is not required).
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your video workflow, curiosity about what comes next, and sound judgment about when and how to use them.
  • A record of delivering quality work efficiently and managing revisions within agreed timelines.
  • Strong writing skills and the ability to make complex subjects clear and engaging.
  • Attention to detail, organized working habits, and clear communication.
  • A collaborative approach and the flexibility to contribute beyond video and animation.
  • Deep understanding of standard design software, including Figma.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience producing video at a B2B SaaS or technology company.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Strong creative work: Your videos and animations tell a clear story, engage the intended audience, and meet Riva’s brand and technical standards.
  • Effective scriptwriting: Your scripts are accurate, engaging, suited to the intended runtime, and ready for production with limited substantive rewriting.
  • Reliable delivery: You manage projects from brief through final review, meet agreed deadlines, provide realistic estimates, and flag risks early.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail: Your work meets the brief, incorporates feedback correctly, and requires few avoidable corrections.
  • AI in practice: You bring new AI tools and techniques to the team and use them, along with templates and reusable assets, to ship faster without losing quality.
  • Dependable team support: You provide reliable support on agreed creative tasks, communicate clearly, and maintain organized files and handoffs.

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

  • Communication: Ability to effectively convey information across all levels using verbal, non-verbal, written, and visual mediums while actively listening to ensure understanding.
  • Collaboration: Inspires and motivates others, embraces diverse perspectives, and works effectively in teams to achieve shared goals.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to make effective decisions by understanding key drivers of company success and applying knowledge to achieve business goals and positive outcomes.

  • Analytical Thinking & Decision Making: Ability to approach problems by relying on logic, data and facts. Uses the information available to effectively decide on an optimal path forward.
  • Managing Resources & Digital Dexterity: Combines adaptability to new technologies with effective utilization of time, budget, and talent to optimize outcomes and drive continuous improvement.
  • Organizational Alignment: Ability to direct focus and effort towards a goal set by the organization.

MORE ABOUT RIVA

We are an Edmonton-based software development company with a global footprint. Our Relationship Engine creates seamless data flow between applications like email, calendar, contacts, and tasks and CRM - synchronizing data and eliminating the need for task switching, application toggling, and data entry duplication across platforms.

We offer a work culture that fosters diversity, equity, inclusion, and fun. Where curiosity is rewarded, and each day offers the chance to learn, grow, and contribute to the efforts of people you like, respect, and value.

jobs.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in building web applications (frontend and backend) for the organization that trains much of the world's cybersecurity workforce. Security isn't a bolt-on here; it's the starting assumption, from OWASP-aware coding practices to solid authentication and authorization patterns. You'd work in a cross-functional, agile team, shipping well-tested code through CI/CD pipelines on AWS (Docker, ECS/Fargate, Lambda), and you'd own what you build in production with a true build-and-run, DevOps mindset. If you enjoy containerization, Kubernetes/orchestration, and automating the path from commit to production, you'll feel at home here: infrastructure and delivery pipelines are treated as part of the product, not someone else's problem. The stack is broad (Python, Node, PHP, REST APIs, React/TypeScript, SQL and NoSQL), so we value engineers who are comfortable moving across languages and projects and who enjoy peer reviews, good design discussions, and mentoring others toward architecturally sound solutions. We also value AI fluency: engineers who use AI tools thoughtfully to move faster and raise the quality bar, while still applying the judgment and security rigor that good software demands.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Developing software solutions as part of a cross-functional team· Participate in peer-reviews of solution designs and related code· Producing technical documentation as needed· Actively sharing responsibilities for meeting team commitments· Ability to coach/mentor other engineers, helping them devise and deliver solutions that are architecturally sound· Willingness to learn new technologies
  • Flexibility to move across language stacks and projects as required
  • Initiative to find ways to improve solutions, systems, and processes to solve problems
  • Willingness to work across the full web stack to develop efficient solutions
  • Operating with a DevOps mentality of build & run applications
  • Producing quality code with automated test coverage
  • Collaborate with other developers to plan, design, develop, and test components & applications
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong experience in creating, managing, versioning, and troubleshooting Rest API endpoints.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices (OOP, API’s, TDD)
  • Familiarity with standard branching and versioning via Git & Gitflow, and GitHub pull requests
  • Familiarity with secure coding practices, OWASP Top 10, and using authentication/authorization protocols
  • Experience with relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database technologies
  • Familiarity with the Atlassian suite of tools
  • Familiarity with ChatOps
  • Understanding of n-tier architecture and service-oriented architecture
  • Familiarity with DevOps, specifically CI/CD pipelines using AWS, Docker Containers, ECS/Fargate, and AWS Lambdas
  • Familiarity with monitoring/alerting software (New Relic, Site24/7, Pingdom, OpsGenie, or other)
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and other front-end technologies
  • Strong hands-on experience developing Web Applications using Python, Node, PHP or other modern web technologies.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • At least 6 years’ experience designing and developing modern web software

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $155,000-$170,000, plus bonus eligible, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

SANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.description:
Lifeforce is hiring a Controller to own accounting and cash management across the company. Your first focus will be our partnership with the Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC), a growing network of in-person franchise clinics across multiple states. You'll design and own how money moves between each ULC clinic's medical practice entity, its franchise entity, and Lifeforce, and you'll make sure every dollar is tracked, reconciled, and reported correctly.

This is a hands-on role. You'll use AI and automation tools to build and keep improving the workflows for reconciliations, cash transfers, month-end close, and executive reporting as the clinic network grows.

You'll start as an individual contributor and build out the finance team as the network grows. Over time, you'll become Controller for all of Lifeforce. You'll work closely with leadership, the ULC team and franchise owners, and our outside accountants.

Reports to: Co-Founder | President Joel Jackson

Cash Management & Fund Flows

  • Design and own a repeatable daily cash process between clinic practice entities, franchise entities, and Lifeforce, so each new clinic plugs in with minimal setup.
  • Open and manage bank accounts for new clinic entities as they launch.
  • Make sure cash is reconciled daily across every entity, by someone other than the person who moved it.
  • Track what each entity owes the others and settle intercompany balances on schedule.

Accounting & Close

  • Own the monthly close for Lifeforce and the clinic-related entities.
  • Prepare accurate financial statements and reporting for leadership.
  • Manage AP, AR, revenue recognition, and the general ledger.
  • Prepare franchisee statements and run true-up, reserve, and MSO fee calculations.
  • Track advances and startup loans to franchisees.
  • Account for state-specific fees as the network expands into new states.
  • Work closely with our outside accountants on bookkeeping, tax filings, and audits.

Automation & AI

  • Use AI tools like Claude to automate reconciliations, transfers, close tasks, and reporting.
  • Build workflows that scale with each new clinic, so the work doesn't grow one-for-one with the network.
  • Check automated outputs for accuracy and fix what breaks.

Controls & Process

  • Build the policies, controls, and documentation for the ULC multi-entity clinic model.
  • Set up dual approval on all transfers, and keep who moves money separate from who reconciles it.
  • Create a repeatable setup process for each new ULC clinic's accounts and fund flows.
  • Keep the books audit-ready.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work with leadership on cash position, reporting, and financial decisions.
  • Partner with ULC and franchise owners on reporting and payments.
  • Answer finance questions from operations, People, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: The cash process, controls, and reporting for the first ULC clinic are ready by its launch, including dual-approved transfers and daily reconciliation. The first monthly close for the clinic entities is done on time, and your core workflows are documented and partly automated.
  • First year: You're running the books for all of Lifeforce, and the monthly close happens on schedule. Each new clinic plugs into a standard, mostly automated setup for accounts, fund flows, and reporting, and you've laid out how the finance team grows with the network.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of accounting experience, including 3+ years as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Accounting Manager.
  • Hands-on experience running a monthly close and preparing financial statements yourself.
  • Multi-entity accounting experience, including intercompany transactions and consolidation.
  • Experience with MSO/PC structures or franchise accounting.
  • Strong cash management and bank reconciliation experience.
  • Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to automate or speed up accounting work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA.
  • Healthcare experience, ideally with both MSO/PC structures and franchise accounting.
  • Experience working alongside an outsourced accounting firm.
  • Experience at a startup or high-growth company.
  • Experience building a finance function from a team of one.

Traits for Success

  • Automates repetitive work first, and adds people where judgment is needed.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just reviewing it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Organized and process-minded, and builds systems that hold up as volume grows.
  • Explains financial questions clearly to people outside finance.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including healthcare, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for full-time employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

jobs.title: RCM Consultant (Solutions Consultant)
jobs.excerpt: About Collectly Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation.
jobs.description:
About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.

Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience, enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.

There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation because it delivers a clear, demonstrable ROI to our customers.

The Opportunity

We are hiring an RCM Consultant to join our sales team. This is a solutions consulting role built for someone who knows revenue cycle management from the inside. You will partner with our Account Executives from the first conversation, go deeper into a prospect's revenue cycle than anyone else on the deal, and turn what you find into demos and business cases that win.

Our buyers are large ambulatory provider groups. They want to work with someone who understands how their billing office runs, which EHR they are on, and where their money gets stuck. Your credibility in RCM is what earns their trust. Domain expertise matters more here than deep technical skills, but you need to be comfortable explaining how our platform connects to their EHR and how data moves between the two.

This is a highly collaborative role. Beyond the AEs and sales leadership, you will work with product, engineering, sales enablement, and our executive leadership team. You will be the voice of the customer inside Collectly and help shape how we sell, what we build, and how we tell our story.

Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management is required.

Key Responsibilties

  • Lead domain discovery: Pair with AEs early in the sales process to map a prospect's current revenue cycle workflows, from patient statements and payment collection to posting, follow-up, and reporting. Uncover the inefficiencies, manual work, and revenue leakage in those workflows, going deeper than a standard sales discovery can.

  • Deliver demos that land: Run tailored product demonstrations that reflect each prospect's specialty, EHR, and workflow. Customize demo environments and supporting assets so prospects see their own operation in the product. Improve the rate at which demos convert into later-stage opportunities.

  • Answer the integration and data questions: Explain how Collectly integrates with EHR and practice management systems, including athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Epic, ModMed, NextGen, Allscripts, Experity, and others. Speak clearly to where data lives, how it shows up in each system, what posts back, and how information flows between Collectly and the EHR. Partner with engineering and implementation on complex questions, and hand off clean requirements once a deal closes.

  • Build the business case: Own the technical side of our Financial Impact Analysis (FIA). Help prospects gather the financial and operational data we need, work with our internal AI agents to build the ROI calculation, and turn the results into a slide deck that gives executive buyers a clear business justification to buy.

  • Sharpen our storytelling: Use our assets and tools to build decks, demo flows, and visuals that make the value of Collectly easy to see. Bring an eye for detail to every slide and every demo.

  • Improve how we sell: Find and fix friction in our discovery, demo, and FIA processes, and execute those improvements alongside the AEs. Build reusable assets by specialty and EHR so the whole team gets faster.

  • Be the voice of the customer: Bring what you hear from prospects to product and engineering as clear, specific feedback. Partner with the VP of Sales and the executive leadership team on go-to-market strategy as we expand our product set and move into new markets.

  • Train the team: Partner with sales enablement to deliver training on RCM workflows, EHR integrations, demos, and the FIA process, so every seller can speak with more credibility.

What Success Looks Like

    Within the first 30 days, you will:

  • Learn the Collectly product suite end to end and deliver our core demo to sales leadership.

  • Learn our sales process, qualification methodology, and FIA process.

  • Shadow discovery calls, demos, and FIA presentations across the AE team.

  • Build working relationships with each AE you support and with sales leadership.

  • Meet your cross-functional partners in product, engineering, implementation, customer success, and enablement.

  • Learn how our integrations work with athenahealth and eClinicalWorks, and identify the specialties and EHRs where you need to fill gaps.

    • By 60 days, you will:

  • Run domain discovery and tailored demos independently with your AEs.

  • Build and present FIAs end to end, from data collection to the business case deck.

  • Answer integration and data flow questions for our most common EHRs without escalation.

  • Customize demo assets and decks for active opportunities.

    • By 90 days, you will:

  • Own domain discovery, demos, and FIAs across the pipeline of the AEs you support.

  • Deliver at least one improvement to our discovery, demo, or FIA process, such as a discovery guide, a demo library by specialty, or a faster FIA workflow.

  • Show measurable improvement in mid-funnel conversion, moving more demos into late-stage opportunities.

  • Lead or co-lead a training session with sales enablement.

    • Over two quarters, success includes:

  • Sustained improvement in demo-to-FIA and FIA-to-close conversion rates.

  • A growing library of reusable assets by specialty and EHR.

  • A regular flow of specific, prioritized customer feedback to product and engineering.

  • Recognition from AEs and prospects as a trusted advisor on revenue cycle.

  • Direct contribution to closed revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, preferably in a solutions consulting or similar pre-sales role. Experience can come from working in a practice or billing office, at an RCM company, or implementing RCM-related software.

  • Working knowledge of ambulatory EHR and practice management systems, with exposure to athenahealth or eClinicalWorks strongly preferred.

  • The ability to explain how healthcare data moves between systems, including where it lives, how it is mapped, and what posts back, to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong financial acumen and comfort building ROI analyses and business cases from operational and financial data.

  • Excellent presentation and demo skills, with the credibility to earn the trust of practice administrators, revenue cycle leaders, and financial executives.

  • A strong eye for detail and the ability to build clear, compelling slides and visual assets.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with sales teams and cross-functional partners.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with prospects and attend industry events.

Preferred

  • Prior experience in a solutions consulting, sales engineering, or other pre-sales role at a healthcare SaaS company.

  • Implementation experience at an EHR vendor or at a software company that integrates with EHRs.

  • Experience across multiple ambulatory specialties and EHRs, such as Epic, ModMed, NextGen, Allscripts, and Experity.

  • Familiarity with healthcare integration methods such as APIs, HL7, FHIR, and file-based data exchange.

  • Experience with patient payments or the patient financial experience.

  • Experience using AI tools to build analyses, decks, and demo assets.

  • Background in early-stage, venture-backed companies.

  • Bachelor's degree.

Core Competencies

  • Deep curiosity and a strong growth mindset. In a market with this many specialties and EHRs, there is always something new to learn.

  • A love of solving problems and the persistence to get to the root cause.

  • A will to win and a competitive drive to improve how we sell.

  • Credibility and people skills that build trust quickly with prospects.

  • Attention to detail in analysis, demos, and presentations.

  • High ownership and comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment.

Our GTM Values

    The right candidate will see themselves in how we work:

  • We are owners: we have high ownership and take action.

  • We is greater than me: we have humility and put the team first.

  • We know our numbers: we are data-driven and understand how to impact our business internally and our customers' business externally.

  • We are AI powered: we automate easy, repetitive tasks and research so we can solve harder problems and have a greater impact.

  • We are one with the Buffalo: we expect challenges along the way and, like the Buffalo, we confront them head on by running INTO the storm.

    • If you think you are a Buffalo who has what it takes to make a meaningful impact within our rapidly growing organization and the broader healthcare industry, apply to join our team today.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Unlimited PTO: We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to recharge when you need it.

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents, because your well-being matters to us.

  • Equity Opportunities: Share in our success with stock options. Your work will drive our growth.

  • Retirement Planning Made Easy: A 401(k) with a generous company match.

  • Student Loan Support: We help lighten the load with contributions toward your student loans.

  • Compensation: Competitive base + performance bonus + equity.
