jobs.title: Professional Services Resource - Workforce Manager
jobs.excerpt: Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.
jobs.description:
Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.
The Workforce Manager will design and deploy centralized resource management for every delivery function in Merge Professional Services, including project management, implementation, training, and integration. No formal intake, scheduling, or capacity process exists today; this role builds it from the ground up, then runs it, routing each engagement to the right delivery tier, assembling the cross-functional team that delivers it, and establishing the capacity and utilization view the organization staffs and hires against.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and deploy centralized resource scheduling across every delivery function, replacing today's informal, function-by-function staffing with a single point of entry for staffing requests, assignment changes, and backfills
  • Build the intake and routing process, defining the criteria that place each engagement in Enterprise Programs, Solutions Delivery, or Scaled Delivery based on complexity and risk rather than contract value or product line
  • Build the full project team for each engagement, sequencing PM, implementation, training, integration, and specialist resources against the project timeline
  • Establish the organization's first demand forecast from pipeline, backlog, and active timelines, surfacing capacity gaps by function before they put start dates at risk
  • Define utilization targets and measures, then manage against them by function and individual, rebalancing workload to prevent chronic over-allocation and unplanned bench time
  • Create baseline reporting on capacity, utilization, assignment lead time, and forecast accuracy for functional leaders
  • Partner with functional leaders, Sales, and Account Management to drive adoption of the new model, set realistic start dates, and resolve competing demands for the same resources
  • Make and defend assignment calls when priorities conflict, escalating trade-offs to the Director with a recommendation and supporting data
  • Serve as business owner of the PSA platform (Salesforce / TaskRay) for resource management, defining requirements, configuration, and the data standards the model depends on
  • Build the first skills and certification inventory across the delivery workforce so assignments match capability and development gaps are visible
  • Document the intake, routing, and scheduling process, enable delivery staff and managers to work within it, and refine it as the organization scales

Core Competencies:

  • Builds structure where none exists, creating process, standards, and data from a blank page
  • Makes timely staffing decisions with incomplete information, weighing customer commitment, workload, and cost
  • Thinks in pipelines and timelines, spotting capacity conflicts weeks before they land
  • Judges complexity, effort, and skill fit accurately across PM, implementation, training, and integration work
  • Treats scheduling data as the source of truth and holds others to the same standard
  • Drives adoption of new process through influence, without direct authority over the people being scheduled
  • Explains assignment decisions transparently, building trust with delivery staff and functional leaders
  • Holds the line on intake and scheduling process under pressure from customers, Sales, and internal stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years in resource management, workforce management, or PMO operations within a professional services or implementation organization
  • Demonstrated experience building or maturing a centralized resource management function for a multi-functional delivery team, not only operating an existing one
  • Advanced proficiency in at least one PSA platform (e.g., Salesforce-based PSA, Certinia, Kantata, ServiceNow SPM, OpenAir), including resource management, forecasting, and time tracking
  • Experience with capacity planning, utilization management, and demand forecasting
  • Strong reporting skills in Excel and dashboard tools (e.g., Salesforce reports, Tableau, Power BI)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and PSA tools, including resource management configuration
  • Background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation, ideally medical imaging
  • Experience leading change management for a new operating model inside a professional services organization
  • Familiarity with skills matrices and competency-based assignment
  • PMP, CAPM, or resource management certification

Compensation

The salary range provided in this job posting is intended to reflect the general market value for the position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific requirements of the role. This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. For base-salary + commission sales roles, the range represents On-Target Earnings.

$94,760.00 - $142,140.00 (USD)

Benefits

The benefits described represent the current offerings at our organization, however, benefits are subject to change and may vary by location and employment status. We strive to provide a comprehensive benefits package that supports our employees’ health, wellness, and financial goals. Please note that benefits may be discussed in more detail during the hiring process.

  • Remote first / work from home culture

  • Flexible vacation to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

  • Paid leave benefits

Description

About Upwind

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agent less cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.

About The Role

Upwind is looking for a Solutions Architecture Manager to lead our Rocky Mountains Architects. This is a player-coach role: you'll lead, hire, and develop a team of SAs while staying hands-on in strategic customer engagements. You'll own the technical win on key deals, act as the escalation point for complex evaluations, and partner with Sales, Product, and Marketing to help customers secure their cloud environments with Upwind.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Solutions Architects

• Hire and onboard new SAs and build a repeatable ramp plan

• Own the technical strategy on strategic and enterprise opportunities

• Design and run POVs with clear success criteria and executive readouts

• Serve as the escalation point for complex technical evaluations

• Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline, deal strategy, and technical-win forecasting

• Share field feedback and competitive insights with Product

• Support Marketing with events, webinars, and technical content

• Drive process improvements and enablement across the SA team

Requirements

• Cloud security depth (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containers)

• Coaching and developing SAs

• Deal strategy and POV execution

• Executive communication and presence

• Cross-functional influence (Sales, Product, Marketing)

• Hiring and building teams

• 7+ years in pre-sales / solutions engineering, including 2+ years leading or mentoring SAs

• Deep hands-on experience with cloud security (CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, vulnerability management, or runtime security)

  • Cloud Security Technical Depth + Executive Engagement: Hands-on experience with cloud computing, cybersecurity principles, and industry best practices.
  • Multi-Segment GTM Experience: Demonstrated success adapting technical approaches across customer segments.

• Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus Kubernetes and containers

• Track record of winning complex enterprise deals

• Excellent executive communication and presentation skills

• Experience at a high-growth security or SaaS company

• Based in the Rocky Mountains

jobs.title: In-House CRA ( Australia)
jobs.excerpt: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases.
jobs.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The In-House Clinical Research Associate (IHCRA) supports clinical site monitoring and management activities for clinical studies, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.

Acting as a key point of contact for investigative sites and internal project teams, the IHCRA plays an important role in supporting site performance, patient recruitment, data quality and study delivery. This role focuses primarily on remote site management, data review, query resolution and essential document collection, while working closely with field CRAs and Clinical Operations Leads (COLs) to ensure studies are conducted efficiently and in accordance with project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary in-house point of contact for assigned investigative sites, managing day-to-day communications, documenting site contacts and following up on outstanding actions and issues.

  • Support remote site management activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, visit schedules, data entry timelines and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Perform remote data review and analysis using EDC systems and site performance indicators to identify trends, potential protocol deviations and issues affecting participant safety or data integrity.

  • Review Case Report Forms (CRFs), generate and follow up on data queries, and support timely query resolution in accordance with study guidelines and monitoring plans.

  • Assist with the collection, review and maintenance of essential study documentation within the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF), ensuring inspection readiness.

  • Collaborate with field CRAs to prepare for site visits, review documentation, follow up on outstanding queries and action items, and support site performance improvement plans.

  • Coordinate study-related activities, including clinical trial supplies, laboratory kits, study medication, system access and documentation updates.

  • Support site identification, investigator recruitment, site start-up activities and patient recruitment, including guidance on study inclusion and exclusion criteria.

  • Conduct remote site visits, including qualification, initiation, interim and close-out visits, as required by the monitoring plan, and provide support to CRAs and COLs through study meetings, training and occasional onsite co-monitoring.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline required; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

  • 1–3 years of relevant clinical research experience required; 4–6 years of related experience preferred.

  • Background in Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a Clinical Research specialty is preferred. RPN certification/designation is also considered an asset.

  • Understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle and site management processes, from study start-up through close-out.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Engineer, LeadConduit Company Overview ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer, LeadConduit

Company Overview

ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition. We provide marketers the products they need to acquire qualified customers at scale. Our platform is trusted by thousands of companies engaged in direct-to-consumer marketing, helping them save wasted spend, comply with ever-changing regulations, and manage a constantly evolving partner landscape.

Our flagship product, TrustedForm, is used to certify over 1 billion opt-in digital customer leads every year and is the gold standard for documenting prior express written consent for TCPA compliance. LeadConduit, our real-time lead processing and routing platform, connects lead sellers and buyers and checks consent, data quality, and delivery rules on every lead.

Job Summary

You own customer and business outcomes, not tickets. You work like a forward-deployed engineer: you belong to the LeadConduit team, and you contribute to projects, initiatives, and pods where the problem is, deliver your work across the full stack (Vue/Nuxt and React/Next.js on the frontend, Node.js and TypeScript services on AWS), and improve processes for delivery in future projects. The technical bar is high, but coding ability is only the starting point. What sets this role apart is judgment: knowing the smallest thing worth shipping, when to drop your own idea, and when AI output is good enough versus when to override it. On LeadConduit, that work splits evenly between two areas: keeping today's platform fast and reliable for the customers who run their business on it, and building the next-generation platform, including a new real-time engine for ping/post, call tracking, and buyer optimization.

You'll move between the LeadConduit team and the initiatives you deploy into, shipping early, talking to customers, and deciding fast.

Responsibilities

  • Own outcomes end-to-end, wherever you're assigned. Frame the problem, design it, ship it, own the metric. Distill to the cheapest version that works. Prototype in days.
  • Work across today's LeadConduit and the next-generation platform. Improve the current product (flows, integrations, reporting) and help build the new real-time engine (field mapping, ping/post, call tracking, buyer optimization).
  • Stay close to customers. Shadow sales and support, talk with lead buyers and sellers, join advisory conversations, and let customer reality drive technical decisions. Propose what to build, defer, and drop.
  • Own your domain and share it. Its interfaces, reliability, performance, and security, including on-call for the systems you own. Consent, TCPA compliance, and PII handling are central to customer trust. Bring patterns, tooling, and hard-won context back to the wider org rather than hoarding them.
  • Build and scale both the product surface and the platform beneath it. Ship responsive, accessible interfaces with a strong UI/UX eye (Vue/Nuxt today, React/Next.js for the new platform), back them with Node.js and TypeScript services and APIs, and keep the real-time, multi-tenant lead and call processing engine reliable and fast as volume grows.
  • Architect AI-driven leverage. Build AI-assisted workflows that hold up, evolve the team's practices as tooling changes (Cursor, Claude Code, and whatever comes next), and look for product wins AI unlocks (smarter routing, anomaly detection on lead flow, AI-built integrations, and more).
  • Make every team you work with stronger. Mentor on judgment and product sense, not just syntax. Write decision memos and ADRs. Enable Product and Design to self-serve.

Qualifications and Skills

  • A track record of shipping something end-to-end that you cared about and owning the outcome, not just the code.
  • Product judgment: pushing back on a bad spec, proposing the cheapest experiment, descoping, and collaborating with Product to suggest solutions rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket.
  • Comfort embedding with unfamiliar teams and codebases, getting productive fast, and leaving them better than you found them.
  • Deep full-stack expertise: React/Next.js and Vue/Nuxt (component lifecycle, state management, rendering optimization), JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern CSS on the frontend; Node.js and TypeScript services, RESTful APIs, and low-latency, high-volume asynchronous data handling on the backend.
  • Cloud and real-time systems depth: AWS core services (Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway) and event-driven, queue-based processing (SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar) to deliver multi-tenant, real-time products reliably at scale.
  • A strong UI/UX eye: you turn wireframes, mockups, and ambiguous requirements into intuitive, accessible, user-centric journeys.
  • Strong systems design judgment in ambiguous contexts, and a security mindset aligned with sensitive consumer data and compliance.
  • Lead generation or performance marketing experience is a strong plus: ping/post, lead routing and distribution, call tracking, or TCPA and consent rules.
  • Fluency building your own AI-assisted workflows and reading AI output critically. Daily use of AI-native tools (Cursor, Claude Code) and precise prompting across OpenAI and Claude models, with the judgment to know when to trust output, how to review it for hidden bugs and security issues, and when to override it.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. Mentorship experience. 5-10% travel.

How It Works

You'll report to an Engineering Manager who owns several teams and stays out of their daily flow. As you embed, you'll often act as the player-coach Tech Lead, owning technical direction while the EM owns delivery health and stakeholder alignment across the group.

Success looks like movement in a user or business metric your team owns, high-value work deliberately not built, decisions made fast, and teams that move faster after you've worked with them, not just while you're there.

Reports To

Engineering Manager

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Strategist
jobs.excerpt: About demandDrive demandDrive is a growth-focused go-to-market agency that helps B2B organizations accelerate pipeline and revenue through integrated sales, marketing, and revenue operations solutions.
jobs.description:
About demandDrive

demandDrive is a growth-focused go-to-market agency that helps B2B organizations accelerate pipeline and revenue through integrated sales, marketing, and revenue operations solutions. We partner with companies ranging from emerging businesses to enterprise brands to design and execute customized programs that align strategy, technology, and execution across the full customer journey. Our services include sales development, demand generation, digital marketing, website development, CRM optimization, and GTM systems support - all built to deliver measurable business outcomes. At our core, we combine smart technology, data-driven processes, and talented people to help clients grow faster and operate more efficiently.

Position Overview

As a Senior Demand Generation Strategist, you own a book of 6-8 B2B client accounts, including some of our largest, and you own whether marketing works on them.

You set the strategy, direct execution across paid media, SEO, content and CRO, and you are the one in the room with the people who hold the budget. You run the quarterly business reviews with client executives yourself - what the program produced, what it cost, what we are doing next.

Most of these accounts have a heavy paid media component, so you need real depth there - you will be in LinkedIn, Google Ads and Meta yourself. But the job is wider than the ad platforms. You design the full demand motion for an account: capture, creation, nurture, retargeting, intent-led targeting, and the way all of it connects to the SDR team and to pipeline in the client's CRM.

You also set the automation standard for the team. We expect the manual half of this job - pulling data, drafting reports, building variants, researching accounts, QA - to keep shrinking, and at this level you are the person building the workflows that shrink it and getting everyone else using them.

You partner with a Client Success Manager who owns the client relationship and contract, and you are supported by specialists in analytics/CRO and SEO. You report to the Senior Director of Demand Generation.

Who We Are Looking For

You are the person who sees a client report opening with impressions and CTR and thinks: that does not answer anything. You rewrite it to lead with pipeline, cost per qualified lead and what we should do next, because that is the only version a VP of Marketing can actually act on.

You are also the person who, having rewritten that report once, does not want to rewrite it by hand twelve more times. You go build something that drafts it - and then you get four other people using it. That instinct matters to us as much as the strategy does. The best strategists we have keep taking the repetitive half of the job and handing it to a machine, then spend the hours they bought back on the client.

Communication is the other half, and at this level it is the differentiator. You can explain a complicated program to a CMO in plain language, make a recommendation, and hold it when someone pushes back. You bring strategy to a client before they ask for it. You have told a client their targeting was wrong, or their offer was the problem, and made the case with data rather than opinion. You are comfortable being the most senior marketing voice on a call and you do not need to check with anyone before answering a hard question.

No two accounts look the same. One week you are rebuilding a medical device company's paid program around a new buying committee, the next you are figuring out why a manufacturer's content is ranking and converting nobody. You will own those accounts end to end, with a CSM beside you and specialists behind you, and you will be measured on what happens to the book - retained, grown, healthy.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Your book of accounts, end to end. Strategy, plans, budgets and results across paid, SEO, content and CRO for every account you own, including some of our largest. No channel hand-offs. If it is marketing on your account, it is yours.
  • Modern demand generation programs. Designing the full motion for an account - demand capture, demand creation, nurture, retargeting, intent-led targeting - not just the campaigns inside one platform.
  • Automating the execution layer, for the team. Building AI-assisted workflows for the repetitive parts of the job: reporting drafts, search term and negative keyword review, ad copy variants, account and persona research, QA. Proving they work, documenting them, and getting the rest of the team using them.
  • Paid media, hands-on. Building, running and optimizing LinkedIn, Google Ads and Meta programs, including B2B targeting by account list, firmographics and buying committee.
  • Reporting on business impact. Monthly and quarterly client reporting built around pipeline, revenue, cost per qualified lead and ROI, always ending with a clear recommendation. Platform metrics are evidence, not the headline.
  • Executive-level client communication. Leading client calls and running quarterly business reviews with client executives and their sales leadership. Clients should hear from you before they have to ask.
  • The connection to pipeline. Making marketing programs and SDR outreach work together, and tracing spend through to meetings, opportunities and closed revenue in the client's CRM.
  • Measurement. Working with our analytics/CRO specialist on attribution, GA4 and GTM so the numbers you report hold up.
  • Account growth. Spotting upsell and expansion opportunities and building the case with your CSM.
  • Raising the bar. Mentoring strategists earlier in their careers, reviewing their programs and reporting, and setting the standard the rest of the team works to.

Required Qualifications

AI and Automation (non-negotiable). You use AI in your daily work, not as a novelty. You have built workflows that replaced manual work you used to do by hand, and you have gotten other people to adopt them - that second part matters at this level. You keep up with what is new and bring it into client work before anyone asks. Comfort with Claude or other leading models wired into real workflows, not just prompted in a chat window. Experience with automation tools (Zapier, n8n, Clay) is a strong plus. We are not looking for someone who needs to be taught this.

Communication and executive presence. You can run a QBR with a CMO and a VP of Sales in the room, present a recommendation, and hold it under pushback. Responsive, confident on camera, and you own follow-through rather than waiting to be chased.

Demand generation depth.

  • 6+ years in B2B demand generation or paid media, with at least 3 years at an agency or owning client accounts directly. Agency pace is a real requirement.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads and Meta, including B2B targeting by account list, firmographics and buying committee.
  • Fluency in demand generation well beyond the ad platforms: nurture, retargeting, intent signals, content and SEO working together on one account.
  • Strong working knowledge of HubSpot, attribution, GA4 and GTM, including where attribution breaks and how to talk about it honestly.
  • A track record of connecting marketing to sales and SDR pipeline, and reporting on pipeline, revenue, cost per qualified lead and ROI.
  • Experience growing accounts: you have spotted expansion opportunities and helped close them.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ABM platforms, Clay or Apollo.
  • Medical device or manufacturing marketing experience.
  • HubSpot certifications.

How We Work

  • Ownership model. Strategists own a book of accounts across every channel. There are no channel splits. You are paired with a Client Success Manager who owns the relationship and contract, and supported by specialists in analytics/CRO and SEO.
  • Measured on outcomes. Strategists are measured on their book's MRR retained, growth, and a monthly marketing health rating set alongside the CSM.
  • AI-first, and we mean it. Every strategist is expected to automate part of their own job and share it. We make time for it, we budget for the tools, and at the senior level what you build becomes how the team works.

Benefits Include

  • Hybrid or remote work model, depending on proximity to HQ in Waltham, MA (must reside in the U.S.)
  • Annual salary range: $105,000 - $120,000
  • Health coverage and other health & wellness benefits via BCBS, vision care, dental coverage (Delta Dental), paid maternity & paternity leave, life & disability insurance, 401(k) matching.
  • Paid time off and 14 paid holidays.
  • Internal growth opportunities.
  • Positive team culture.
  • Company laptop, full tech stack, tools, and other resources provided by demandDrive

jobs.excerpt: About Hello Heart: Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.
jobs.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the roleHello Heart’s AI team builds Nia, an AI health assistant for people managing their cardiovascular health. As a Clinical AI Quality Specialist, you will evaluate and monitor Nia’s clinical behavior before and after release, working alongside the Clinical AI Quality & Governance Team Lead. You will run evaluations, review production conversations, and turn findings into documented decisions with product and engineering. This is a hands-on role for a clinician who is comfortable working with AI tools.

Responsibilities

  • Run Nia’s offline evaluations for clinically relevant changes. Write test cases, including tricky and ambiguous ones, and score outputs against the expected clinical behavior. Build and maintain evaluation datasets and contribute to scoring methods
  • Review production conversations using defined sampling methods. Take part in the weekly review and help prepare monthly results that state what was and wasn’t covered.
  • Test whether Nia detects and correctly handles high-risk situations, including medical emergencies, self-harm, and medication safety. Measure how often it escalates too much or too little.
  • Describe each failure clearly enough for engineering to act on, and flag your best read of the cause (for example, a wrong answer, missing patient context, or an escalation that fired too late). Make sure each unsafe or incorrect finding has an owner, a ticket, and a decision.
  • Keep clinical specifications, review records, and evidence current and auditable. Write clear, precise clinical assessments that engineering and product can act on.

Qualifications:

  • PharmD (or equivalent clinical doctorate) with an active US license. 3+ years of combined clinical practice and clinical AI evaluation.
  • Questions assumptions and investigates before drawing conclusions. Reads current guidelines, drug labels, and primary sources, and cites them in written assessments. Uses AI tools to work faster, and verifies AI output against sources before relying on it.
  • Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM-based systems, reviewing production conversations, and using monitoring tools (e.g., Langfuse).
  • Command of triage and escalation, crisis and self-harm handling, and medication safety, grounded in current guidelines.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools and evaluation workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Explains clinical risk clearly to engineering and product audiences, writes precise clinical assessments and documentation, and accepts feedback without defensiveness.
  • Genuine passion for how AI can improve preventive care and chronic disease management. Curious, open to learning, and comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-moving field.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Clinical experience in cardiovascular care or hypertension management.
  • Experience with structured rating of clinical transcripts, including agreement between raters.
  • Experience reviewing crisis and self-harm behavior.
  • Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM-based systems, or using monitoring tools such as Langfuse.

Individual compensation is based on job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in United States job postings reflect annual salary and bonus only and do not include equity or benefits.

An overview of this role

As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.

What you'll do

  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.
  • Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.
  • Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
  • Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.
  • Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.
  • Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.
  • Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.
  • Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.
  • Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.
  • Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.
  • Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.

We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.

About the team

CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.

jobs.description:
Marketing and Communications Manager

Location: Remote, US Based, EST

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role, not a marketing strategy role. We are looking for someone with approximately four years of marketing experience who wants to roll up their sleeves and do the work: write the content, build the campaign, update the website, manage the calendar, chase the follow-ups, coordinate the event, and keep things moving. If you have spent 10 or 20 years leading marketing strategy and teams, this is not the role we are hiring for.

Over the past year, Underscore has built the foundation for a stronger marketing and new business engine, including a refreshed brand and positioning, a redesigned website, a defined ideal client profile, HubSpot infrastructure, an earned media program, and a growing portfolio of events designed to connect us with leaders across biopharma.

Now we’re looking for a Marketing and Communications Manager who can execute on that foundation, consistently.

This is an execution role. The Marketing and Communications Manager will own the day-to-day work of Underscore’s marketing: content for prospect outreach, case studies, our quarterly Rare Company newsletter, website and sales collateral updates, lead follow-up, events, and PR support. You will work closely with our leadership, subject matter experts, Sales Enablement, and our PR agency to make sure great ideas become great content and, ultimately, business opportunities.

You will also help execute our events. This includes our Rare Company Dinner series, which will be held at least four times in 2027. You will work on invitations, follow-ups, and venue management, and help make sure we deliver a valuable experience for senior leaders in biopharma. You will support internal efforts as well, such as our Town Hall and Gratitude events.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable keeping a content calendar on track, interviewing a media expert for a case study, working with Sales Enablement on a HubSpot campaign, and supporting an industry event.

What You’ll Do

Content

  • Create content at scale for prospect outreach. It has to be highly relevant to biopharma leaders and build on Underscore’s recognition and reputation.
  • Own and execute Underscore’s editorial calendar across the website, LinkedIn, email, and other marketing channels.
  • Own the quarterly Rare Company newsletter, an opt-in publication that gives prospects, and potentially clients, new news and new perspectives relevant to biopharma. Underscore’s subject matter experts are the source of the information.
  • Reuse everything. Take the expertise that already exists across Underscore (an award, a partner meeting, a conference takeaway, a dinner theme) and turn each one into a LinkedIn post, a newsletter item, a web update, and a line in the deck.
  • Maintain Underscore’s voice across everything we publish.

Case Studies

  • Publish case studies and maintain a strong library of them, with a goal of approximately two new case studies per quarter.
  • Partner with account leads, media teams, analytics, and other subject matter experts to identify compelling stories and results.
  • Own the case study process from beginning to end, including interviews, results gathering, writing, internal review, client approval, publishing, and inclusion in the sales library.
  • Work within client confidentiality requirements to develop compelling blinded case studies.

Website and Sales Collateral

  • Keep the Underscore website current on a monthly cycle: new team members, company news, articles, events, and awards.
  • Keep our capabilities decks, credentials, team bios, case studies, RFP content, and other sales materials current and easy to access.

Lead Follow-Up and Sales Enablement

  • Make sure every lead gets a follow-up within 48 hours, whether it comes from a conference, an event, a campaign, the website, or a Rare Company Dinner. Your job is to make lead routing and follow-up a standing process with clear owners.
  • Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to Sales Enablement on the coordination and execution of prospect management in HubSpot.
  • Supply the content for tailored communications to different prospect audiences. This will be structured by audience so we can test and learn what works, and what doesn’t.

Events, PR and Awards

  • Help execute Underscore’s events, including the Rare Company Dinner series and major industry moments such as Fierce Pharma Week.
  • Support internal efforts such as Town Hall and Gratitude.
  • Serve as the execution partner to our PR agency, providing the company information, executive bios, subject matter expertise, quotes, images, and approvals needed to support earned media.
  • Own the annual marketing calendar (events, awards, etc) and coordinate awaard submissions from initial opportunity through final deadline.

Planning

  • Maintain the master marketing and new business calendar that our CEO and executive leadership team work from.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 4 years marketing experience
  • Excellent writing and storytelling. You write clear, jargon-free content that is engaging, from LinkedIn posts to case studies. You can interview a subject matter expert and turn the conversation into something a senior biopharma marketer would want to read.
  • Some familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.
  • Working knowledge of PowerPoint.
  • 1 to 2 years of event experience.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to keep a calendar and several projects moving at once.

Preferred

  • Three years b2b experience for healthcare, pharma, or a healthcare agency.
  • Agency-side experience, ideally in media or digital, so you can talk with the people who build media plans.
  • Exposure to rare disease, oncology, or specialty pharma.
  • Enough design literacy to make a one-pager in a template, and to know when you need a designer.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, success in this role will mean:

  • Underscore has a consistent editorial calendar that is being executed across channels.
  • The Rare Company newsletter goes out every quarter and has become a recognizable and valuable read for our target audience.
  • New case studies are being developed and added to our credentials library each quarter.
  • Every lead from events, campaigns, and the website has a clear owner and a follow-up within 48 hours.
  • The website and sales materials are updated monthly rather than reactively.
  • Strong ideas and insights from across Underscore are consistently turned into useful, market-facing content, and reused across channels.
  • Our CEO and executive leadership team work from one current marketing and new business calendar.

Who Will Thrive Here

You’re a doer.

You like taking something from idea to finished product. You know how to pull a good story out of people who may not think of themselves as storytellers. You care about the quality of the writing, but you also care whether someone opened it, responded to it, or wanted to have a conversation because of it.

You’re comfortable working in an environment where there are plenty of ideas and opportunities, and part of your value is bringing the structure, discipline, and follow-through that turns those ideas into a real marketing program.

At Underscore, you’ll have access to deep expertise across media, analytics, strategy, and healthcare. Your job is to help make sure the market sees it

Interested?
Apply by submitting your resume and a brief note outlining your healthcare or media experience.

 Underscore Marketing is a woman-owned, independent agency specializing in life sciences. Since 2002, we've helped clients gain a competitive edge through bold, data-driven promotional strategies that deliver measurable results.  

Our team comprises media, strategy, and omnichannel analytics experts who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and results. When you join Underscore, you become part of a dynamic environment where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work helps elevate brands in a competitive healthcare landscape.  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a team that values integrity, creativity, and results, if that sounds like you, we invite you to share.  

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement 
Underscore is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

Job Responsibilities

Syneos Health is recruiting a Talent Acquisition in Germany from a fixed term contract for 12 months - Start date January 2027

You will partner closely with Hiring Managers to manage the recruiting process from end-to-end, developing strategies and implementing

recruiting process, identifying and sharing recruitment best practices across the business and industry, maintaining current market knowledge, legal and recruitment trends, and developing sourcing methodologies and strategies to target and identify qualified candidates.

The successful candidate will be passionate about Syneos Health’s mission and culture, thrive in a fast paced environment, be proactive, resourceful and efficient. This person must be well organized, flexible, and enjoy the challenges of supporting a growing company.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines

jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

  • No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking
  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)
  • Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation
  • Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)
  • Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)
  • LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

In-House Counsel, Securities & Generalist

About the role

Pacaso is hiring an In-House Counsel to lead our SEC reporting and securities compliance, and to be a trusted generalist partner across the business. You will own the legal side of our periodic filings and disclosure process. You will also support the business on a wide range of other legal matters as they come up.

Roughly half your time will go to securities and governance. The other half will be whatever the business needs, from commercial agreements and real estate to employment, marketing and privacy.

This role suits a lawyer with 3 to 5+ years of law firm or in-house experience in securities or capital markets work who now wants breadth, direct business impact and a seat close to decision-makers. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations and executive leadership.

What you'll do

SEC reporting and securities

  • Own the preparation and review of the company's SEC filings, including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and offering materials.
  • Lead the disclosure process with Finance and Accounting.
  • Advise on securities law compliance, including offerings, equity issuances and insider trading.
  • Stay current on SEC rules and guidance, and update policies and processes as needed.

Public company governance and compliance

  • Serve as a primary legal advisor on the company's obligations as an SEC reporting company.
  • Support the board and its committees, including meeting materials, minutes and written consents.
  • Maintain governance documents and company policies.
  • Partner with Finance on disclosure controls and related processes.
  • Maintain entity records and good standing across subsidiaries.

Business and general legal support

You will be a true generalist and a day-to-day legal partner to teams across the company, from the front line to the executive team. We need someone who is excited by variety, comfortable learning new areas quickly, and ready to build legal processes as the company grows.

  • Draft, negotiate and manage agreements, including vendor, partnership, technology and services contracts.
  • Support real estate and property-related matters, including entity structuring, transactions and state-by-state regulatory questions.
  • Partner with People on employment matters such as policies, offer and separation agreements, leave and accommodation questions, and wage-and-hour compliance.
  • Advise Marketing and Sales on advertising, promotions, disclosures and licensing requirements.
  • Support privacy and data protection, including policies, vendor data processing agreements and responses to individual requests.
  • Help manage intellectual property, including trademarks, brand protection and software licensing.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, disputes and regulatory inquiries, and manage their budgets and scope.
  • Build scalable legal processes, such as contract templates, intake and approval workflows and playbooks, so the business can move faster with fewer one-off requests.

What you bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.
  • 3 to 5+ years of experience at a well-regarded law firm or in-house legal team, with substantial securities or capital markets work.
  • Hands-on experience drafting or reviewing SEC periodic reports and disclosure documents.
  • Working knowledge of federal securities laws and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, at a law firm or in-house.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar areas of law quickly, and to recognize when to escalate or engage outside counsel.
  • Sound judgment, clear writing, and the ability to explain legal risk in plain terms to non-lawyers.
  • Comfort managing many matters at once with limited supervision.

Preferred

  • In-house or secondment experience at a startup or high-growth company.
  • Exposure to real estate, employment, privacy or intellectual property matters.
  • Experience building templates, playbooks or legal operations processes.
  • Comfort working with non-legal teams as a day-to-day business partner.

Compensation

  • Around $190,000- we will consider experience and location as variables
  • RSU grant

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

  • Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building
  • Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare
  • 401(k) to help you build long-term security
  • Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers
  • Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work
  • Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

Are you looking to make an impact and be part of shaping the future of healthcare?

At Semble, we’re looking for an Implementation Manager who can take end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of concurrent customer implementations, including complex, multi-stakeholder projects. You’ll bring structure, sound judgement and a proactive approach to deliver projects through to successful go-live and handover. You will work with a high degree of autonomy, while maintaining clear communication with the Implementation Lead on progress, risks, priorities and decisions.

About Semble

Semble is on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people with a best-in-class cloud-based clinical system that is trusted by thousands of clinicians, empowering them to provide better care, streamline operations, and save costs:

  • 8 million patients in the UK have been treated by clinicians using Semble.
  • We’re the market leader in private primary care and the fastest-growing practice management software in the UK.
  • On the back of our recent Series B funding from Mercia Ventures, Octopus Ventures, Triple Point, and Smedvig Ventures, we’re poised to further accelerate our growth trajectory.

At Semble, our team is proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact – We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

Location

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you’ll be doing

Reporting to our Implementation Lead, you will own the full project lifecycle for major customer implementations, planning, governance, execution, and handover, working closely with the Implementation Associates, Customer Success, Sales, Migrations, Technical Solutions and Product teams.

You will:

Own end-to-end delivery

  • Take accountability for delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, from discovery and workflow mapping through configuration, testing, training, go-live and handover.
  • Own delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, proactively driving actions to completion and remaining accountable for delivery quality, including work delegated to others.

Be the trusted client contact

  • Lead relationships with senior clinical, operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Build confidence through clear recommendations, reliable follow-through and a thorough understanding of the client’s workflows, constructively challenging assumptions and requests where needed to support successful delivery.

Shape and deliver the client solution

  • Lead discovery and workflow mapping, translating client requirements into agreed workflow and configuration decisions.
  • Develop strong Semble product expertise and be responsible for configuration, troubleshooting, testing and training, drawing on specialist support where needed.
  • Design training and rollout approaches appropriate to the client’s size, complexity and readiness, including train-the-trainer approaches for larger organisations.

Collaborate cross-functionally

  • Work effectively across CS, Product, Sales, Support, and Migrations teams.
  • Build strong internal relationships and proactively share knowledge.
  • Share knowledge proactively, contribute to team documentation and best practices, and help create an environment where the whole team learns and improves together.

Drive continuous improvement

  • Identify process inefficiencies, contribute to documentation and refinement, and share lessons learnt to improve team practices.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager delivering customer-facing software implementations (ideally in a start-up, healthcare SaaS or another regulated domain).
  • Strong project management fundamentals: scope, schedule, budget, quality, RAID, change control, governance, and stakeholder management.
  • Track record of leading cross-functional teams to outcomes in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex implementations, combining independent decision-making with proactive reporting, collaboration and timely escalation.
  • A proven track record of successfully managing multiple customer implementations simultaneously, with examples of balancing competing deadlines, managing dependencies and maintaining delivery quality.
  • Understanding of change management principles and experience supporting clients through adoption challenges.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare workflows and practice management operations (or strong appetite to develop this quickly).
  • Experience mentoring project or implementation colleagues, helping them develop their delivery skills and judgement.
  • Deep product knowledge mindset, comfortable troubleshooting independently and advising clients on best-practice workflows.
  • Tools: confident with common project management and collaboration tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence, Asana or MS Project, or equivalents).

How we’ll measure success

  • On-time, on-scope delivery for strategic implementations.
  • Time-to-value and adoption targets met post go-live.
  • Quality and timeliness of project documentation.
  • Customer CSAT/NPS and stakeholder feedback.
  • Reduction in post-go-live defects and rework.
  • Clear, consistent reporting to leadership, internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Reliable delivery across the assigned portfolio.

What you’ll get in return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!
  • Up to £75k package (based on your experience and the value you can bring).
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays + bank holidays + 3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) – that we will expect you to take so you can recharge and rest.

Who You Are

You thrive on independence. You write clearly, set your own priorities, and ship without someone checking in. You'd rather see your work show up in the signup numbers than in a slide deck.

  • 3–6 years in B2B SaaS growth, ideally in data, analytics or martech, with real numbers to show for it.

  • Data & martech fluency: You know how GA4, Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, BigQuery, Looker Studio and Power BI fit together, and what ETL, connectors and attribution mean. You can read a product doc about API integrations, data pipelines or dashboards and turn it into content a marketer or analyst actually wants to read.

  • SEO and content as core skills: Hands-on keyword research, on-page and programmatic SEO, and content-led organic growth.

  • Self-serve SaaS experience: Free-to-paid conversion, onboarding and lifecycle marketing for low-cost, product-led products not enterprise ABM.

  • Analytical self-sufficiency: You build your own dashboards and don't wait for an analyst to tell you what worked.

  • Async, remote execution and excellent written English (our core markets are the US and Europe).

Bonus Points:

  • Paid acquisition on Google and LinkedIn at modest budgets.

  • Video/YouTube tutorials, or working with affiliates and creators (our creator network earns a 30% lifetime revenue share).

  • Basic SQL, or a background as a marketing analyst or at an agency.

  • Partner co-marketing with BI and data-warehouse vendors.

  • Experience marketing to the audiences of tools like Supermetrics, Funnel or Fivetran.

The Offer

We believe in rewarding performance.

  • Competitive Pay: A competitive package with upside tied to growth performance.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere.

  • Real Ownership: No micromanagement. You own the outcome and the credit.

Want to stand out? Share one growth result you personally drove (the channel, what you did, and the numbers) plus two links to content you wrote or SEO work you shipped.

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

The Director of Client Services will play a central role in advancing GoodPower’s mission by building and leading high-impact partnerships with the organizations, campaigns, and communities we serve. This leader will oversee the full client lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing engagement and expansion, ensuring every partner experiences the depth of GoodPower’s expertise and the transformative potential of our work.

As GoodPower grows, this role is expected to build and lead a client services team.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States and reporting to the Chief Growth Officer. The Director of Client Services will work from home, meet daily by video chat with GoodPower team members and partners, and conduct most work online, with in-person meetings as needed. The Director of Client Services must be available for travel within the United States and potentially abroad, and to participate in staff retreats, client meetings, and conferences.

Lead client relationships

  • Establish standards for client communication, performance reporting, and service quality, along with the metrics used to track client health and retention.

  • Client services experience in marketing, digital or advertising is required for this role.
  • Experience in climate, clean energy, or decarbonization, and working with private sector clients in one of these sectors is required for this role.
  • Proven experience building or scaling a client services or account management function, including designing processes, playbooks, and reporting standards that others can follow.
  • Proven track record of growing client accounts and contributing to revenue or partnership development goals concretely.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex client relationships at once, with strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize without close supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting complex information clearly to clients and senior leadership.

The Rapid7 Incident Responder is a hands-on, technical role focused on digital forensics and incident response that offers various customer-facing and consulting opportunities. Rapid7 Incident Responders split their time between reactive breach response cases—supporting Rapid7 customers in their greatest time of need—and proactive customer engagements, delivering threat hunting and detection and response exercises with dedicated internal security teams. Rapid7 aims to provide sustainable work-life balance that allows talented Detection & Response experts to thrive in a reactive Incident Response setting.


About the Team

The Rapid7 Incident Response team is the tip of the spear within Rapid7's Detection & Response practice, ensuring 24/7 breach response coverage for MDR and retainer customers. Delivering services through Rapid7's portfolio—including InsightIDR and Velociraptor—the team's frontline experiences directly inform Rapid7's Product organization to drive continuous improvement across both managed and standalone solutions.


About the Role

As an Incident Responder, your primary responsibility will be to manage major incident response engagements embedded within Rapid7 MDR SOC pods, with oversight from Senior Incident Responders, while dedicating time to ongoing research and service enablement. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Deliver end-to-end incident response services, managing customer engagements from initial scoping to final reporting across the entire IR lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and guide SOC Analysts during major investigations and provide mentorship on minor incident investigations.
  • Conduct forensic investigations using real-time telemetry from the InsightIDR platform and endpoint artifacts from Velociraptor.
  • Lead proactive threat hunting through Rapid7’s Compromise Assessment offering utilizing Velociraptor and other EDR technologies.
  • Execute threat emulation activities as part of Rapid7’s Detection & Response Workshop, helping clients assess their readiness against major threats using existing tools.
  • Advise clients on security best practices and mitigation strategies through enterprise security controls.
  • Research and apply knowledge of emerging attacker methodologies to enhance internal methodologies, procedures, and response efforts.
  • Contribute to public blogs and webinars by sharing actionable insights on the latest attacker techniques uncovered during investigations.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • Bring 2-3 years of hands-on incident response experience, including technical investigations, forensic analysis, and analyzing Windows, Mac, or Linux artifacts to assess threat actor activity.
  • Apply deep knowledge of enterprise security, integrating technologies such as EDR, SIEM, Velociraptor, and OSQuery to enhance threat detection and streamline response.
  • Demonstrate strong technical expertise in at least two specialized areas, including host forensics (Windows, Mac, Linux), network traffic analysis, log review, malware triage, or cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Communicate complex investigation findings and remediation steps in a clear, structured manner that conveys objectives and rationale to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, including executives and legal teams.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across internal SOC pods and external customer teams to understand business needs, align on response strategies, and deliver measurable value.
  • Hold yourself and others responsible for driving end-to-end investigation outcomes, meeting strict timelines, and maintaining high standards of delivery across competing priorities and an on-call rotation (including evening and weekend shifts).
  • Navigate evolving threat landscapes and shifting incident priorities with agility, remaining forward-focused while adapting investigation approaches in high-pressure, ambiguous environments.
  • Hold relevant industry certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GDAT, GCFE, GFCA, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

jobs.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We are embarking on an exciting journey to build out our global Marketing analytics capability. Our culture is built on high trust, which empowers colleagues and fosters the high ownership necessary to meet our shared expectations and deliver high performance. As a remote-first company, you have the flexibility to work wherever you feel most focused and productive within your employing country. This freedom comes with wonderful, tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. These benefits include unlimited annual leave, great healthcare, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact, and in turn, we expect high ownership and commitment. This is a place where trust and high performance are valued, and we provide the environment and support you need to excel. We prioritise an environment where we openly share ideas, embrace our mistakes, and learn from them—collaboration is key to everything we do!

About the role
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will champion data science within our FinCrime-Fraud-AI-ML team. You will design, build and own the machine learning models that stop bad actors, while improving the experience for our legitimate customers. You'll start by finding the quick wins, then lead more ambitious, innovative work.
You'll join a highly collaborative FinCrime squad of Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Backend Engineers, and partner closely with fraud analysts, operations and product. Your initial focus is fraud detection; as the role evolves, you'll have the chance to extend your impact into areas such as risk and credit rating.

What you'll do
  • Model lifecycle: own fraud detection models end to end, from problem framing and feature engineering to training, evaluation and deployment. Automate training and deployment so models are scalable, documented, tested and monitored for drift.
  • Fraud detection: build models that score transactions, accounts and customer behaviour in real time, covering threats such as account takeover, stolen payment credentials, first-party fraud, scams and mule activity.
  • Data and features:work with Data and Analytical Engineering to bring new data sources into our models using dbt best practices, including transactional, device, behavioural and identity signals.
  • Experimentation: design and run experiments to measure the impact of new models, third-party data sources and emerging tools on fraud losses, approval rates and customer experience.
  • Commercial translation:turn complex business needs into solvable data science projects, and set thresholds that balance fraud losses against friction for legitimate customers.
  • Continuous improvement:keep scrutinising our methods to improve model accuracy and the quality of data inputs, and respond quickly as fraud patterns change.
  • Empowerment:build tools and strategies that help non-technical stakeholders understand and act on model results.
  • Leadership: mentor other data scientists, review their work and help set technical standards for the team.
What you'll bring
  • 6+ years' in the Data Science space, including but not limited to, hands on experience with regression analysis, clustering methods, boosting algorithms, feature/model selection, training and deploying models that deliver measurable value
  • Results Driven: Excels at driving technical results in a business oriented framework.
  • Experience in fraud, financial crime, risk or a similar adversarial domain, ideally in payments, fintech or banking, including imbalanced classification and delayed or noisy labels.
  • Strong Coding Skills in Python and ability to use Python for automation, application deploymentSQL: Expert skills in CTEs, joins, and subqueries to manipulate complex datasets for modeling.
  • The ability to deploy your own models and set up the monitoring they need.
  • Familiarity with a modern stack: scikit-learn, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, and visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau or Streamlit.
  • A problem-solving mindset that balances technical excellence with commercial impact. You're comfortable over-communicating and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Nice to have
  • Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, ECS and EMR.
  • Advanced knowledge of experimentation design and evaluation.
  • Graph analytics or graph ML for detecting fraud rings and mule networks.
  • Real-time or streaming ML with low-latency scoring.
  • Model explainability techniques such as SHAP, and experience with model risk governance.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments or remittances, and the regulations around fraud and AML.
  • A “tenacious” attitude—you are willing to do things manually when necessary but seek to automate at every opportunity.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.
