jobs.title: AI Transformation Architect [IC4]
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Working hours

🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.

Preferred location:

  • USA

Why this job is exciting

Every engineering organization has bought coding agents. Yet very few can confidently tell you that they’re making the impact they thought they would. They are falling short, not because the model isn’t good enough, but because the codebase is too complex and, outside of a few thousand people employed by OpenAI and Anthropic, nobody understands what good context looks like. Agents can’t access all the code they need, they burn tokens hunting for the right code, and fill the gaps by guessing. Organizations build internal harnesses and knowledge bases using techniques that are outdated before the product is even in use. You’ll be the person to show customers how to actually fix these problems.

Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, and agents write more code, having the right context matters more and more.

Being a brand new role, you’ll be building from scratch. You’ll define what the AI maturity curve looks like inside of enterprise organizations, turn that into a framework customers can use to assess themselves against, and lead engagements with customers where you’ll directly dig into their environment, build an action plan, and work with them to action it. Then you’ll measure again and show what changed and the results they’ve achieved.

You’ll spend your time in customer environments, in the room with VPs of Engineering and staff engineers, and in the product. You’ll also shape the broader market’s view on what good context looks like for agents, which is a question the whole industry is still figuring out. Your results will show up in how customers use the Sourcegraph platform and in the ways they are able to actually make agents work in enterprise codebases.

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Build relationships across Sales, Field Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product
  • Learn our products, our value prop, and how our largest customers use Sourcegraph
  • Shadow customer calls and interview customers about where their agents succeed and fail today
  • Review our existing benchmark studies and draft a first point of view on the dimensions of context that matter most

📅 Within one quarter, you will…

  • Publish Sourcegraph’s first perspective on context maturity, grounded in what you’ve learned from customer conversations and our own data
  • Ship v1 of the maturity framework: the categories, the criteria that define each stage, and how evidence maps to a score
  • Partner with Marketing to launch a self-serve version
  • Equip Solutions Engineers to run a lightweight version of the assessment inside of trials
  • Run your first assessment with 1-2 select customers, and refine the framework based on what you find

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Be a recognized voice on context and agent readiness, with a steady cadence of writing, talks, or research that engineering leaders reference
  • Publish findings from real assessments: what you’re seeing across enterprise codebases, where agents break, and what moves the needle
  • Own a repeatable paid engagement with a defined scope, deliverables, and readout
  • Deliver action plans that customers execute with you — activating workflows, integrations, and agentic use cases in their own environment
  • Re-measure your first customers and show movement up the curve
  • Feed what you learn back to EPD as a standing input on agent effectiveness in the enterprise

About you

You’re a consultant at heart, with technical chops and credibility. You can walk into a complex engineering organization, find what’s broken, and leave with a plan people act on. You’re equally comfortable telling a VP of Engineering their environment isn’t where they think it is as you are debating a staff engineer on why.

You build things that didn’t exist before: frameworks, practices, points of view. You can turn insight into action and you’re energized by a blank page as a starting point.

Finally, you’re in the middle of the AI shift yourself. You have deep experience and strong opinions on where agents work and where they don’t, and you share them publicly. You stay on top of AI development, use new models and harnesses as they’re released, and have a perspective on how every generation of these products changes the story.

Your skill-set:

  • 7+ years experience advising enterprise technology or engineering organizations
  • Systems or solutions architecture experience in large-scale software, the developer ecosystem, or SDLC environments
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and a point of view on how enterprises are adopting them
  • Experience creating structured, repeatable approaches to diagnosing problems, such as frameworks, assessments, playbooks, or methodologies others can use
  • Experience turning technical findings into an executive-ready business roadmap, then working hands-on with customers to deliver it

Nice to Have

  • You’ve run your own consulting practice or built a consultative services offering from scratch
  • Background in developer tooling, platform engineering, developer experience, or DevOps
  • A public voice - writing or speaking - you have a body of work people reference
  • Experience with consumption or usage-based products

Level

📊 This job is an IC4. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.

Your salary is determined by your pay band for the IC4 job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.

💰 The salary for this role is $200,000 USD.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take about 4.25 hours in total.

👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

  • Recruiter screen (30 min)
  • Hiring manager interview with Hiring Manager (45 min)

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

  • Technical deep dive with Field Engineering (45 min)
  • Conversation with Marketing (30 min)

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

  • Working session with Aimee, Sales, Customer success (45 min)
  • Values Interview (30 min)
  • CEO interview (30 min)

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

jobs.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

Avicado is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to design and deliver practical technical solutions for construction-industry clients. This client-facing role combines construction project management and accounting knowledge with hands-on technical problem-solving across PMIS platforms, enterprise financial systems, integrations, data, and custom applications.

The ideal candidate can lead discovery with business and IT stakeholders, translate operational needs into implementable designs, and personally validate technical approaches by exploring APIs, reviewing code, analyzing data, and building proofs of concept. The architect owns solution direction from discovery through development handoff and supports delivery teams as designs are implemented.

What You’ll Do

  • Solution Architecture & Hands-On Technical Design
    • Lead technical discovery and design workshops; identify requirements, constraints, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
    • Design integrations, data flows, custom applications, and automation solutions connecting PMIS, ERP, and other enterprise systems.
    • Document architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data mappings, transformations, and actionable development requirements.
    • Investigate APIs, webhooks, databases, file interfaces, and existing code to understand capabilities and technical limitations.
    • Build scripts, prototypes, and proofs of concept to test assumptions and demonstrate feasibility.
    • Guide developers through design decisions, technical troubleshooting, implementation reviews, and solution handoffs.
  • Construction & Financial Process Consulting
    • Apply construction project controls knowledge across budgets, commitments, cost codes, change orders, invoices, and reporting.
    • Understand how construction PMIS processes connect with accounting, procurement, job costing, and ERP workflows.
    • Evaluate solution options against real business operations, data integrity, financial controls, and long-term maintainability.
  • Client Relationships & Consulting Delivery
    • Build trusted relationships with customers, software vendors, partners, and internal delivery teams.
    • Communicate technical tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to business and technical audiences.
    • Own technical design deliverables while contributing to billable engagements, estimates, scoping, and proposals.
    • Support existing client solutions, identify enhancements, and uncover opportunities to create additional value.
    • Take initiative, make sound decisions with limited guidance, and remain responsive in a collaborative remote environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in solution architecture, technical consulting, systems integration, software development, or comparable client-facing technical work.
  • Experience with construction operations, construction PMIS platforms, or closely related project management business processes.
  • Working knowledge of construction financial workflows, including budgets, commitments, change orders, invoices, and ERP/accounting relationships.
  • Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and/or file-based interfaces.
  • Ability to read code, query data with SQL, troubleshoot interfaces, and develop scripts or technical proofs of concept.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into architecture, technical specifications, and actionable implementation recommendations.
  • Strong client-facing communication, relationship-building, ownership, and independent problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Procore, Trimble Unity Construct (e-Builder), Kahua, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar construction platforms.
  • Experience with ERP or accounting platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or Workday.
  • Deeper construction accounting knowledge, including job costing, general ledger structures, accounts payable, and reconciliation.
  • Experience with Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or other integration platforms; familiarity with SOAP, XML, and SFTP.
  • Hands-on experience with C#, Python, JavaScript, Power BI, cloud services, or Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Experience with AI-assisted technical investigation, code review, prototyping, or solution design.
  • Experience developing estimates, statements of work, and technical proposals in a consulting environment.
  • Experience mentoring technical professionals, leading technical teams, or managing direct reports.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline, equivalent practical experience, or relevant certifications.

Characteristics of an ideal candidate 

  • Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external 
  • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
  • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
  • Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems
  • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture
  • Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance 

Why Avicado 

  • Competitive compensation 
  • Health insurance 
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote work
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program  And more… 

About Avicado 

Avicado LLC, was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously.

Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. Job Description

Role Title: Project Manager

Department / Seat Name: PMO

Job Type: W2; Full-Time; Remote

Role Summary

The Project Manager (PM) plays a critical role in ensuring successful delivery of RSI Security’s cybersecurity and compliance engagements. The PM will lead the coordination, execution, and tracking of multiple client projects from kickoff through final deliverables, ensuring alignment across internal teams and client stakeholders. This role bridges Sales, Technical Operations, and the Client Experience team to drive execution and reinforce client trust throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Role Purpose

The Project Manager at RSI Security is responsible for orchestrating the seamless execution of client-facing cybersecurity and compliance engagements. This role exists to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards of quality, while fostering trust and transparency with clients and internal teams. By aligning cross-functional efforts and driving operational discipline, the Project Manager plays a vital role in preserving client satisfaction, optimizing resource utilization, and reinforcing RSI Security’s reputation for excellence.

Core Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end project delivery: scope, timeline, resource coordination, and risk mitigation
  • Facilitate project kickoffs, weekly status calls, and closeout activities
  • Monitor project performance using KPIs and internal dashboards
  • Ensure documentation, deliverables, and milestones are completed on time and to quality standards

Client Experience & Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution
    Provide clear and proactive communication to manage expectations and enhance satisfaction
  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on observed client needs

Internal Collaboration

  • Coordinate with assessors, consultants, and technical SMEs to ensure aligned project delivery
  • Work closely with the Sales and CX teams on pre-engagement planning and post-project review
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing

Compliance & Operational Rigor

  • Ensure all activities comply with internal standards, client contracts, and industry best practices
  • Maintain accurate records in project management tools (e.g., Monday.com, HubSpot)
  • Support internal QA efforts and contribute to lessons-learned reviews

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

3+ years of project management experience delivering client-facing engagements in professional services, consulting, or IT/cybersecurity.

Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of concurrent client projects from kickoff through closeout, including scope, timeline, hours budget, and risk.

Working familiarity with at least one cybersecurity or compliance framework (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CMMC, FedRAMP) and how audit or assessment engagements are structured.

Hands-on experience with a work management platform (Monday.com, Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar) and a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar), with disciplined record-keeping.

Experience leading client kickoffs, weekly status calls, and escalations as the primary point of contact.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate technical assessors and SMEs alongside non-technical client stakeholders.

Important Notice to Job Applicants and Recruitment Agencies

Work Authorization & Visa Sponsorship RSI Security is currently unable to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, O-1, STEM OPT extensions, or Permanent Residency/Green Card sponsorship) for any position (except for our offshore contractor positions). All applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States on a full-time, ongoing basis without the need for current or future employer immigration sponsorship

Unsolicited Agency & Staffing Submissions Policy RSI Security does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate submissions, or profiles from recruiters, placement services, or staffing agencies.

About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in providing senior technical and organizational leadership for SANS’ Cloud Platform Engineering organization — spanning platform core services (identity, product administration, and entitlements), DevOps tools and services, website engineering, and courseware & platform orchestration — while serving as the engineering executive for Project CORE, SANS’ enrollment and entitlement modernization program. This role leads individual contributors and engineering teams through their managers and leads; owns shared engineering platforms, standards, tooling, and vendor relationships; and drives the architecture, delivery, and cross-functional coordination required to modernize SANS’ enrollment, entitlement, and administrative systems. The Director partners closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and fellow engineering directors to translate business strategy into secure, scalable, and maintainable systems.

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor individual contributors and engineering teams through managers and leads.
  • Own engineering standards and best practices — CI/CD, code quality, secure development — and facilitate architecture governance across teams.
  • Plan and balance engineering capacity against shifting business priorities, communicating trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Lead strategic modernization programs end to end: architecture, cross-team commitments, delivery planning, and executive reporting.
  • Direct modernization of core product platforms — enrollment, entitlement, identity, and product services — including integration with enterprise systems and retirement of legacy tooling.
  • Measure engineering effectiveness and drive continuous improvement across teams.
  • Champion incident management discipline and publish regular engineering communications to stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing through engineering managers or leads.
  • Demonstrated success leading a large, multi-team modernization or systems-integration program from design through delivery.
  • Strong technical acumen with prior hands-on development experience and the ability to guide architectural decisions across services, integrations, and data flows.
  • Experience with modern AI development techniques and best practices.
  • Experience with enterprise business systems and integrations (e.g., Salesforce/Service Cloud, identity providers, payment/order management).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices, including AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, software procurement, licensing, and budgets.
  • Experience with Agile, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and cross-functional coordination.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience in education technology, training delivery platforms, or certification systems.
  • Experience facilitating architecture governance (architecture councils, RFC processes, engineering standards).
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms (PingIdentity, Entra ID) and entitlement modeling.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted development tooling and governing its safe, cost-effective adoption.
  • Interest in a security-first mindset and secure coding practices.
  • Ability and passion for developing both individuals and teams.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $240,000 OTE (comprised of base salary and bonus), depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

jobs.excerpt: El Institute for War & Peace Reporting (IWPR) es una organización independiente sin fines de lucro que trabaja para empoderar a las voces locales en primera línea, promoviendo cambios positivos en contextos de conflicto, crisis o transición en todo el mundo.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
El Institute for War & Peace Reporting (IWPR) es una organización independiente sin fines de lucro que trabaja para empoderar a las voces locales en primera línea, promoviendo cambios positivos en contextos de conflicto, crisis o transición en todo el mundo. Desde hace más de 30 años, IWPR fomenta el acceso a información confiable y el debate público para contribuir a la construcción de sociedades más estables, justas e inclusivas.

El Institute for War and Peace Reporting (IWPR) busca contratar un/a consultor/a especializado/a en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, para brindar asesoría a medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina. La consultoría se centrará en fortalecer las capacidades de estos medios para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que les permitan generar y aumentar sus ingresos en dichas plataformas, de acuerdo con su contexto, sus recursos y sus prioridades editoriales.

El/la consultor/a prestará apoyo de asesoramiento continuo y personalizado a los medios de comunicación participantes para evaluar el potencial de monetización de sus canales digitales actuales, identificar oportunidades para generar y diversificar ingresos, y recomendar mejoras en las estrategias de contenido, la frecuencia de publicación y otras prácticas que puedan potenciar la monetización. A partir de estas evaluaciones, el consultor colaborará con cada medio para desarrollar y poner en práctica un plan de monetización a medida, destinado a aumentar los ingresos y reforzar la sostenibilidad financiera.

Asimismo, el/la consultor/a analizará el desempeño de los contenidos y ofrecerá recomendaciones prácticas para mejorar el alcance, la fidelización de la audiencia, la participación y el potencial de ingresos. Esta labor incluirá la definición de objetivos y el seguimiento de indicadores, el análisis de las métricas disponibles y el apoyo a la implementación de ajustes que contribuyan a la sostenibilidad financiera de cada medio.

La asesoría deberá considerar las políticas de monetización, los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a los medios participantes. Las recomendaciones deberán adaptarse a estas condiciones y a las capacidades de cada equipo, respetando en todo momento su independencia editorial y cumpliendo estrictamente con los protocolos de seguridad establecidos por IWPR.

El/la consultor/a deberá mantener una coordinación permanente con IWPR durante toda la consultoría, documentar los avances y demostrar flexibilidad para trabajar de forma remota con equipos que pueden enfrentar limitaciones de conectividad o desenvolverse en contextos complejos.

Alcance de la consultoría:

  • Brindar asesoría remota y personalizada en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, a equipos de medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina.
  • Acompañar el diagnóstico, diseño e implementación de un plan de monetización adaptado al estado de los canales, el contexto, los recursos y las necesidades de cada medio.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para gestionar sus canales, optimizar sus contenidos e identificar y aprovechar opciones de monetización que contribuyan a su sostenibilidad económica.
  • Orientar la definición de objetivos, metas de ingresos, indicadores y herramientas de seguimiento que permitan evaluar los resultados y ajustar las estrategias de contenido y monetización.
  • Aplicar una metodología práctica y orientada a resultados, basada en el acompañamiento continuo, recomendaciones que los equipos puedan implementar con sus recursos y la documentación de avances y productos.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de seguridad y los requisitos de reporte establecidos por IWPR, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes y considerando las políticas y restricciones aplicables a la monetización en cada plataforma.

Funciones:

  • Realizar un diagnóstico de los canales (particularmente Youtube) y las capacidades de cada medio, identificar oportunidades y obstáculos para la monetización y acordar un plan de trabajo con objetivos, cronograma e indicadores de seguimiento.
  • Asesorar sobre los requisitos de elegibilidad, las políticas y las opciones de monetización disponibles, considerando los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a cada medio.
  • Acompañar la implementación de las iniciativas de monetización y analizar las métricas de alcance, retención, tiempo de visualización e ingresos disponibles para identificar mejoras y orientar ajustes.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para interpretar sus resultados y tomar decisiones que contribuyan a generar ingresos de manera sostenida, de acuerdo con sus recursos y prioridades editoriales.
  • Coordinar con IWPR, documentar avances y aplicar los protocolos de seguridad del proyecto, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes.

Entregables:

Minutas de las reuniones con los medios, informes escritos sobre los avances logrados por cada equipo, las actividades planificadas y, cuando corresponda, recomendaciones estratégicas, utilizando la plantilla proporcionada por IWPR.

Requisitos mínimos:

  • Licenciatura en Periodismo, Comunicación, Marketing Digital, Administración de Empresas o áreas afines, o acreditación de al menos tres años de experiencia comprobada en monetización de plataformas digitales.
  • Experiencia mínima de tres años en el diseño e implementación de estrategias de monetización de plataformas digitales, especialmente YouTube, con resultados demostrables en la generación o el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Conocimiento de las herramientas, los requisitos de elegibilidad y las políticas de monetización de YouTube, incluidos aspectos relacionados con derechos de autor, restricciones geográficas y acceso a pagos.
  • Experiencia en el análisis de métricas de desempeño e ingresos y en la optimización de canales y contenidos para mejorar el alcance, la retención de audiencias y los resultados de monetización.
  • Experiencia en la asesoría a equipos y en el diseño y la facilitación de talleres o mentorías, con capacidad para formular recomendaciones adaptadas a sus recursos.
  • Disponibilidad horaria flexible para coordinar reuniones, mentorías y talleres de forma remota con equipos en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Dominio pleno de español e inglés.
  • Sensibilidad cultural y capacidad demostrada para adaptar el acompañamiento a diversos contextos y necesidades.
  • Ética profesional.
Salary: $40 to $80 per hour

We’re looking for a Business Analyst in Mexico to support the ongoing operation, maintenance, and enhancement of a US-based client’s commerce platform. Backlog Management & Issue Analysis

Production Monitoring & Operational Metrics

Production Support & Issue Resolution

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with 15 to 20 of our largest customers. You’ll be their strategic advisor and their most knowledgeable guide to the platform. Inside TrueContext, you’ll be their strongest voice.

Why this work matters

When a hospital's imaging system goes down, patients wait for answers. When a substation fails, a neighborhood loses power. When an inspection is missed in a building’s fire system, people are at risk. A skilled field engineer stands behind each of those moments. Their work keeps hospitals, cities and energy systems running, and most of it goes unseen.

TrueContext is the Field Intelligence platform built for those engineers. Leading companies in medical technology, utilities, energy and building systems use us to guide their teams through complex work and capture what happens at every asset. That knowledge then turns into better decisions. Each visit makes the next one faster, safer and smarter.

We’re early in a big shift. Customers have known us as the tool that digitized their forms, and we’re becoming the platform that makes field work intelligent. Our Customer Success team guides customers through that change, and it’s a chance to help define a category while it’s still taking shape.

jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data Product Delivery Manager to prioritize the data analysis and business intelligence product backlog supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This SME-level position will work with Government mission owners, users, and technical teams to translate operational needs into clear product requirements, backlog priorities, and measurable acceptance criteria. The manager will coordinate requirements for data ingestion, governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting. The Data Product Delivery Manager will connect mission priorities with technical delivery, helping teams understand the intended value, dependencies, and acceptance expectations for each data product. The role will collaborate with data engineers, database personnel, governance specialists, BI developers, testers, and program leadership throughout planning, development, validation, and release.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Data Product Delivery Manager will:

  • Maintain and prioritize the data analysis and BI product backlog in coordination with Government stakeholders.
  • Gather and clarify user needs, operational challenges, reporting requirements, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate mission needs into product features, user stories, business rules, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Refine backlog items so delivery teams understand scope, dependencies, data needs, and completion expectations.
  • Coordinate priorities for data ingestion, data governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting.
  • Recommend sequencing based on mission value, urgency, technical readiness, dependencies, and available capacity.
  • Facilitate backlog refinement, planning discussions, product demonstrations, and stakeholder reviews.
  • Coordinate with governance personnel on ownership, definitions, authoritative sources, access decisions, and approved uses.
  • Work with data engineers and database teams to clarify ingestion, transformation, integration, and warehouse requirements.
  • Work with BI teams to define reporting behavior, calculations, filters, visualizations, and self-service capabilities.
  • Maintain traceability among user needs, backlog items, acceptance criteria, test results, and delivered functionality.
  • Support acceptance testing by clarifying expected outcomes, resolving requirements questions, and documenting stakeholder feedback.
  • Track dependencies, impediments, risks, scope changes, and decisions affecting product delivery.
  • Coordinate release readiness and communicate delivered capabilities, limitations, and outstanding issues.
  • Collect user feedback and assess whether delivered products meet mission needs.
  • Maintain product documentation, decision records, backlog status, and delivery briefings.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Ability to prioritize a data analysis and BI product backlog.
  • Ability to clarify user needs and define measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to coordinate requirements for data ingestion, governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting.
  • Applicable DoDM 8140/8570 certification for the assigned duties.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO I) or equivalent certification — strongly preferred.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Experience managing enterprise data, analytics, or BI product backlogs.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience developing user stories, business rules, requirements traceability, and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, data warehouses, metadata, data quality, and governance practices.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, demonstrations, and product releases.
  • Familiarity with Agile backlog and delivery-management tools.
  • Strong stakeholder facilitation, analytical problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s

  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals to join our growing team! As Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals, you’ll own the third-party integrations that power Figure’s mortgage and lending products and drive the product roadmap for a set of emerging HELOC growth channels. Integrations run through every step of our HELOC funnel and loan origination system (LOS): property and public record data, collateral valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation and eSign, notarization, and recording. Each one shapes how quickly a borrower gets an offer, how confidently we underwrite, and how smoothly a loan officer or partner gets a loan to funding. You’ll own the full lifecycle of these integrations, from improving the vendors we have and onboarding new ones to holding vendors accountable to the quality and SLAs our borrowers and partners depend on. You’ll build the monitoring that makes integration health visible across the company and use funnel, conversion, and quality data to decide where the next investment goes. This is a hands-on role: you write the requirements, run the vendor calls, and stay close to the details. You’ll also own the core product roadmap for new HELOC growth channels like SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors, early, high-upside channels where the product and partner workflow are still being defined.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for all third-party integrations across Figure’s mortgage and lending products, including data integrations, integrations that feed credit and underwriting workflows, and the vendor services behind each stage of the HELOC funnel (property data, valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation, notarization, recording, and debt payoff)
  • Drive a prioritized roadmap of improvements to existing vendor integrations, measured by funnel conversion, borrower and loan officer engagement, underwriting quality, and LOS usability
  • Evaluate, select, and onboard new vendors that improve HELOC and LOS functionality or unlock new capabilities, from due diligence through contracting, build, QA, and launch, with Engineering, Credit, Compliance, Legal, and Operations

jobs.excerpt: About us NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend.
jobs.description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the Role

NinjaOne provides a unified IT management platform that simplifies IT operations, endpoint management, and security. We are looking for a Staff Network Architect, Cloud and Datacenter to own the enterprise network architecture across our Austin datacenter, AWS, and our production and corporate environments. You will design, build, and run the enterprise network behind our Austin datacenter and AWS environments, which support our QA, Development, and Sales teams, and set the network standards that other teams build on.

You will combine architectural vision with hands-on engineering: designing secure, scalable, highly available networks across datacenter and AWS, connecting them through hybrid and WAN architectures, and automating how they are deployed and operated. You will work closely with Datacenter Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure as Code and Build and Release, Security, QA, Development, and Sales. Expect roughly half your time on the Austin datacenter and half on cloud and platform work across the organization.

Must-have: hands-on AWS network architecture experience, including hybrid connectivity between AWS and a physical datacenter.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option. Candidates in the Austin area are preferred.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Architecture and design: Own the network architecture for the Austin datacenter, AWS, and our production and corporate environments: design diagrams, IP addressing and CIDR/IPAM standards, routing designs, and design standards, and lead architecture reviews and vendor evaluations.
  • Design and scale core network boundaries by establishing robust CIDR allocation strategies, IPAM (IP Address Management) frameworks, and non-overlapping subnets across all corporate domains.
  • Cloud network design lead: As we move to infrastructure as code, serve as lead network designer for our cloud environments. Build and maintain a complete map of the network, from VPCs and front ends to subnets and CIDR blocks.
  • VPN replacement: Define the strategy for replacing our VPN, covering both the Austin datacenter and all users accessing AWS, and run the project end to end.
  • AWS networking: Design VPCs, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, and multi-account topologies; build hybrid connectivity with Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN, and BGP; secure it with Network Firewall, PrivateLink, and Route 53 Resolver.
  • Datacenter networking: Design, deploy, and troubleshoot leaf-spine, VXLAN/EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VRF, and MLAG environments, and take part in cabinet builds, cabling validation, and network cutovers.
  • Hybrid cloud: Build WAN and routing fabrics that connect on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud, with predictable failover paths.
  • Security and resilience: Implement segmentation, firewall policy, and least-privilege connectivity with Security; support IPv4/IPv6, incident response, root-cause analysis, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Automation and IaC: Automate provisioning, validation, and drift detection using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and CloudFormation, and fit network changes into version control and CI/CD.
  • Monitoring and reliability: Improve telemetry, alerting, and runbooks; lead troubleshooting of complex issues across datacenter, firewall, and cloud networking.
  • Leadership and influence: Act as the senior technical authority for networking, mentor engineers, work with vendors, carriers, and cloud providers, and communicate risks and decisions to leadership. Drive projects forward across SRE, Platform Engineering, and engineering teams, influencing and aligning teams beyond your own to adopt network standards and make changes.
  • Other duties as needed

About You

  • 15+ years in network engineering, datacenter networking, cloud networking, or infrastructure architecture.
  • Proven record of owning a network architecture end to end and leading major network transformations, from design through delivery.
  • Demonstrated hands-on AWS network architecture: VPC, Transit Gateway, VPC peering, security groups and NACLs, Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN, and hybrid connectivity to physical datacenters.
  • Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, Layer 2/3, VLANs, VRFs, BGP, OSPF, LACP, and high-availability design, with hands-on enterprise switching and routing experience.
  • Practical experience with segmentation, firewall integration, routing policy, and IP address management.
  • Network automation and infrastructure-as-code experience with Python, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across datacenter, AWS, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity, and the ability to write clear architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
  • Ability to influence and align engineering teams you do not manage, and to communicate risks and decisions to senior leadership and vendors.
  • Able to travel to the Austin datacenter as needed, with occasional after-hours maintenance or incident response.
  • Engineer strategic solutions (including advanced NAT/PAT and VRF segmentation) to resolve overlapping CIDR block challenges during multi-tenant cloud integrations.
  • Architect highly scalable, hierarchically structured CIDR blocks to maximize address efficiency and minimize routing table sizes via route summarization.
  • Architect and implement high-availability hybrid paths connecting enterprise datacenters (e.g., Element Critical) to major cloud providers like AWS and Azure.
  • Design robust WAN transit architectures leveraging AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, SD-WAN, and managed MPLS networks.

Nice to haves

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty and/or Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Cloud WAN, Network Firewall, PrivateLink, and multi-account shared services design.
  • Experience leading a VPN or remote-access replacement.
  • Juniper, Cisco, or Arista platforms; Juniper Mist; VXLAN/EVPN fabrics; IPv6 design.
  • Familiarity with virtualization networking, enterprise storage, and bare-metal infrastructure; network telemetry and observability tools.

What You’ll Love 

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. 
We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.
We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.
We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.
We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.
We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

Blending strong project management discipline with hands-on technical expertise, the associate ensures successful delivery, testing, and implementation of technical solutions to improve transplant centers and clinical teams work with CareDx products and services. This role reports to the Lead Project Manager.

Project Execution & Delivery

  • Serve as a triage point for EMR Support, assessing incoming issues, identifying the appropriate path for resolution, and coordinating with the necessary internal teams.

Testing, Validation & Quality Assurance

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, USA)
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.

JOB TITLE: Web Designer & Technical Writer

We are seeking a versatile Web Designer & Technical Writer who combines strong visual design skills with the ability to write, edit, and review technical content. This role will support digital communications by improving clarity, usability, and visual quality across announcements, websites, and other digital assets.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working across design and content, and able to translate complex information into clear, accessible, and engaging materials.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Web Designer Responsibilities:

  • Design, re-design, code, test, implement, and maintain new web pages and sections of agency Internet and intranet websites.
  • Create prototypes (including graphic design, navigation, and layout options) of new web pages and site areas.
  • Collaborate with content providers (including attorneys, economists, senior management, administrative, and IT support staff) and key web team members on project goals, audiences, schedules, and other aspects of project planning and deliverables.
  • Establish layout, design, formatting and style guidelines for websites.
  • Review and track web metrics and analytics.
  • Research, evaluate, and report on new and emerging developments and trends in web design and web services.
  • Effectively communicate orally and in writing when presenting ideas and recommendations to a wide range of audiences, including senior management staff.
  • Train end users, web staff, and agency trainers, regarding various aspects of agency web services.
  • Ensure that new web pages and sections comply with:
    • Section 508 and 504 requirements for accessibility.
    • Best practices in usability and information architecture.
    • Federal and agency policies and requirements.
  • Implement, code, and test prototypes using technologies such as HTML, CSS, XHTML, dynamic HTML (JavaScript), ASP, JSP, and PHP in a multi-browser, multi-operating system, and multi-device environment.
  • Comply with best practices for “plain writing” when creating, organizing, and editing content.
  • Support and assist web content administrators, quality assurance analysts when requested.

Technical Writer Responsibilities:

  • Effectively communicate orally and in writing when presenting ideas and recommendations to a wide range of audiences, including technical, non-technical, junior, and senior staff.
  • Prepare and edit technical documentation including: User Manuals, Job Aids, “Help,” What’s New, FAQs, policies, procedures, guidance, and other technical information (in print and web media) as requested.
  • Prepare other written documentation including: organization charts, flow charts, brochures, newsletters, information sheets, and other documentation (in print and web media) as requested.
  • Comply with best practices for “plain writing” when creating, organizing, and editing content.
  • Support and assist government and contract staff including: web content analysts, web software developers, web quality assurance analysts, managers and other web support staff when requested.
  • Prepare multimedia training and guidance tutorials.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Section 508 / accessibility compliance
  • Familiarity with web analytics and reporting (e.g., Google Analytics or similar tools)
  • Experience designing for government, enterprise, or regulated environments
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Ability to explain design and content decisions clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Comfort working independently in a fast-paced environment

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to obtain a US DOJ public trust clearance
  • For the purposes of obtaining a federal security clearance, all applicants must be a US Citizen

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

This position is fully remote. The employee will primarily work in a home office environment and must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success.
jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Performance Marketing to build and own how we test and learn across direct mail, email, and paid digital, reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing Strategy.

The impact you'll make:

Someone sees a Mission Lane offer to apply in a mailer or online, and in a moment decides if our card might help them get where they’re going. That decision to apply could be where real financial progress begins for them. Millions of moments just like this one are pivotal in our mission to enable people to build better futures.

As Senior Manager, Performance Marketing, you’ll shape the strategy behind these moments and own the always-on, hypothesis-led testing agenda that connects people with offers that resonate, so we can help more people get where they’re going.

This is a new role on a newly created, growing marketing team that works closely with the credit team. There’s plenty to build and you’ll have a hand in all of it. You’ll set the learning agenda and help shape how the team works as it grows.

What you'll own:

  • The always-on, hypothesis-led testing agenda across direct mail, email, and paid digital (social, connected TV, display), with tests built to beat benchmarks and drive positive selection, including affiliate tests of offer, copy, and creative ahead of larger media investment
  • Benchmark and control creative by channel and segment, from spotting degradation and setting refresh cadence to certifying winners that clear a defined lift threshold
  • Performance against benchmark across direct mail and paid digital: the share of tests that win, how quickly they win, CPA and CAC improvement, and test velocity by channel, with booking quality (credit mix) tracked in partnership with credit, risk, and product
  • One prioritized learning roadmap across the full funnel that carries insights between channels, with executive-ready readouts of what we tested, why, and what we learned
  • Creative briefs that turn customer and performance data into clear hypotheses, with content strategy and agency partners from brief through production, plus AI-assisted variant creation and turning social and organic engagement into applications
  • Growth and marketing KPIs (GRR, CTR, NABs) with business analysts, and conversion on our owned digital properties with product managers, from finding where people drop off to designing confidence-building nudges
  • Agencies, contractors, and junior team members, through clear briefs and quality standards, plus day-to-day leadership of the working group that builds and runs our campaigns
  • Close collaboration with the leads of Content and Marketing Operations to ensure channel and brand consistency and support excellent execution and orchestration.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in consumer performance marketing, direct response, or growth marketing, with a track record of beating creative and control benchmarks
  • Financial services marketing experience, including working within regulatory and compliance requirements
  • Hands-on experience across direct mail, email, and paid digital, including testing offer, copy, and creative through affiliate marketing
  • Experience designing and running A/B and multivariate tests (DOEs), with fluency in statistical significance, sample sizing, and test hygiene
  • Strong brief-writing skills and experience partnering with creative teams and content strategists
  • Experience working with credit and risk, finance, product, legal, and compliance, and guiding cross-functional efforts and junior talent, through direct reports and across teams
  • Experience with tiered capital allocation and media budget management across direct mail and paid digital
  • Proficiency with SQL, Tableau or Looker, Google or Adobe Analytics, and direct mail testing platforms
  • Experience partnering with business analysts on KPI frameworks (GRR, CTR, NAB attribution) and with product managers on conversion UX, including drop-off analysis and nudge design
  • Ability to travel ~3-4 times per year for high quality in person collaboration

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA
  • Experience in the credit industry, with an understanding of credit

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $152,000 - $197,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting .

Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third-party recruiters.

Application Integrity:

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Role Title: Emerging Technology Threat / Strategic Competition Advisor

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hs/wk)

Location: Remote, US only

We are engaging Emerging Technology Threat / Strategic Competition Advisors to contribute to a customer’s project focused on evaluating AI reasoning in strategic and threat assessment contexts. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Required Skills

  • Emerging-tech threat assessment

  • Strategic/competitive reasoning

  • Legitimate/prohibited discrimination

Scope of Work

  • Design and author realistic cases centered on emerging-technology threats—such as AI/autonomy, hypersonics, space, cyber, quantum, directed energy, and CBRN-adjacent domains—within the context of strategic competition dynamics.

  • Apply net-assessment principles and strategic-competition analysis to ambiguous scenarios, assessing adversary intent, capability development, and the boundary between legitimate and prohibited analysis.

  • Grade AI model outputs against criteria including analytical rigor, use of sources, handling of uncertainty, expression of limitations, and practical utility for strategy or targeting.

  • Ensure scenario fidelity by validating that evaluation cases reflect authentic strategic and threat-assessment methodologies, not simplified or headline-driven versions.

  • Identify and flag instances where the AI model unnecessarily refuses sound conceptual, analytic, or policy inquiries.

  • Document edge cases and articulate the reasoning behind each assessment to ensure defensibility and transparency in evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Senior-level experience in strategic analysis, threat assessment, or net assessment at respected organizations—such as defense think tanks, intelligence community strategic shops, service futures/strategy offices, or combatant-command strategy/plans roles.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least one emerging-technology area with clear understanding of its military or strategic implications.

  • Deep knowledge of great-power and strategic competition trends, including adversary modernization, doctrine, and capability trajectories (e.g., China, Russia, or key regional actors).

  • Exceptional analytic writing and briefing skills, with the ability to construct defensible assessments using calibrated confidence and transparent reasoning.

  • Experience leading analytic reviews, teaching, or mentoring in relevant fields.

  • Outstanding written and verbal English communication abilities, able to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Prior experience generating evaluative content for training, simulation, or analytical review purposes is a plus.
