jobs.description:
About the Team

The Corporate Development team at DoorDash is a fast-paced, high-performing group responsible for sourcing, evaluating, negotiating and executing M&A and investments. This team is central to DoorDash’s continued growth. We work closely with senior leadership, operations, product and finance teams to guide company strategy. We lead all aspects of identifying, evaluating, and executing transactions that have a significant impact on the overall direction of the company.

About the Role

You will help identify and execute transformative acquisitions and investments globally that accelerate or increase the likelihood of DoorDash achieving its strategic objectives. You will report to the Senior Director, Corporate Development. This role is remote first with some domestic and international travel expected.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Participate in all aspects of the deal cycle, including sourcing, evaluation of business model attractiveness, strategic/financial analysis, valuation, due diligence, structuring and negotiation, and integration
  • Coordinate diligence, deal execution, and integration across cross-functional teams, including operations, engineering, product, finance, accounting, and legal
  • Identify, research and recommend industries, companies and technologies for DoorDash to evaluate from an M&A or investment perspective and analyze the company's objectives and identify, recommend and pursue technologies that can accelerate those goals
  • Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards and presentations that track and analyze our industry, as well as track prospective M&A opportunities
  • Support cross-functional capital markets and financing efforts

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 4+ years of corporate development, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital experience
  • Are strategic, driven and analytical with a passion for the local economy and a thorough understanding of the competitive landscape
  • Proficient in financial modeling, valuation, and quantitative analysis with a familiarity of basic accounting principles
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional senior executives in a fast-changing environment

We expect this position to be filled by 01/19/27

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$129,200—$190,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. As a Clinical Operations Lead, you will provide clinical operations oversight for projects at a regional or global level, ensuring study deliverables, CRA activities and investigator sites are managed in accordance with the protocol, monitoring plan, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations. You will act as a key liaison between CRAs and the clinical project team, providing operational guidance, training and oversight throughout the study.

Our Services

jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Senior Principal Scientist, Psychiatry accountable for planning and overseeing the scientific strategy and delivery of psychiatry-focused clinical trial services across a portfolio of studies. This role is responsible for ensuring the scientific integrity, quality, and consistency of endpoint data collection, including rater training, scale administration, and central monitoring methodologies. The role provides scientific leadership across a portfolio of studies, supporting study design implementation and the development of services for psychiatric indications (e.g., MDD, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder). Responsibilities include oversight of rater training programs, central monitoring frameworks, and data quality strategies to support reliable and valid clinical trial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the scientific delivery of psychiatry clinical trial services across a portfolio of studies, including rater training and central monitoring.
  • Contribute to definition and implementation of study-specific delivery plans for endpoint quality, including integration of central monitoring and review workflows.
  • Provide direction to internal study teams on feasibility, scale selection, administration standards, and timing of deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary scientific point of contact for assigned studies, ensuring clarity and consistency in internal and sponsor communications.
  • Contribute to design and implementation of rater training programs (e.g., MADRS, HAM-D, HAM-A, YMRS), including certification, calibration, and remediation pathways.
  • Monitor central monitoring outputs, including identification of data quality signals, rater drift, and protocol deviations, and guide appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Support the resolution of scientific and data quality escalations arising from central monitoring and study review activities.
  • Develop central monitoring resources to systematize feedback.
  • Collaborate with Project Management to ensure efficient and profitable delivery of services, including resource allocation and workflow optimization.
  • Contribute to the development and standardization of SOPs, training materials, and operational guidelines for psychiatry trials.
  • Support staff development within scientific and rater training teams, including mentoring and performance feedback.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of psychiatry-focused products and services, including rater training programs, central monitoring methodologies, and scale-specific guidance.
  • Support innovation in endpoint quality assurance and approaches for detecting data quality issues.
  • Contribute to the design and interpretation of metrics related to rater performance, endpoint reliability, and data quality.
  • Analyze patterns in clinical trial data to identify risks such as placebo response inflation, rater drift, and scoring inconsistencies.
  • Provide scientific consultation on study design, scale selection, administration strategy, and risk mitigation.
  • Support business development through scientific input in proposals
  • Drive scientific dissemination through publications, conference presentations, and internal knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Contribute to advancing best practices in psychiatric endpoint assessment and central monitoring.

Requirements

  • Tertiary qualifications or post graduate degree in the area of psychology, psychiatry, neuroscience, or related field
  • Evidence of scientific track record in publications, conference presentations, patents or grants, with maintenance of on-going professional development.
  • Experience in interacting with clinical scientists, neuropsychologists and medical professionals at a high level.
  • Experience managing scientific projects and directing staff.
  • At least 6 years of neuropsychological practical experience.
  • An understanding of the science of measuring cognition and behavior, including an understanding of computer-based tools and traditional neuropsychological assessment tools available to measure change in cognition in a clinical setting
  • Expertise in psychiatric rating scales (e.g., MADRS, PANSS, HAM-D, YMRS) and structured interview methodologies (e.g., SIGMA).
  • Experience with rater training, central monitoring, or data quality oversight.
  • 5+ years of experience in clinical trials, with emphasis on CNS/psychiatry preferred.

Skills, Knowledge and Specialist Expertise

  • Ability to organize and lead the organization of complex tasks and processes
  • Capable of critical thinking, problem solving, with ability to generate and present ideas and solutions.
  • Ability to use own initiative and pay close attention to detail
  • Ability to get on with people and work well in a team
  • Confidence to present a tailored presentation to a potential customer
  • A positive and determined approach to researching and analyzing new business opportunities
  • Strong client management skills
  • Commercial awareness

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
  • 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate’s 401k program.

  • Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
  • Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
  • Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.
Wage Range
$165,000—$175,000 USD

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

Once a Luscii programme goes live, your work really begins. As Customer Success Manager (or Impact Specialist, as we call the role within Luscii), you take ownership of a portfolio of NHS customers and lead the relationships that help them succeed. You bring your own experience, structure and proven ways of working to each account. You know that no two customers are the same, so you adapt your approach based on what you learn, how customers respond and what the data tells you. You stay ahead of the conversation, rather than waiting for customers to tell you what they need.

You also understand the value of learning from others. By sharing successful approaches, customer stories and insights from across our network, you help customers see what is possible and work towards their own results. At the same time, you bring valuable feedback and data back into Luscii, helping us improve our products, strengthen customer relationships and scale our impact across healthcare.

You own the ongoing relationship with a portfolio of live NHS accounts. Your focus is to help customers get lasting value from Luscii, while making sure their programmes continue to develop and deliver measurable results. You combine a structured approach to customer success with the flexibility to adapt your plans as you learn more about each account.

You take the lead in setting direction, creating momentum and keeping customers engaged. You know when to challenge, when to share insights and when to adjust course. Overview

The Director of Strategy & Business Analytics reports to the SVP, Head of Business Analytics. This is a player-coach role requiring both strong individual contributor output and direct people leadership. The Director is expected to lead, mentor, and develop a team of analytics professionals while remaining actively hands-on -- building analysis, driving strategic projects, and presenting findings to senior and executive leadership. The individual must demonstrate strong business judgment, proactively identify analytical opportunities, and deliver data-driven insights that drive business decisions across functions.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of analytics professionals, fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.
  • Remain actively hands-on -- building analysis, models, dashboards, and reports alongside the team, not just directing the work.
  • Work across business functions on analytical and strategic projects as directed by the SVP, Head of Business Analytics.
  • Identify business problems, performance gaps, and opportunities that warrant analysis -- not only when asked, but by staying close to what is happening in the business.
  • Structure business questions into a clear analytical approach and determine the right method and data needed to answer them.
  • Turn work around quickly when speed matters.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership and C-suite executives. This person will be in those rooms regularly.
  • Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give business stakeholders direct visibility into their metrics.
  • Apply statistical methods to the work -- segmentation, regression, hypothesis testing, forecasting -- at the level the question requires.
  • Work with machine learning model outputs and translate results into recommendations business leaders can act on.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering on data needs, pipeline requirements, and data model gaps that affect analytical work.
  • Manage multiple projects at once and prioritize based on business impact.

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready to turn clinical expertise into stronger care, tighter compliance, and a better-trained team?

Why This Role Matters

Behind every approved authorization, managed case, and chronic disease program is a clinical team that needs to get it right, every time. As our Clinical Specialist, you’re the person who makes that happen. You’ll audit our Utilization Management, Case Management, and Chronic Disease Management work, keep us ready for NCQA and URAC accreditation, and train the clinicians who deliver care to our members. Your work protects members, safeguards documentation integrity, and keeps our programs defensible under state, federal, and accreditation standards. When you raise the bar on quality and training, the whole organization performs better.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Audit with purpose: Conduct internal and external audits of UM, CM, and CDM processes and documentation, then prepare audit files, findings, and corrective action recommendations that drive real change.
  • Safeguard compliance: Ensure our programs meet state, federal, and accreditation requirements, including HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, URAC, and ERISA as applicable, so members are protected and the organization stays audit-ready.
  • Spot risk early: Identify quality and compliance risks and partner across teams to resolve them before they become larger problems.
  • Sharpen our playbook: Review and support SOPs and workflows to keep them aligned with regulations and clear enough to follow in practice.
  • Prepare for accreditation: Build and maintain NCQA and URAC evidence so the organization is always ready for external review.
  • Build and deliver training: Develop, maintain, and deliver role-based curriculum and onboarding for UM, CM, and CDM staff, using virtual sessions, self-paced modules, and one-on-one coaching designed for adult learners. Cover core processes such as case initiation and closure, documentation standards, high-dollar case monitoring, stop-loss notification, administrative support, customer service, and productivity expectations.
  • Measure what works: Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, observation, and performance data, then refine the content where results fall short.
  • Track competency: Maintain training records and competency documentation, monitor trends, and escalate performance concerns to leadership when needed.
  • Support corrective action: Provide coaching and training aligned to corrective action plans (CAPs), document outcomes, and keep leadership informed of progress.
  • Stay current: Keep up with changes in regulatory, accreditation, and evidence-based practice standards, and complete all required HIPAA training on time.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience:

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license required; additional licensure may be required based on program scope
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 2–4 years of experience in UM, CM, and/or DM/CDM required; managed care experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience applying adult learning principles and delivering effective training
  • Experience executing audits, including sampling, evidence validation, audit trail review, and report writing

Technical Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of applicable regulations and accreditation standards (HIPAA, CMS as applicable, NCQA, URAC)
  • Clinical documentation review and data integrity expertise
  • Education management and competency development through training oversight, performance analysis, and targeted learning interventions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Smartsheet
  • Proficiency with multiple screens and strong typing skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems in a remote environment, including Teams (on and off camera), SharePoint, shared drives, VPN, Navigate multiple platforms, Quick Links, GIAS, ADP, Confluence, and a phone system with headset; additional programs may apply based on job duties. Full system proficiency is expected after training and a 1.5-month ramp (3 months total).

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

jobs.excerpt: About Us: Consertus is an AI-native global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep industry expertise with advanced digital capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Consertus is an AI-native global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep industry expertise with advanced digital capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 2,500 professionals, we help clients plan, deliver, and optimize complex capital programs across the full project lifecycle.


Our integrated capabilities span advisory, digital solutions, engineering and design, and program delivery, enabling organizations to navigate complexity, mitigate risk, and achieve strategic objectives. We serve a diverse range of industries, including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial real estate, life sciences, and technology.


At Consertus, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative, flexible, and inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop their skills, and make a meaningful impact. Together, we’re transforming the way the world is planned, built, and delivered.

Learn more about how Consertus is creating lasting value for clients, communities, and our people at www.consertus.com.


About this Role:

Our small, but mighty, Legal team is looking for an experienced, smart, and driven Senior Contracts Manager aligned with our mission. The successful candidate will, among other things, independently draft, review, redline, and negotiate agreements within established guidelines and escalate issues for attorney review, own the contract lifecycle from intake through execution and administration for the assigned divisions, and identify opportunities to develop and improve contracting strategy, processes, and standards while maintaining the templates and playbooks.


This position will offer a high level of exposure across the assigned business divisions, acting as a true contracting business partner and primary point of contact for revenue-generating leaders. You will be encouraged to build your profile internally by working collaboratively across departments and regions, reducing the company’s risk profile, and driving revenue growth. Expect lots of variety, a fast-moving environment, and plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. You’ll wear multiple hats and act as a force multiplier for the team.


Key Responsibilities:

Contract negotiation and management

  • Independently draft, review, redline, and negotiate routine and moderately complex commercial agreements, including client and master services agreements, professional services agreements, subconsultant and subcontractor agreements, vendor agreements, teaming agreements, statements of work, amendments, and change orders, within delegated authority and escalating matters as appropriate
  • Apply and maintain company templates, approved positions, and escalation guidelines; identify and communicate contractual risks involving scope, payment, indemnity, insurance, liability, intellectual property, confidentiality, flow-down requirements, and termination
  • Serve as the primary contracting partner to sales, pursuit, operations, procurement, and finance teams: advise on contract terms and process, set realistic timelines, and balance revenue priorities against risk
  • Support pursuits and proposals (both public and private RFP) by reviewing solicitation and client-issued terms and identifying risks and exceptions before submission, and completing applications, certifications, and affidavits

Contract lifecycle management

  • Ensure robust and complete contract management across the full contract lifecycle—from intake and drafting through execution, amendment, renewal, and closeout—identifying opportunities for efficiencies and implementing process changes
  • Review, administer, and validate contract metadata in the CLM to ensure data accuracy, playbook compliance, and timely responsiveness
  • Monitor in-flight contracts to prevent bottlenecks in review, approval, or e-signature
  • Upload, review against the contracting playbook, and circulate contracts for execution
  • Escalate non-standard or high-risk terms with a clear summary of the issue and a recommended position
  • Track amendments, change orders, renewals, expirations, and key contractual obligations, proactively alerting stakeholders to upcoming deadlines
  • Ensure prime contract requirements are appropriately flowed down to subconsultant and supplier agreements

Stakeholder support and vendor compliance

  • Provide frontline support for contract requesters with system and process questions
  • Partner with Finance and Ops to onboard vendors, suppliers, and subconsultants, contract with them, request COIs, and ensure accurate setup in all systems
  • Manage certificates of insurance, tracking coverage requirements and expirations and following up on deficiencies
  • Train contract requesters and business users on CLM use, contracting processes, and playbook requirements

CLM administration, reporting, and process improvement

  • Prepare reports and analytics based on CLM and vendor portal usage
  • Help develop and keep the Contracting Guidebook and Legal intranet portal up to date
  • Serve as day-to-day administrator of the CLM platform, including user provisioning, template and workflow configuration, and troubleshooting
  • Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, including generative AI tools, to improve contracting speed, quality, and consistency
  • Support Legal team members and other company employees on other tasks, as assigned

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience in commercial contracting, or equivalent legal contracting work, including at least 3 years independently negotiating moderately complex agreements
  • Demonstrated experience owning a CLM implementation or optimization, or a playbook and template program
  • BS/BA from an accredited university; equivalent work experience will be considered
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, and comfort using contract repositories, electronic signature tools, and CLM platforms

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

  • Highly organized and structured, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines, maintain accurate records, and follow through with limited day-to-day direction
  • Excellent oral and written communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to explain contract provisions clearly and work effectively with business partners and outside counsel
  • Desire to work in a dynamic, high-growth, fast-paced, and collaborative environment
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and resourceful
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and integrity
  • Comfortable with, or an interest in learning about, the use of new technologies and software, including generative and agentic artificial intelligence
  • Professional demeanor, high level of integrity, strong business judgment (including knowing when matters require additional facts, attorney review, or escalation), attention to detail, and effective problem-solving skills
  • Alignment with the company’s guiding principles

Additional Requirements:

Preferred qualifications:

  • Admin-level experience with Ironclad or a comparable CLM platform, including building workflows, particularly in the project management and advisory, construction, or energy industries
  • Experience with public-sector or federal contracts, procurement, and flow-down requirements, and familiarity with industry-standard design and construction contract forms (e.g., AIA, ConsensusDocs, EJCDC)

Location: This role may be based anywhere in the continental United States.

Travel: Occasional travel (up to 20%) may be required.


Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $150,000. Actual compensation will be based on level, experience, skills, and location.


What’s In It For You:

  • Comprehensive core benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Employer-paid life and disability coverage
  • A wide range of voluntary benefits, including pet insurance, pre-paid legal, hospitalization, critical illness, and accident insurance
  • 401(k) with day-one eligibility, including a 100% company match on the first 3% of eligible compensation and a 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5%
  • Generous time off, including 10 paid holidays, and a PTO plan that starts at 15 days annually, growing up to 25 days with tenure
  • Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Software Engineer, Computer Backup Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Remote-first How We Got Here Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators.
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Computer Backup

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Remote-first

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team that builds the Backblaze Computer Backup client, the desktop software that protects customers' files in the background on Windows and macOS. We are hiring on both platforms. Each platform has its own dedicated codebase and tools, so you will work in the environment you know best: Visual Studio on Windows or Xcode on macOS.

The core of the client is built and has years of production use behind it. You will take ownership of a proven, widely deployed codebase, keep it healthy, and extend it with new capabilities, support for new operating system releases, and improvements to speed, reliability, and the customer experience. The software you ship runs on customers' own computers and protects the files they care about most, so the impact of your work is direct and visible. This is a remote-first role for an engineer who enjoys understanding how a mature system works and making it better.

What You Will Own

Build

  • Extend the Computer Backup client for your platform, Windows or macOS, delivering new features and improvements in a proven codebase.
  • Support new operating system releases while keeping the client working on the older versions customers still run.
  • Work with Design and Product on customer-facing client features, and with backend engineers on the services the client communicates with.
  • Take part in technical design discussions, write clear design documents, and review code with the rest of the client team.
  • Use AI, including agentic coding tools, to explore unfamiliar code and speed up implementation, testing, and debugging, and help the team adopt good practices with them.

Own

A proven, widely deployed client codebase with years of production use behind it, and the health of that code on your platform:

  • Improve the existing code over time through refactoring, modernization, and stronger test coverage, without disrupting the customers who rely on it.
  • Keep the client efficient, using minimal CPU, memory, disk, and network on the customer's computer.
  • Write unit and automated tests, and work with QA to improve coverage on your platform.
  • Diagnose and fix problems reported by customers, using logs, crash reports, and reproduction on real machines and operating system versions.
  • Keep the client secure and private, including encryption, authentication, and how it stores local data.
  • Take part in client releases, including installation, upgrade, and automatic update behavior.
  • Mentor other engineers, including contractors working on the client, through code review and pairing.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping native desktop applications to customers.
  • Strong day-to-day experience with Visual Studio for Windows development or Xcode for macOS development.
  • Native development experience on your platform: C++ or C#/.NET on Windows, or Swift, Objective-C, or C++ on macOS.
  • Experience with Win32 APIs and/or Microsoft Foundation Classes.
  • Experience working in large, mature codebases: reading unfamiliar code, finding root causes, making safe changes, and adding tests where there are few.
  • Experience with background processes and services, file system work, and operating system APIs on your platform.
  • A thorough understanding of data structures, algorithms, serialization formats, and the tradeoffs among them.
  • Experience building software that is efficient with CPU, memory, disk, and network, and the skill to profile and tune it.
  • Experience supporting several operating system versions at once.
  • Experience with relational databases, especially SQLite.
  • Experience writing and/or maintaining middleware libraries.
  • Strong debugging skills, including diagnosing problems from logs and crash reports on customer machines.
  • Experience writing unit and automated tests and working closely with QA.
  • Uses AI tools effectively in daily development. Familiarity with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex is a plus.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum and a solid grasp of SDLC processes.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain complex concepts simply. Comfortable on a distributed, remote-first team with strong async communication.

Also True of the Right Person

  • Experience with backup, sync, or storage products.
  • Experience with installers, automatic updaters, and code signing on your platform.
  • Experience with encryption, cryptography libraries, and secure handling of keys.
  • Experience with modern native UI frameworks on your platform.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and cloud storage.
  • Experience working with both Xcode and Visual Studio.
  • Familiarity with the details of disk filesystems such as APFS, NTFS, ReFS, etc.
  • Familiarity with Java.

Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture, so even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Backblaze Employee Privacy Notice.

Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make


As a Placement Specialist you will spend your day forming relationships with the clinical placement sites where students can acquire hands-on learning in their field. This role is a hybrid between sales and customer service; Specialists will be responsible for introducing themselves to prospective providers and securing agreement to work with our students, while also providing quality follow-up to ensure a relationship that extends beyond the first placement. The goal is to ensure that each site is more than just a number and is, in fact, a mutually respected, cultivated relationship that continues to yield a quality student experience. Keeping this process personal grows the University's brand by sending prepared and engaged students to sites across the country. Our priority is always on the relationships built at the student, site, and university level.


What You Will Do:

  • Build partnerships with hospitals, community facilities/clinics and other agency sites for students to complete their clinical rotations in a variety if experiences across different specialties and present these sites to the Program Director for approval.
  • Develop leads for possible partnerships with healthcare agencies by identifying suitable clinical sites, negotiating placement agreements, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Manage relationships with existing clinical agency partners to ensure successful clinical experiences for all students.
  • Match students and site in a timely manner to avoid any lapse or delays in class registration.
  • Maintain complete knowledge and understanding of our Partners’ curriculum and programs and clearly explain these curricula and programs to clinical partners.
  • Identify and assess concerns related to clinical experiences; facilitate appropriate intervention with Placement Coordinators, faculty, and Program Coordinators.
  • Working with University Partners and legal teams to secure contracts with sites.
  • Serve as role model for faculty, staff, and students in the areas of customer service, collaboration, communication, and general professionalism.
  • Use relationship skills in situations requiring group problem solving, consensus building, and win-win negotiation.

What You’ll Bring to the Team


Experience That Matters Most:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) required; commensurate experience, (i.e., healthcare/placement) considered
  • 3-5 years of successful demonstration of business development and/or sales competencies. Inside sales and/or sales support skills helpful
  • Solid knowledge of or experience working in healthcare field, directly with or for providers
  • Problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Willingness to collaborate to achieve goals
  • Ability to multi-task, organize, and attend to details
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to develop relationships via phone and in person
  • Self-motivated and able to work autonomously, reporting back to a team

Our salary structure and compensation philosophy reflect the value we place on our employees' experience, education, and skills. We pride ourselves on offering a competitive and fair total rewards package that considers the market.


The salary range for this position is between $54,400 - $64,000. The starting salary will fall somewhere in this range and will be determined by various factors such as experience, location, market conditions, and departmental budgets. You will have the opportunity to discuss your salary expectations during the interview process.

Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ¿Quiénes somos?  En idealista desarrollamos soluciones de datos de alta calidad que apoyan la toma de decisiones en el mercado inmobiliario.
jobs.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

En idealista desarrollamos soluciones de datos de alta calidad que apoyan la toma de decisiones en el mercado inmobiliario. Nuestros productos impulsan el análisis del mercado inmobiliario, la valoración de activos y los insights avanzados para clientes de España, Italia, Portugal ¡y ahora también Francia!

Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un perfil altamente técnico y analítico para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de tecnología, que trabaja en estrecha colaboración con el negocio en idealista/data.

Como Analytics Engineer, tendrás un papel clave en la explotación eficiente de nuestros datos:

  • Diseñar, construir y orquestar pipelines que transformen datos en bruto en datasets listos para el cliente.

  • Desarrollar queries SQL optimizadas y procesos ETL escalables.

  • Automatizar workflows clave con Airflow y dbt, migrando a ese stack desde frameworks internos.

  • Monitorizar los productos de forma continua para garantizar una entrega de datos fiable.

  • Refactorizar y optimizar los data pipelines existentes para mejorar el rendimiento, la fiabilidad y la mantenibilidad.

  • Documentar procesos y construir fuentes de datos reutilizables y mantenibles.

  • Colaborar con la unidad de negocio idealista/data para construir mejores productos de datos, coordinándote con el equipo de data governance y con otros equipos de datos para ser lo más eficaces posible.

El puesto también implica realizar análisis exploratorios para identificar mejoras y aportar recomendaciones con impacto en el negocio. Una parte fundamental de tu trabajo será adaptar las soluciones existentes a nuevos mercados y necesidades, buscando siempre eficiencia, escalabilidad y robustez.

El puesto es full remote, pero esperamos que nos acompañes presencialmente en:

  • Las sesiones de onboarding.

  • Los eventos sociales.

  • Al menos una reunión trimestral con el equipo.

Valoramos la iniciativa, la colaboración y la capacidad de traducir las necesidades de negocio en productos de datos útiles y sostenibles.

Qué harás

  • Construir y mantener data pipelines para entregar métricas y datasets de alta calidad.

  • Orquestar workflows con Apache Airflow, dbt y Clickhouse.

  • Optimizar queries SQL y diseñar transformaciones eficientes para distintas necesidades de segmentación (tiempo, geografía, tipo de producto).

  • Monitorizar la salud de los pipelines, resolver incidencias e identificar de forma proactiva oportunidades para mejorar su escalabilidad y fiabilidad.

  • Realizar análisis exploratorios para proponer mejoras y generar impacto en el negocio.

  • Colaborar estrechamente con expertos de negocio y con los equipos de data engineering.

  • Documentar código, procesos y productos de datos para favorecer la reutilización y la escalabilidad.

  • Compartir conocimiento y acompañar a tus compañeros dentro del Data Crew.

  • Dar soporte a proyectos de advanced analytics proporcionando datasets limpios y fiables.

Qué esperamos de ti

Imprescindibles

  • Nivel alto de SQL (incluida la optimización de rendimiento) y de Python.

  • Experiencia en orquestación de workflows (Airflow o similar).

  • Buen conocimiento del desarrollo de pipelines ELT.

  • Atención al detalle y foco en la data quality.

  • Capacidad de colaborar con equipos de negocio y traducir sus necesidades en soluciones.

Deseables

  • Experiencia con dbt, Airflow y Clickhouse.

  • Conocimiento de datos inmobiliarios o financieros.

  • Conocimiento a nivel usuario de la infraestructura AWS Cloud.

  • Familiaridad con data modeling, testing y buenas prácticas de CI/CD.

  • Experiencia con Git y con monitorización en producción.

¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

  • Trabajarás en productos de datos que los clientes usan a diario para tomar decisiones de alto valor.

  • Colaborarás con un equipo cualificado y pragmático que valora soluciones simples, robustas y listas para producción.

  • Desarrollarás tu especialización en pipeline engineering, analytics engineering y diseño de productos de datos.

  • Formarás parte de una compañía que está transformando el mercado inmobiliario con innovación basada en datos.

  • Disfrutarás de una cultura remote-first con momentos presenciales significativos para conectar como equipo.

Y algo más sobre nosotros…

Desde que iniciamos esta aventura en el año 2000, idealista es mucho más que una compañía.

Es una cultura, una forma de hacer y entender las cosas que nos diferencia. El respeto, la tolerancia, la integridad y la transparencia forman parte de nuestro ADN.

Contamos con un equipo de personas que representa a más de 20 nacionalidades distintas, con idiomas diversos, perfiles, culturas y orígenes diferentes. Valoramos la diferencia y aprender de los demás; diferentes creencias y formas de pensar nos enriquecen.

idealista fomenta la igualdad en todos los ámbitos, realizando acciones de sensibilización y visibilidad del colectivo LGTB+ entre los empleados/as, en la publicidad y en la comunidad en general.

Tenemos el compromiso de crear entornos y espacios donde las personas se sientan seguras, protegidas, libres de discriminación y primando la igualdad de oportunidades.

Asimismo, la promoción de la igualdad de género es otra de las bases de nuestro compromiso con nuestro equipo. Estamos comprometidos con el desarrollo de medidas que fomenten la igualdad y favorezcan la conciliación, maternidad y paternidad.

¿Te imaginas formando parte del equipo? ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

jobs.title: Senior Director, Media Measurement & Effectiveness
jobs.excerpt: Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns.
jobs.description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at .

About this position:

Later is looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial Senior Director to build and lead our media measurement practice, with a focus on social and creator marketing. Sitting within Performance Media in our Services organization, you'll help brands understand how paid amplification and organic creator programs influence brand perception, retail sales, and consumer behavior. You'll partner with Performance Media, Managed Services, Strategy, and Client Success to shape measurement from pre-sale planning through study delivery and client recommendations.

This is a builder role: you'll take immediate ownership of active brand lift studies across simulated and natural exposure methodologies, then expand our offering across retail and sales lift, incrementality, visitation, and creative effectiveness. You'll initially operate as an individual contributor, personally leading study design, execution, and interpretation with support from an established Performance Media team. As the practice scales, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape a dedicated measurement team.

What you'll be doing:

Measurement Strategy

  • Own Later's media effectiveness strategy across paid social and organic creator marketing, connecting campaign objectives to measurable brand and business outcomes.
  • Define when and how to use brand lift, retail sales measurement, sales lift, incrementality testing, visitation studies, and creative effectiveness research based on client objectives, budget, and study feasibility.
  • Develop measurement approaches for key verticals, including online and offline sales impact for CPG and retail brands and foot traffic for location-based businesses.
  • Establish a preferred measurement partner ecosystem and a roadmap for scaling commercially viable measurement offerings.

Study Design & Execution

  • Take immediate ownership of existing brand lift programs, including simulated and natural exposure studies, from research brief and questionnaire design through fieldwork, interpretation, and client delivery.
  • Lead retail sales, sales lift, visitation, and creative effectiveness studies, coordinating with measurement partners and media teams on data requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Design and oversee incrementality tests using appropriate test and control approaches, including randomized holdouts or matched-market designs where feasible.
  • Build repeatable study workflows, quality controls, measurement benchmarks, and reporting standards that improve consistency and turnaround times.
  • Translate study findings into clear client recommendations on creator selection, creative strategy, audience approach, and media investment, explaining what each methodology can and cannot establish.

Client & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Sales and Strategy to scope and price credible measurement plans for client proposals, setting clear expectations for study requirements and deliverables.
  • Embed measurement into campaign planning with Performance Media, Managed Services, and Client Success so objectives, exposure requirements, and test conditions are established before launch.
  • Collaborate with Research, Data, and technical partners on study-specific survey, exposure, and sales data requirements, and equip client teams to explain findings accurately.

Practice Leadership & Development

  • Build the practice's operating model, priorities, and delivery standards while personally leading studies and resolving methodological challenges.
  • Evaluate, negotiate, and manage third-party measurement partnerships, balancing methodological rigor, study quality, cost, scalability, and client value.
  • Define future resource needs and recruit, develop, and lead measurement specialists as client demand and investment in the practice grow.
  • Advance Later's capabilities through developments in social platform measurement, experimentation, retail measurement, and privacy-conscious research, introducing solutions that address clear client needs.

What success looks like:

  • First 30 days: Active brand lift studies have clear ownership, delivery plans, and quality expectations, with priority improvements identified across methodology, workflows, and client communication.
  • First 90 days: Repeatable brand lift workflows and study design, interpretation, and partner-management standards are in place, supported by a prioritized roadmap for retail sales measurement, incrementality, and creative testing.
  • By 6 months: Priority measurement offerings have defined methodologies, preferred partners, scoping and pricing guidance, and delivery processes, with initial studies launched where client demand and feasibility support them.
  • By 12 months: Later has a scalable media measurement practice that delivers credible evidence of brand and business impact, informs client investment decisions, and has a clear resourcing plan, with dedicated hiring aligned to business demand.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If your experience aligns with this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

  • Progressive experience leading media effectiveness, advertising research, or marketing science programs, with ownership of strategy, study delivery, and senior client relationships at a Director or Senior Director scope.
  • Deep expertise in survey-based brand lift research, including simulated and natural exposure methodologies, questionnaire design, sampling, statistical interpretation, and study limitations.
  • Direct experience with retail sales measurement, sales lift, and incrementality testing, including selecting appropriate test and control approaches and interpreting online and offline sales outcomes. Experience with visitation studies and creative effectiveness research is also valuable.
  • Experience evaluating and managing third-party measurement providers, including methodology assessment, commercial negotiations, and study delivery. Familiarity with ThisThat, Circana, ABCS Insights, InMarket, Samba TV, Precisely / PlaceIQ, or comparable providers is an asset.
  • The research and statistical judgment to personally lead studies, assess data quality, challenge unsupported conclusions, and translate findings into clear recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Proven success building measurement capabilities, workflows, service offerings, or teams, with an entrepreneurial approach to ambiguity and the ability to establish the foundation as an individual contributor before scaling a team.
  • Strong client communication and cross-functional leadership, with the ability to shape proposals, explain methodological tradeoffs, influence stakeholders, and develop measurement talent. Experience tailoring programs to CPG, retail, entertainment, or other consumer verticals is a plus.

How we work:

  • We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
  • We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
  • We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
  • We deeply understand our business: If we don't have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
  • We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range: $160-200k

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

About Event Temple

Event Temple is a high-growth technology company headquartered in Vancouver, BC, Canada. As the world’s leading Hotel Sales and Catering software, we've achieved the #1 ranking in the Hotel Tech Awards for four consecutive years. Our mission is to become the world's largest, most respected sales and catering software for venues and hotels while creating success, happiness, and opportunity for our customers, team, and communities.

The Opportunity

You’ll own net-new revenue for the DACH region. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy contractor role focused on outbound-led acquisition. You’ll target individual hotels and management groups, run structured sales cycles, and land multi-property rollouts. You won’t inherit a territory; you’ll build one.

Role type: Contractor.

Build Your Market

  • Own the DACH territory and build your pipeline from the ground up.
  • Win business across the whole hotel ecosystem: groups, management companies and independents, plus the consultants and tech vendors who shape what they buy.
  • Spot the bigger opportunity early: land one property, then grow across the portfolio.

Run the Deal

  • Lead every stage yourself, from first discovery call to signed contract.
  • Build relationships across the property and the portfolio: sales and revenue leaders, operations, GMs, ownership and the C-suite.
  • Give demos that show the money: more revenue, lower costs, hours given back to the team.

Keep It Moving

  • Carry 10–15 live opportunities at any time.
  • Know where every deal stands and what it needs next.
  • Forecast accurately, plan your territory, and come to pipeline reviews with clear answers.

Be in the Room

  • Be the face of Event Temple for owners and management groups in the region.
  • Show up at the industry events and partner meetings that matter.
  • Travel up to one week a month to push key deals forward, open new doors, and help customers launch.

A Week in This Role Might Look Like

  • Running demos with hotels and management groups you sourced yourself.
  • Reaching out to the accounts on your target list.
  • Getting a few deals across the line on commercials.
  • Sitting down with a GM, revenue leader or ownership team, on-site or on Zoom.
  • Finding the next properties to bring on inside a group that just signed.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 5+ years selling B2B SaaS into hotels, travel or hospitality (PMS, CRS, RMS, S&C, distribution or similar), with a track record of winning new logos.
  • Proven success in a role like this one: selling a complex, multi-stakeholder product to hotel groups and management companies, and growing single-property wins into portfolio rollouts.
  • Strong working knowledge of the hotel tech stack and how the systems connect (PMS, CRM, RMS, POS, integrations). You can hold your own in a technical conversation with an IT director or a systems consultant.
  • A network across DACH hospitality, or the drive to build one fast.

Skills & Mindset

  • You run discovery like an operator: you ask the questions a GM would ask.
  • You’re credible with owners, GMs and commercial directors because you understand how hotels make money and how their systems work.
  • You’re disciplined about forecasting, CRM and follow-through.
  • You’re self-directed and energised by building a territory from scratch.
  • You’re creative about getting in the door and turning one property into a portfolio.

The Practical Bits

  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written.
  • Germany based (Munich or Berlin preferred).
  • Able to travel across DACH region and Europe.
  • Comfortable working remotely as a contractor.
  • Driven by closing deals and accountable for your own number.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll be the face of Event Temple across DACH. Early wins here determine how we land management groups, scale into key markets, and build long-term regional footprint. You’ll help shape our DACH go-to-market approach while driving meaningful revenue and expansion.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • High autonomy and ownership.
  • A supportive, collaborative team.

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models, from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings, helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We have led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we are building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora and Workday now sell Zuora Billing and Revenue together under one Workday contract. This role makes that partnership win technically in Workday Financial Management (FINS) accounts, both net-new and existing. You will work alongside Workday and Zuora AEs, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, and you will own the technical win.

  • Scope and build proofs of concept as the primary mechanism for technical proof, with a forward-deployed engineer mindset, working hands-on with APIs, events, and data integrations between Zuora and Workday tenants

jobs.description:
1. Votre rôle

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Learning Groupe, rattaché(e) à la Directrice Learning Groupe. Votre temps se partage en deux parties à répartir :

  • La moitié sur le pilotage du Learning & Development pour une zone internationale en pleine dynamisation

  • L’autre moitié sur des projets Learning Groupe, en particulier autour de l’IA, de ses usages et de son adoption et de ses impacts sur nos métiers mais aussi des programmes stratégiques autour du Leadership ou encore du business.

Au quotidien, vous travaillez avec l’équipe L&D Groupe, les managers, les experts métiers, les RH locales, les partenaires de formation et les communautés internes. Le rôle demande de faire tourner l’existant avec rigueur et, en même temps, de construire les dispositifs de demain.

  1. Vos missions

  1. Piloter le Learning de la zone internationale (50 %)

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur ou l’interlocutrice Learning de référence pour les pays de la zone. Vous prenez en charge les actions de formation de bout en bout, du besoin jusqu’au bilan.

Déploiement des compétences

  • Vous recueillez, analysez et qualifiez les demandes de formation individuelles et collectives.

  • Vous conseillez les RH et les managers sur les solutions adaptées aux besoins, aux priorités et aux budgets.

  • Vous repérez les besoins communs à plusieurs pays pour mutualiser formations et ressources, en lien avec l’équipe L&D

Gestion des actions de formation et certification

  • Vous coordonnez les organismes de formation, les formateurs, les experts internes et les autres partenaires.

Budget, données et indicateurs

  • Vous pilotez le budget de votre zone.

  • Vous garantissez la fiabilité des données dans les outils Learning.

  • Vous produisez et suivez les indicateurs clés : participation, complétion, satisfaction, certifications, consommation budgétaire et avancement des plans.

Adoption et amélioration continue

  • Vous accompagnez le déploiement des outils et dispositifs Learning Groupe auprès des équipes locales, en les adaptant aux réalités de chaque pays.

  1. Contribuer aux projets stratégiques Learning Groupe focus IA (50 %)

Vous participez à la conception et au déploiement de programmes structurants pour tout le Groupe : développement des compétences IA, parcours métiers, Leadership, onboarding ou programmes liés aux transformations de l’entreprise.

  • Vous cadrez les besoins avec les sponsors, les managers, les experts métiers et les équipes RH.

  • Vous pilotez les projets : objectifs, populations cibles, planning, livrables, parties prenantes, communication, risques et indicateurs de succès.

  • Vous co-concevez des parcours multimodaux adaptés aux besoins des métiers en lien avec des partenaires extérieurs.

  • Vous créez des kits, guides et supports réutilisables qui facilitent le déploiement.

  • Vous accompagnez managers, RH, experts et ambassadeurs dans l’adoption des nouveaux programmes.

  • Vous suivez l’adoption, l’engagement et l’impact des dispositifs, puis proposez des ajustements.

  • Vous assurez une veille sur les nouvelles pratiques Learning et les technologies émergentes.

  1. Faire de l’IA un levier concret pour le Learning

L’IA occupe une place importante dans le poste, sur les deux volets. Votre rôle est de transformer ce qu’elle permet en usages Learning utiles, adoptés et responsables.

  • Vous identifiez et formalisez des cas d’usage IA pour le Learning et le développement des compétences.

  • Vous concevez et améliorez des prompts pour la recherche, l’analyse, la synthèse, la conception pédagogique, la création de contenus, la communication ou encore le reporting.

  • Vous expérimentez l’IA générative pour accélérer la conception de parcours, la curation de contenus, l’accompagnement des apprenants ou le reporting.

  • Vous participez à des pilotes autour d'agents IA, avec nos experts Transformation et nos équipes techniques

  • Vous contribuez à l’acculturation et à l’adoption de l’IA auprès de publics variés.

  • Vous gardez un regard critique sur les résultats produits par l’IA et appliquez les règles de confidentialité, de sécurité, d’éthique et de gouvernance

Vous avez au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Learning & Development, en formation, en développement des compétences ou en gestion de projets RH ou Learning.

  1. Learning et gestion de projet

  • Vous avez piloté des actions de formation de bout en bout, de l’expression du besoin jusqu’à l’évaluation.

  • Vous savez mener plusieurs demandes, formations et projets en parallèle avec des temporalités différentes.

  • Vous avez l’habitude de coordonner différentes parties prenantes.

  • Vous avez déjà suivi des budgets, des fournisseurs, des commandes et des indicateurs Learning.

  • Vous maîtrisez les bases de la gestion de projet : cadrage, planification, suivi, risques, livrables et reporting.

  • Vous connaissez les principes de l’ingénierie pédagogique, du digital learning et de l’expérience apprenant et vous êtes curieux des nouveautés L&D.

  • La connaissance des certifications professionnelles, surtout dans l’IT, et de leur cycle de gestion est un plus.

  1. IA et outils digitaux

Nous ne cherchons pas un profil technique ou un AI Engineer. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui comprend ce que l’IA permet, l’essaie et en fait des usages Learning pertinents.

  • Vous êtes attentif ou attentive à la confidentialité, à la sécurité et à l’usage responsable de l’IA. Vous savez prendre de la distance critique et évitez les compier-coller sans vérification.

  1. Savoir-être

  • Vous êtes curieux ou curieuse, vous aimez expérimenter et vous gardez un regard critique.

  • Vous aimez transmettre, accompagner les utilisateurs et transformer une idée en solution simple et concrète.

  • Vous aimez travailler dans un contexte mouvant, avec des challenges permanents.

  1. Formation, langues et mobilité

  • Vous avez un Bac+5 en RH, Learning & Development, ingénierie pédagogique, management, gestion de projet ou domaine proche. Une expérience équivalente sera aussi étudiée.

  • Votre anglais professionnel est de niveau C1 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Il sera évalué pendant le recrutement. Vous êtes à l’aise pour parler et écrire avec tous les niveaux managériaux.

  • Vous parlez couramment français.

  • Vous pouvez vous déplacer ponctuellement dans les pays de la zone.

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases mais vous vous reconnaissez dans l’essentiel du poste ? Postulez. Votre curiosité et votre capacité à apprendre comptent autant qu’une correspondance parfaite avec cette liste.

We Elevate. Digitally.

SQLI, leader européen de l’expérience client et de la transformation digitale, aide les grandes marques internationales à créer de la valeur grâce à la technologie et à l’innovation digitale. De la stratégie au déploiement des actifs technologiques de nos clients, nous imaginons et construisons des architectures robustes et performantes ainsi que des expériences engageantes en combinant technologies de pointe, méthodologies éprouvées et expertise technologique approfondie.

jobs.title: Stress Engineer (Aerospace)
jobs.excerpt: NAXCON GmbH, headquartered in Weil am Rhein with additional offices, including Stuttgart, is one of Germany's leading engineering and IT service providers.
jobs.description:
NAXCON GmbH, headquartered in Weil am Rhein with additional offices, including Stuttgart, is one of Germany's leading engineering and IT service providers.

Our experts possess extensive expertise in software and hardware development, modern electronics, and cutting-edge technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI).

In addition to delivering high-quality engineering solutions for our customers, we are passionate about driving our own innovation projects as well as research and development activities. Renowned companies from a wide range of industries place their trust in our expertise, reflecting the outstanding knowledge, professionalism, and commitment of our engineers.

Position: Stress Engineer

Location: Wesseling, Germany

Field: Aerospace

Type: Full-time/100% Remote

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Aerospace Stress Engineer to support structural analysis and certification activities for the Seastar aircraft programme.

The successful candidate will perform detailed structural strength analyses of metallic and composite aircraft components, applying established engineering calculation methodologies and finite element analysis techniques.

The position involves preparing structural substantiation documents and certification reports, ensuring technical accuracy, consistency and full traceability of engineering results.

The engineer will collaborate closely with the client's engineering team and the Stress Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE) throughout the analysis, review and approval process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed structural stress analyses in accordance with established engineering methods, standards, and processes.
  • Conduct static strength analyses of metallic aircraft structures and components.
  • Perform metallic Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) assessments.
  • Conduct static strength and Fatigue & Damage Tolerance analyses of composite aircraft structures.
  • Apply classical engineering calculations and Finite Element Analysis (FEA/FEM) methods to assess structural performance.
  • Define and document analysis input data, boundary conditions and relevant load cases.
  • Develop, evaluate and maintain finite element models and associated calculation files.
  • Analyze simulation results and perform post-processing of structural analysis outputs.
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive structural stress certification reports using client-defined formats.
  • Ensure consistency and full traceability between engineering input data, calculation files, simulation results and final reports.
  • Review preliminary analysis results with the client's engineering team and Stress CVE.
  • Incorporate technical feedback and update engineering calculations and documentation accordingly.
  • Prepare technical presentations summarizing analysis methodologies and key results when required.
  • Support colleagues working in Flight Test, Production, Systems Engineering and Airworthiness.
  • Coordinate technical issues with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Maintain structured documentation and comply with project quality requirements.
  • Work independently and deliver assigned engineering activities within agreed deadlines.
  • Travel occasionally to project locations within the European Union.

Required Technical Expertise

  • Strong background in aerospace structural engineering and aircraft stress analysis.
  • Practical experience analyzing metallic and composite aircraft structures.
  • Sound knowledge of static strength analysis and Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) methodologies.
  • Proficiency in Finite Element Analysis (FEA/FEM) and classical hand calculation techniques.
  • Ability to define structural boundary conditions, load cases and relevant engineering assumptions.
  • Experience developing and evaluating finite element models and simulation results.
  • Strong understanding of engineering calculation methods and structural substantiation principles.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, structural design information and technical specifications.
  • Experience preparing technical analysis reports and structural certification documentation.
  • Strong analytical thinking and systematic problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail, quality and engineering documentation accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings effectively with engineering teams and reviewers.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks independently and meet project deadlines.

Key Deliverables

1. Complete Structural Analysis and Calculation Packages

  • Engineering input data, boundary conditions and load cases.
  • Classical hand calculations and supporting calculation spreadsheets.
  • Engineering scripts used in the analyses, where applicable.
  • Finite element models and associated input decks.
  • Simulation output files and post-processing results.
  • Intermediate calculations and results required to maintain full technical traceability.

2. Stress Certification Reports

  • Draft structural stress certification reports.
  • Final structural stress certification reports in Microsoft Word format.
  • Complete and consistent technical evidence supporting the analysis conclusions.

3. Technical Presentations

  • Presentation materials outlining the analysis approach, key assumptions and principal findings, when required.

4. Engineering Documentation

  • Analysis documentation and reporting aligned with company requirements and CVE review expectations.

What we offer:

  • International Working Environment: Join a diverse and multicultural team where people from different backgrounds and cultures collaborate to achieve outstanding results.
  • German Language Development: Whether you are a beginner or an advanced speaker, we provide a supportive environment to help you improve your German language skills.
  • Dedicated Point of Contact: You will have a personal contact within the company who will support and guide you throughout your employment.
  • Professional Growth: Our engineers have the opportunity to work on exciting projects across different industries, continuously expanding their expertise and developing new skills.
  • Regular Team Events: We organize regular company events to strengthen team spirit, encourage collaboration, and create a positive working atmosphere.
  • Competitive Compensation: We value our employees and offer an attractive compensation package that reflects your qualifications, experience, and performance.

  • Strong RMAN backup and recovery experience.
  • Proven performance tuning skills (AWR, ASH, SQL tuning).
