Overview

Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities!

We currently have an opportunity for a Sr. Manager, Demand Generation & Shopper Activation. This is a remote opportunity reporting to our Corporate Headquarters in Lake Forest, IL.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Manager, Demand Generation & Shopper Activation is a commercially minded marketing professional responsible for planning and executing shopper marketing programs that improve visibility, engagement and conversion at the shelf, online and in-store. Working in close partnership with Customer/Sales teams, Brand, Ecommerce, Retail Media, Insights and agency partners, this role translates established brand strategies and customer priorities into retailer-specific activation, manages program execution and budgets, and uses shopper and retailer data to continuously improve results and drive profitable growth.

You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!

Shopper Marketing & Retail Activation

  • Plans and executes shopper marketing programs in partnership with Customer/Sales teams, translating brand and customer priorities into retailer-specific activation that improves visibility, engagement and conversion in-store and online.
  • Develops and manages connected programs spanning merchandising, displays, seasonal events, promotions, retailer content, digital shelf and in-store and online shopper activation.
  • Builds and maintains activation plans for priority retailers, including Walmart, Amazon, Target, Club, Grocery and other strategic customers, and contributes shopper insights and activation ideas to customer conversations and Joint Business Plans.
  • Manages program timelines, retailer deadlines, display and fixture development, and in-market execution, coordinating with Sales, Supply Chain, Packaging and agency partners to deliver on time and within budget.
  • Manages assigned shopper marketing budgets and agency relationships, tracking spend and program ROI and recommending adjustments to maximize return on trade and marketing investment.

Brand-to-Shelf Alignment

  • Partners with Brand teams to translate established brand strategies, consumer priorities and jobs-to-be-done into shopper-relevant activation that stays consistent with the brand proposition across retailers and formats.
  • Uses shopper insights, retailer signals and category trends to sharpen program ideas, and shares activation learnings with Brand teams to inform future planning.

Consumer-to-Commerce Connection

  • Partners with Retail Media Network and Commerce Media teams to connect shopper marketing programs to retailer-specific conversion opportunities and ensure retail media supports in-store and online activation.
  • Aligns retailer search, digital shelf, PDP content, merchandising, promotion and availability with shopper programs to improve the path from the shelf or search results through purchase.
  • Uses retailer and commerce signals to continuously improve program content, targeting and execution.

Performance, Analytics & Optimization

  • Partners with Analytics & Insights to establish KPIs, hypotheses and post-event evaluations for shopper programs, with a focus on conversion, incrementality and business outcomes.
  • Uses shopper, retailer and sales data to optimize, scale or discontinue programs, and applies learnings to improve future planning and execution.
  • Documents and shares best practices and learnings across Brand, Customer and Digital teams to improve execution quality and speed.

  • You listen, learn, and evolve
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • You put safety first, always
  • You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals
  • You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
  • You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences

Qualifications

Education/Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience to successfully perform the essential functions of the position.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in shopper marketing, trade marketing, retail activation, category management, ecommerce or integrated marketing, ideally within CPG or another consumer-led business.

Preferred

  • Experience with retail media and digital shelf optimization and connecting them to shopper marketing programs.
  • Experience supporting Walmart, Amazon, Target, Club or Grocery customer teams.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Demonstrated experience executing shopper marketing programs with Customer/Sales organizations and major retailers.
  • Working knowledge of in-store merchandising, displays, promotions and digital commerce, with experience using data to evaluate and improve program performance.
  • Experience managing budgets and agency or vendor partners.
  • Strong understanding of shopper behavior, in-store merchandising, retailer programs, retail media, ecommerce and digital shelf, and the relationship between physical and digital retail.
  • Commercial orientation with the ability to connect shopper marketing activity to sales, conversion and profitable growth.
  • Ability to use shopper, retail and sales data to establish KPIs, frame hypotheses and translate performance into clear decisions.
  • Ability to influence Brand, Sales, Ecommerce, Insights and agency partners without relying on direct authority.
  • Strong project management, organization and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment and adapting to retailer and business priorities.

Competencies

  • Strategic Mindset – Connects near-term activation choices to the longer-term customer, brand, and omnichannel growth agenda while balancing demand creation and demand capture.
  • Business Insight – Applies understanding of customer economics, category dynamics, retailer priorities, and media performance to recommend investments that improve incremental sales and profitable growth.

We are looking for people who bring excitement and energy to our organization, are curious and eager to learn, and want to help drive our programs forward.

  • Support build and test by helping prepare and review travelers, work instructions, and inspection records
  • Collect, analyze, and chart quality metrics for monthly reporting and management review
  • Help prepare for and participate in internal audits
  • Assist with drawing and design review checklists, and help track action items to closure
  • Support contamination control
  • Apply industrial engineering principles (process mapping, time studies, workflow and layout analysis) to identify and reduce inefficiencies in build, inspection, and test flows
  • Support lean manufacturing initiatives such as 5S, standard work, value stream mapping, and mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) to improve quality and throughput
  • Identify and support process improvements that make receiving, storage, and build kitting faster and more reliable

Requirements

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or a related field
  • Rising juniors, seniors, or graduate students only
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Preferred: Familiarity with ERP or inventory management systems, quality standards (e.g., AS9100, ISO 9001), or reading engineering drawings
  • Highly preferred: Prior experience in a hardware, manufacturing, or aerospace environment

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible work hours
  • Free Scout Swag!
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth
  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment at the forefront of space technology
  • Be a part of a team that is making history!
  • Compensation is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Standard pay for these internships is $30/hour.

Don't fulfill all the qualifications listed above? If you still feel like you might be a good fit, please feel free to APPLY ANYWAY. We believe in a well-rounded team, and this sometimes means that someone with out-of-context knowledge can contribute just as well as someone with very explicit alignment with our capabilities needs stated.

Our positions are based in Reston, Virginia, with much of our team operating in a hybrid or remote fashion.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

To conform to US Government space technology export regulations, applicants must be a US citizen, lawful permanent resident of the US, a protected individual as defined by 8 USC 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorization from the US Department of State.

We’re Proud to Prioritize Mental Health. Scout Space has been recognized with the Bell Seal for Workplace Mental Health by Mental Health America. jobs.excerpt: Join the ACI Learning Adventure!  Our Mission Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success.
jobs.description:
Join the ACI Learning Adventure!

Our Mission

Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.

We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.

The ACI Team

Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.

Purpose-Driven Culture

At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.

Your Opportunity

Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!

Who We Are

ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.

Most business development roles stop at the handoff. This one doesn’t. You’ll spend the bulk of your week opening new commercial conversations for our Account Executive team, and you’ll also carry a small book of your own that you close yourself. If you want to prospect and you want to sell, and you’d rather not wait two years for permission to do the second one, this is a rare place to do both.

What you’ll do

ACI Learning trains people in cybersecurity, IT, and audit. A lot of organizations need exactly that and have never heard of us. Your job is to find them and start the conversation.

Roughly 80 percent of your time is outbound. You’ll research target accounts, build lists that reflect who actually buys from us, and run real outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video. When a conversation turns into something real, you’ll hand it to an Account Executive with enough context that they can pick it up without starting from zero.

The other 20 percent is yours to close. Interest comes through our eCommerce funnel every day, and some of it comes from small teams rather than individual learners. Those opportunities are too big for a checkout page and too small to pull an Account Executive off enterprise work. When a team of three to five needs licenses, you run it end to end: discovery, demo, quote, objections, close. Anything smaller goes to self-service. Anything larger goes to an Account Executive with your qualification attached.

Specifically, you’ll:

  • Run consistent outbound prospecting across multiple channels to create new commercial opportunities
  • Research accounts and build target lists aligned to our ideal customer profile and territory priorities
  • Qualify inbound leads against agreed criteria and act on them quickly
  • Book discovery meetings for Account Executives and make sure they actually happen
  • Hand off with real notes: qualification, stakeholders, and a scheduled next step
  • Own the full sales cycle for three to five seat opportunities, from qualified through closed
  • Build quotes, work through pricing and objections, and process orders to completion
  • Keep your CRM records current daily
  • Tell marketing the truth about lead quality and what messaging is landing
  • Bring recurring objections and pricing friction back to our eCommerce, marketing, and product teams

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • At least one year of business development, sales development, or inside sales experience in a business-to-business environment
  • A track record of consistently hitting activity and pipeline generation targets
  • Genuine outbound ability. You can build pipeline without waiting on inbound volume
  • Working proficiency with a CRM and a sales engagement or sequencing platform
  • Comfort running a transactional sales cycle on your own, including pricing conversations and objection handling
  • Clear writing and speaking, with enough credibility to hold a real business conversation with a technical or operational buyer
  • The ability to manage your own time, priorities, and output in a fully remote role

What we’d like you to have

  • Experience in education technology, SaaS, IT training, or the cybersecurity, audit, or IT skills market
  • Experience at a company that runs both self-service and sales-assisted motions
  • Exposure to sales organizations with multiple segments and defined account routing rules

What we require

  • Based in the United States and able to work remotely full time
  • A dedicated, distraction-free workspace with reliable high-speed internet
  • Availability during standard business hours aligned to your assigned territory
  • Sustained use of a computer, headset, and phone, with frequent phone and video conversation throughout the day

What we’re counting on from you

  • That you prospect consistently rather than in bursts. The rhythm matters as much as the volume
  • That the opportunities you pass along get accepted by Account Executives, because you qualified them properly the first time
  • That the meetings you book actually happen
  • That the three to five seat deals you own get closed, and that the revenue shows up
  • That deals land in the right motion. Sending one to the wrong place costs us either margin or speed
  • That the CRM reflects reality. If it isn’t in the system, it didn’t happen

If you’ve spent the last year booking meetings for other people and you’re ready to start closing some of your own, we’d like to hear from you.

OTE (On-Target Earnings) is the total compensation you can expect—combining your base salary and variable bonus—when you achieve your performance goals. It’s designed to reward you for hitting quota and give a clear picture of your earning potential.

OTE
$80,000—$80,000 USD

Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move

For Full-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.

Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.

Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.

401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.

One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.

Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

jobs.excerpt: Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About 6sense

Over the last 18 months, we have been transforming 6sense from a traditional ABM provider into a destination and partner for our customers’ agentic go-to-market.

We are well positioned to lead. Our intelligence rests on 13 years of enterprise buyer data, more than one billion intent signals, and a semantic context layer that makes every signal explainable. This differentiated data layer is a strong moat for our business and differentiates our agents and activations.

6sense combines a healthy enterprise software business with fast-growing advertising (20% growth) and data and intelligence (20% growth) businesses, alongside emerging businesses in managed services and agentic activations. Enterprise customers including Cisco, NetApp, Thomson Reuters, Dell, and NVIDIA trust us with their go-to-market.

The Opportunity

Our product offerings are ready, but the market does not know it yet. We carry a legacy brand in a quiet category, and our product has moved faster than our story. Our Board and executive team are committed to investing in marketing and building a category-leading company.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Storytelling & Communications to reposition 6sense, define and shape the agentic go-to-market category, and make our story impossible to ignore and easy to repeat. In partnership with leadership, you’llset the strategy and execute it through internal use cases, thought leadership, customer stories, influencers, and communications that educate the market on our new offerings.

This is not a traditional content leadership role. You’ll own our content editorial strategy and agenda and be one of the people telling the story yourself. The role combines a storyteller’s instincts, an evangelist’s presence, the strategic judgment of a senior marketing leader, and the discipline to lead an AI-enabled content and communications organization.

What You’ll Own

Define the Narrative and Shape the Category

  • Partner with the CMO and executive leadership team to reposition 6sense and define and shape the agentic go-to-market category. Establish the point of view, language, and frameworks that help the market understand what is changing, why it matters, and why 6sense should lead.
  • Build one narrative architecture connecting company strategy, product innovation, customer proof, thought leadership research, and executive voice. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand to make our story differentiated, credible, and consistent across audiences and channels.
  • Lead sustained market education on how agentic go-to-market changes the way teams work, where people and agents fit, and how customers can begin the transition.
  • Turn customer insight, internal use cases, and product innovation into evidence-led stories. Mobilize executives, customers, and influencers to carry those ideas into the market, and assess whether they are changing understanding and earning adoption. 

Lead the Team and Content Strategy 

  • Lead an approximately five-person team spanning earned media/PR, executive communications/internal communications, social media/influencer marketing, content strategy/blog, and customer stories.
  • Coach and develop the team; set clear priorities and editorial standards. Build AI-enabled ways of working that increase leverage without compromising quality, trust, or voice. Focus resources on stories that move the market rather than content that fills a calendar.
  • Set the voice and storytelling principles that make our work unmistakably ours. Bring customer stories to the center of the narrative and adapt strong ideas across editorial, social, earned media, campaigns, and executive channels.

Build Market Influence and Executive Voice 

  • Be a visible company spokesperson on stages, in media, on podcasts, and at customer and industry events. Build relationships with journalists, analysts, influencers, customers, and partners that help us lead the conversation.
  • Partner with the CEO, CMO, and executive team on keynote narratives, thought leadership, and major company moments. Challenge ideas constructively and help executives turn complexity into compelling stories.

Connect Employees and Drive Growth 

  • Own the internal narrative and content for executive messaging, company-wide meetings, organizational announcements, and employee storytelling. Help employees understand our strategy, progress, and culture—and tell a consistent story themselves.
  • Partner with Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand, Sales, Product, and GTM Enablement to bring the narrative into launches, campaigns, customer moments, and field-ready conversations that support consideration, advocacy, pipeline, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like 

The market can explain what 6sense stands for and why we are different. Our category language and research earn attention and adoption; executives become recognized voices; customers become central storytellers; and employees and sales teams tell a coherent, compelling story. We measure influence, buyer engagement, advocacy, and growth—not publishing volume alone.

What You Bring 

  • Significant leadership experience across content, communications, thought leadership, research, brand storytelling, or corporate marketing, with the ability to connect these disciplines into a coherent strategy.
  • A body of work demonstrating exceptional storytelling and measurable impact on market perception, buyer engagement, customer advocacy, sales effectiveness, or growth. You simplify complex ideas without making them simplistic.
  • Experience building or repositioning a corporate narrative during a growth, transformation, category, or market transition. You can develop a distinctive point of view, challenge conventional thinking, and translate it into market education and category-shaping work.
  • Experience setting a thought leadership and research agenda and turning evidence into original ideas, influential stories, and executive platforms—not simply managing content production.
  • Strong understanding of B2B buying committees, sales cycles, and competitive differentiation. You connect narrative to positioning, brand, demand, customer marketing, and commercial outcomes.
  • Fluency in AI and agentic technology sufficient to ask discerning questions, distinguish meaningful differentiation from noise, and work with Product and technical leaders on a credible story. You also know how to use AI without compromising quality, trust, or voice.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, verbal communication, and presentation skills. You are comfortable in the boardroom and on stage, working with C-suite leaders, journalists, customers, and industry influencers, and developing executives into stronger external voices.
  • A record of leading multidisciplinary teams and senior-level talent: hiring, coaching, prioritizing, and giving sharp creative feedback. You influence across functions through credibility and conviction and move fluidly between strategy and hands-on work.

Who This Role Is For 

You may currently lead Content, Corporate Communications, Brand, Editorial, Product Marketing, or Thought Leadership at the VP level, or have served as a Chief Evangelist while building and leading a team. Your background matters less than your ability to find the story, shape it, mobilize an organization around it, and tell it yourself.

Base Salary Range: $240,000.00 - $280,000.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

jobs.excerpt: About WhiteMatter WhiteMatter is the first agent-native company that secures and operationalizes the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle.
jobs.description:
About WhiteMatter

WhiteMatter is the first agent-native company that secures and operationalizes the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. Foundation models are non-deterministic, so protecting agents only at runtime leaves every decision to the last millisecond and every alert to the security team.

WhiteMatter treats AI as a deployment problem first: every agent is assessed, governed against policy, and deployed from an approved blueprint before it reaches production; every action it takes is decided before it executes; and every outcome is proven after it runs. Founded by security veterans and deployed across enterprise environments, WhiteMatter is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

Make every agent matter.

About the Role

As an AI Field Developer, you will work directly with customer engineering, platform, and security teams to implement and customize WhiteMatter's AI security solutions. You will write production-quality code, build integrations with customer AI applications and infrastructure, troubleshoot deployment challenges, and translate real-world customer requirements into working technical solutions.

This role is ideal for a practical engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building quickly, and working closely with both customers and core product engineering teams.

What You Will Do

  • Build Customer Integrations: Develop and maintain Python-based integrations, APIs, SDKs, adapters, and connectors for enterprise AI applications and infrastructure.
  • Integrate WhiteMatter's security capabilities into LLM-powered applications, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and MCP-based workflows.
  • Build proof-of-concept implementations and turn successful prototypes into reliable, maintainable solutions.
  • Deploy and Customize AI Security Solutions: Implement WhiteMatter within customer environments, including cloud infrastructure, containerized workloads, and enterprise application stacks.
  • Configure integrations with customer identity systems, logging platforms, API gateways, and security tools; support on-premises, private-cloud, and hybrid deployments where applicable.
  • Troubleshoot Real-World Engineering Challenges: Debug API, authentication, networking, configuration, and runtime issues.
  • Investigate AI-specific security challenges such as prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, insecure agent permissions, and untrusted context.
  • Develop test cases and reproducible examples to identify integration gaps and improve reliability.
  • Collaborate with Customers and Product Engineering: Work with customer developers, DevOps teams, and security engineers to understand implementation requirements.
  • Translate field problems into actionable engineering issues, product enhancements, and reusable integration patterns.
  • Improve Engineering Quality: Write unit tests, integration tests, and deployment automation; follow secure coding practices and contribute to reusable code and technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Approximately 1–4 years of experience in software engineering, backend development, AI engineering, DevOps, or a related technical field; strong early-career candidates are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in Python and familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and common software engineering practices.
  • Experience building or integrating applications that use LLMs, AI agents, or modern AI development frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Git, Linux, debugging, testing, and basic CI/CD workflows.
  • Understanding of application deployment concepts, including Docker, cloud environments, environment configuration, and application logging.
  • Ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar systems and work independently in ambiguous environments.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate directly with enterprise customers.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable AI orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with MCP servers, clients, tools, and integration patterns.
  • Exposure to AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or private-cloud deployments.
  • Knowledge of application security, OWASP guidance, threat modeling, or penetration testing.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluations, guardrails, observability, and AI red-teaming.
  • Experience integrating enterprise identity, secrets management, SIEM, or security monitoring tools.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver working customer integrations within agreed timelines.
  • Reduce deployment friction through reusable connectors and automation.
  • Resolve complex customer implementation issues effectively.
  • Improve product quality by converting field feedback into actionable engineering contributions.
  • Enable customers to operate WhiteMatter reliably in their environments.

Important Logistical Note

Candidates must possess active, valid U.S. work authorization. WhiteMatter is currently unable to provide visa sponsorship.

jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Group Director, Delivery to lead a flagship global program for one of the world’s most prominent technology companies, operating at the intersection of creative, media, and digital engineering. In this high-impact leadership role, you will blend strategic vision with operational rigor to architect and scale end-to-end delivery across integrated brand campaigns, global media initiatives, and complex digital experiences—spanning web platforms, product builds, ecommerce, and CMS ecosystems. You’ll lead and mentor a multidisciplinary delivery organization while partnering directly with C-suite stakeholders to drive execution excellence, financial health, and continuous workflow modernization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Bridge strategy and execution by architecting and elevating end-to-end delivery excellence across integrated creative, paid media, and digital engineering/experience business lines.
  • Oversee a multi-track global portfolio spanning brand campaigns, paid media ecosystems, websites, digital platforms, ecommerce, CMS implementations, and product builds, ensuring work is delivered on time, on brief, and within budget.
  • Directly lead, mentor, and scale a team of program and project managers, fostering a high-performing, accountable culture centered on continuous improvement, career growth, and delivery craft.
  • Own executive-level client relationships as a primary delivery partner, leading C-suite status updates, steering committee readouts, and strategic roadmap discussions.
  • Govern program-level financial health, including multi-million-dollar budgets, margin performance, demand forecasting, resourcing plans, and Estimate to Complete (ETC) / Estimate at Completion (EAC) tracking.
  • Champion scalable tooling, QA standards, and workflow modernization—integrating agile, waterfall, and hybrid ("Scrumfall") methodologies to reduce operational friction across creative, media, UX/UI, and engineering teams.
  • Proactively identify portfolio-wide risks, dependencies, and resource bottlenecks, driving early, solution-oriented escalations and cross-functional alignment across global teams.
  • Partner with Client Partners and discipline leads to drive business development and account growth by defining program scope, delivery frameworks, and resource estimates for new and expanding engagements.
  • Occasional on-site presence and travel as needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 12+ years of progressive project and delivery management experience across digital agency or technology environments, spanning Paid Media, Creative, Advanced Analytics, SEO, and Engineering/Digital Experience builds.
  • 5+ years of enterprise program management experience orchestrating complex, multi-track global initiatives and multi-million-dollar budgets.
  • 7+ years of people management experience leading, coaching, and scaling multidisciplinary project and program management teams.
  • Deep fluency in end-to-end digital production and engineering lifecycles, including UX/UI workflows, design systems, web and product development, CMS architectures, and ecommerce platforms.
  • Proven mastery of program financial management, including P&L and margin accountability, resource forecasting, scoping, and ETC/EAC reporting in partnership with operations and finance teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to consolidate project-level artifacts into unified, program-scale governance frameworks that optimize delivery velocity and mitigate risk across global geographies.
  • Executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with a track record of building trust and navigating high-stakes conversations with C-suite clients and internal leadership.
  • Hands-on expertise leading digital transformation initiatives and operating within Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid Scrumfall frameworks.
  • Proficiency in enterprise project management and collaboration tools, including Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, and Google Workspace.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with modern development systems and frameworks across both creative/media and web/product engineering environments, PMP certification, and active fluency in emerging AI and digital delivery tools.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401k plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

jobs.excerpt: A LITTLE INFORMATION ABOUT US!  Foods Connected is an award winning cloud based software platform that helps retailers and food companies across the world manage their supply chain, quality control, and trading and planning management.
jobs.description:
A LITTLE INFORMATION ABOUT US!

Foods Connected is an award winning cloud based software platform that helps retailers and food companies across the world manage their supply chain, quality control, and trading and planning management. Our software solutions are currently utilised by 10 of the largest food retailers in the world. As a team, we provide tools that help our customers manage their processes in a fast and efficient way and provide real-time visibility and reporting on what is happening in their business.

At Foods Connected, we recognise that our employees are our most important asset and we value creating a great working environment to ensure our team enjoy, working together and solving problems for our customers. Whether we are in the middle of a fast and intense development sprint, on a Teams call discussing project statuses, it is important to us that our employees are happy and delivering the best possible result for our customers. We’re always keen to welcome talented individuals to join our expanding team. So if you’re driven, detail oriented, and passionate about working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment... we’re looking for you!

IS THIS SOMETHING THAT INTERESTS YOU?

As Head of Implementation – Agriculture, Welfare & Sustainability, you will co-lead Foods Connected's specialist implementation capability across carbon and environmental sustainability, agriculture and animal welfare. You will help manage a multidisciplinary team of specialists and act as the senior subject matter authority on animal welfare, carbon emissions and regenerative agriculture for new customers and suppliers from implementation through to long-term partnership.

This role is central to Professional Services. It focuses on delivering exceptional implementation experiences, embedding industry-leading practice, and equipping customers and suppliers to meet evolving climate, sustainability and welfare requirements from day one. You will work in a consultative and hands-on way, translating complex policy and science into practical, scalable solutions, and advising the wider Professional Services team on carbon, sustainability, agriculture and animal welfare within the Foods Connected platform.

You will work closely with Product, Sales and Account Management to shape how carbon, sustainability, agriculture and welfare requirements are built into our tools and services, driving both customer success and platform innovation. You will also champion the adoption of AI tools, processes and technologies, personally and across your team, to improve the efficiency, consistency and impact of implementation delivery and specialist services.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Implementation & Client Partnership (50%)

  • Co-lead the specialist Professional Services team in building long-term partnerships with our agriculture clients, from structured implementation and onboarding through to ongoing relationship management across carbon and environmental sustainability, agriculture and animal welfare.
  • Act as the senior subject matter expert on animal welfare, carbon emissions and regenerative agriculture in client engagements, ensuring customers and suppliers understand, and can put into practice, the relevant standards, frameworks and regulatory requirements within the Foods Connected platform.
  • Design and continuously improve client delivery frameworks and specialist service methodologies across all three disciplines.
  • Act as senior escalation point for complex subject matter challenges, solving problems in short timeframes with expert insight and pragmatic solutions.
  • Add specialist expertise to emerging risk areas in agriculture, helping clients anticipate and respond to them before they become compliance issues.
  • Set customers and suppliers up for long-term compliance and reporting success, reducing friction and accelerating time-to-value.
  • Alongside the other Head within Professional Services, mentor and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team of Sustainability, Agriculture and Animal Welfare Specialists, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Strategic Leadership & Policy Development (30%)

  • Co-define and co-lead Foods Connected's strategic approach to carbon, sustainability, agriculture, animal welfare and CSR across multiple supply chains (ruminant, including dairy, beef and lamb; pork; poultry; fresh produce; arable and crops; woodland; and clothing and textiles).
  • Represent the company in high-level engagements with NGOs, regulatory bodies and industry forums.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of specialist policies and standards, aligned with global best practice and evolving requirements, including science-based targets (SBTi, including FLAG, and SBTN), GHG Protocol and Scope 3 supply chain emissions, the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR), sustainability reporting requirements and UK/EU animal welfare legislation.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to embed carbon, sustainability, agriculture and welfare metrics into Foods Connected's digital tools and analytics platforms.

Innovation & Thought Leadership (20%)

  • Identify emerging trends and regulatory shifts across carbon and climate reporting, sustainability, agriculture and animal welfare to inform product development, service innovation and customer support.
  • Champion and personally model the active use of AI tools and technologies across the team, staying current with developments and identifying new opportunities to integrate AI into specialist workflows and service delivery, to improve efficiency, enhance reporting quality and support data-driven decisions.
  • Collaborate with Business Development and Product to shape service propositions that support growth in new markets and sectors.
  • Deliver presentations, publish white papers and contribute to industry publications to position Foods Connected as a thought leader.

Qualifications and Experience

Minimum

  • Postgraduate qualification in Agriculture, Livestock Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability or a related field.
  • Demonstrated senior-level experience across one or more of animal welfare, agriculture, or the environment (carbon emissions, regenerative agriculture and reporting frameworks such as SBTi, SBTN and EUDR) within the food industry.
  • Deep expertise in ruminant (dairy, beef and sheep) supply chains and their emissions, and in UK/EU livestock supply chains and regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven track record of delivering cross-border implementation or compliance programmes across the UK, EU and global markets.

Preferred

  • Experience in animal welfare or wider agricultural compliance within the food industry.
  • Recognised industry contributor (for example published research or committee memberships).
  • Familiarity with digital traceability, sustainability and carbon accounting platforms.
  • Experience in a consultancy services environment.
  • Strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex policy and science into actionable implementation plans.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and industry-specific software platforms.
  • Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to design scalable onboarding and service delivery frameworks.

BENEFITS:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Flexible working hours and a Remote or hybrid working environment.
  • Generous holiday package: 25 days plus 10 public holidays & Your Birthday Off.
  • Private healthcare and employee wellness initiatives
  • CSR Day per year to give back to causes that matter to you

jobs.excerpt: About EPIC iO Technologies EPIC iO builds technology for the real world.
jobs.description:
About EPIC iO Technologies

EPIC iO builds technology for the real world.

We help organizations see more, know more, stay connected, and act faster by bringing together AI, intelligent video, edge technology, and enterprise-grade wireless connectivity.

But the technology is only part of the story.

What really makes EPIC iO different is the people behind it.

Smart, driven people who like solving hard problems. People who dig in, challenge assumptions, move quickly, and take ownership. People who know the best ideas can come from anywhere and that solving meaningful problems takes collaboration, curiosity, and zero ego.

We’re helping protect people and critical assets. Keep businesses and remote operations connected. Make existing infrastructure smarter. Turn real-world data into action when it matters most.

And we’re building a team that wants to make an impact while doing it.

Wicked-smart people. Real-world problems. Technology that matters. And we’re just getting started.

The Project Manager supports Customer Operations by managing customer projects from initiation through completion. This role manages technical delivery projects across IT infrastructure, telecommunications, and unified communications, coordinating cross-functional teams, technical resources, customer stakeholders, project documentation, RAID tracking, resource and event tracking, and project reporting to ensure project work is completed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with customer specifications and defined success criteria.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Manage assigned customer projects through the full lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, handoff, and closure.
  • Clarify customer objectives, success criteria, project scope, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate technical and non-technical cross-functional teams to keep project activities aligned, documented, and moving toward completion.
  • Maintain project schedules, action items, deliverables, status updates, RAID logs, project documentation, and stakeholder communications in the appropriate project tools.
  • Track risks, actions, issues, and dependencies using a consistent approach and communicate impacts, mitigations, owners, and due dates.
  • Assist with problem identification and resolution by documenting issues, coordinating responsible parties, and confirming completion of corrective actions.
  • Monitor project progress against defined success criteria and escalate variances, delays, blockers, or customer-impacting issues in a timely manner.
  • Support resource and event tracking and prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, or ad-hoc reporting as required by leadership or customer needs.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders by phone, email, meetings, and project updates.
  • Identify and quantify project variances, recommend corrective actions, and track follow-through to support project delivery outcomes.
  • Collaborate across workstreams outside the direct project team to complete deliverables, support handoffs, and reduce project friction.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum five (5) years of experience managing IT or technology projects, including delivery in B2B and SaaS environments.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and interact credibly at multiple organizational levels.
  • Experience supporting planning, stakeholder interface, project communication, and senior management updates.
  • Ability to manage daily workflow with limited supervision while meeting departmental and customer requirements.
  • Experience managing projects in an ERP, project management, or comparable business system.
  • Strong organization, follow-through, documentation, risk tracking, and issue-resolution skills.
  • Hands-on experience delivering projects in telecommunications, wireless, or fiber environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing IT infrastructure projects such as server replacement or refresh, network deployments, and unified communications (UCaaS) implementations.

Desired Qualifications

  • PMP certification preferred; equivalent project management certification or formal training considered.
  • Experience with technology deployments, customer operations, field services, or multi-workstream implementation projects.
  • Experience using Monday.com, ERP tools, CRM systems, or comparable project/work management platforms.
  • Background with an enterprise technology manufacturer, systems integrator, VAR, or managed services provider delivering infrastructure, networking, or communications projects for business customers.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.
  • Ability to communicate effectively by phone, email, video, and online collaboration tools in a remote environment.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Equal Employment Opportunity

EPIC iO is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. The Company does not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager - Ads Audience, Identity, Signals and Measurement
jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house, world-class ad tech ecosystem to give our members more choices in how they enjoy Netflix. This tier lets us attract new members at a lower price point while creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.


About the team

Ads Data Engineering is at the core of building a data ecosystem that powers Netflix's understanding and decision-making about the impact of ads on our business. This team builds rich, connected, and easily accessible data products spanning ad inventory, forecasting, targeting, ad serving, pacing, and more.


This role will lead the Ads Signals & Measurement team across three core areas:

  • Conversion & Attribution: Building the data and attribution capabilities that connect advertising exposure to outcomes, powering conversion measurement and ML-based optimization.
  • Measurement: Building the data foundations that power our first-party measurement solutions across the full funnel, including incrementality, lift, experimentation, and third-party measurement studies.
  • Audience Onboarding & Identity: Enabling audience onboarding, identity resolution, and rich signal generation to power audience and targeting solutions.

Horizontally, the team connects these areas through a data flywheel where signals, identity, measurement, attribution, and optimization continuously reinforce one another. This role sits at the intersection of these domains, ensuring they come together as a cohesive data ecosystem that powers both measurement and performance optimization. We're looking for a Data Engineering Manager to help set the technical bar and lead teams across these domains.


Who are you?

  • A seasoned technologist with 15+ years building data-foundation, backend, or data engineering systems, someone other engineers naturally look to for direction.
  • You've spent real time in advertising or ad-tech data, specifically in domains like Ads identity graph, measurement, and targeting, and while your depth may run deepest in one domain, you're comfortable moving across several.
  • You've built trust and driven technical direction across organizational lines, not just within your own team, and you've done it in more than one company or role.
  • You take data privacy and governance seriously, not as a checkbox, but as something you've actually built for.
  • You're a clear, thoughtful communicator who can translate technical nuance for engineers and business context for leaders, often in the same conversation.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity, and just as comfortable helping a room of smart, opinionated engineers land on a shared answer.
  • You genuinely enjoy helping other engineers grow, and see that as just as core to the job as your own technical output.

What will you do?

  • Set the team's vision and direction, and ensure long-term coherence across the various orgs, connecting the dots between domains rather than optimizing just one.
  • Weigh in on and help resolve cross-domain decisions, working with uber TL and sub-domain ICs, helping teams converge on approaches that scale across the org, not just within a single team.
  • Mentor and coach data engineers, helping them grow technically and adopt AI and emerging tools and technologies.
  • Build strong partnerships with xfn partners in D&I, product and engineering teams as well as our data platform and horizontal DE teams outside of ads, contributing to and shaping horizontal and platform-wide efforts.

What (ideally) do you know?

  • Modern data stacks end-to-end: ingestion, processing, storage, and serving.
  • Ad-tech systems and data flows, ideally with direct exposure to at least 2 domains across measurement, attribution, identity, audience, and targeting.
  • Large-scale distributed data systems such as Spark, Kafka, or columnar stores.
  • The latest in AI and agentic technologies as they apply to data engineering.
  • A graduate degree in Computer Science with a data focus is a plus, as is experience formally mentoring engineers on their technical growth.
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $446,000.00 - $752,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Corporate Travel Consultant - Marlboro Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned

  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset.   • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

For this position we source for our sistercompany Troostwijk.

About us

Troostwijk and it's group TBAuctions are one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.

  • Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.

  • Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.

  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.

  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.

  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.

  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.

  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.

What matters in this role

We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

  • Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.

  • Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.

  • Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.

  • Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.

  • French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development.

Performance that pays off

You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance.

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you.
