jobs.excerpt: Chcesz rozwijać środowisko Microsoft 365, w którym technologia realnie ułatwia codzienną współpracę?
jobs.description:
Chcesz rozwijać środowisko Microsoft 365, w którym technologia realnie ułatwia codzienną współpracę? Interesują Cię Microsoft Teams, Teams Rooms, nowoczesne rozwiązania konferencyjne oraz automatyzacja usług IT? Dołącz do projektu, w którym będziesz mieć wpływ na rozwój narzędzi wykorzystywanych przez użytkowników w międzynarodowej organizacji.

Szukamy Senior Systems Engineera / Senior Systems Engineerki, który/a połączy doświadczenie techniczne z podejściem skoncentrowanym na użytkowniku. Jeśli lubisz rozwiązywać złożone problemy, usprawniać istniejące usługi i wdrażać technologie, które przynoszą konkretną wartość – ta rola jest dla Ciebie.

O roli i zespole

Dołączysz do obszaru Collaboration Services, odpowiedzialnego za rozwój i utrzymanie usług współpracy opartych na ekosystemie Microsoft 365 w międzynarodowym środowisku enterprise.

Twoim głównym obszarem odpowiedzialności będą Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Teams Rooms oraz technologie wykorzystywane w salach konferencyjnych. Będziesz rozwijać rozwiązania zapewniające spójne, niezawodne i intuicyjne doświadczenia podczas spotkań oraz współpracy między zespołami i lokalizacjami.

Na co dzień będziesz:

  • Zarządzać środowiskiem Microsoft Teams Rooms, urządzeniami konferencyjnymi, panelami sal oraz powiązanymi technologiami audio/video.

  • Diagnozować i rozwiązywać złożone problemy techniczne związane z Microsoft Teams, systemami konferencyjnymi i usługami współpracy.

  • Odpowiadać za lifecycle management, aktualizacje, standaryzację i rozwój infrastruktury sal konferencyjnych.

  • Monitorować usługi, identyfikować potencjalne problemy i wdrażać usprawnienia, zanim wpłyną na użytkowników.

  • Współpracować z lokalnymi zespołami IT, użytkownikami, dostawcami i partnerami technologicznymi.

  • Wspierać adopcję Microsoft Teams i innych narzędzi Microsoft 365, analizując potrzeby użytkowników i przekładając ich feedback na konkretne usprawnienia.

  • Automatyzować powtarzalne zadania z wykorzystaniem PowerShell, Power Automate i Microsoft Graph.

  • Testować nowe funkcjonalności Microsoft 365, w tym rozwiązania AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot i Agents.

  • Współtworzyć kierunek technologiczny i roadmapę rozwoju usług Collaboration Services.

W zależności od Twojego doświadczenia i zainteresowań będziesz mieć również możliwość pracy z szerszym ekosystemem Microsoft 365, obejmującym SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange, Planner, Viva, Loop, Stream, Forms, a także Digital Signage, usługi SMTP, rozwiązania Adobe oraz zarządzanie licencjami Microsoft 365.

Nie musisz znać wszystkich tych technologii. Kluczowe jest doświadczenie w obszarze Teams i Teams Rooms oraz gotowość do rozwijania kompetencji w kolejnych usługach.

Wymagania

  • Bardzo dobra, praktyczna znajomość Microsoft Teams i Microsoft 365, zdobyta podczas pracy w środowisku enterprise.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu i utrzymaniu Microsoft Teams Rooms, systemów konferencyjnych lub rozwiązań meeting-room.

  • Umiejętność diagnozowania i rozwiązywania złożonych problemów technicznych związanych z usługami współpracy oraz technologiami audio/video.

  • Dobra znajomość ekosystemu Microsoft 365 i zależności między jego usługami.

  • Doświadczenie w utrzymaniu, optymalizacji i rozwijaniu usług IT z uwzględnieniem potrzeb użytkowników końcowych.

  • Samodzielność, proaktywność i odpowiedzialność za prowadzone działania.

  • Umiejętność współpracy z zespołami technicznymi, użytkownikami biznesowymi oraz zewnętrznymi dostawcami.

  • Nastawienie na ciągłe doskonalenie usług, upraszczanie procesów i wdrażanie nowych rozwiązań.

  • Komunikatywność, otwartość na dzielenie się wiedzą i chęć poznawania nowych technologii.

  • Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

  • Znajomość PowerShell, Power Automate i Microsoft Graph oraz doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów administracyjnych.

  • Doświadczenie z SharePoint Online, OneDrive i Exchange Online.

  • Znajomość Microsoft 365 Copilot, M365 Agents i możliwości wykorzystania AI w usługach IT.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu licencjami Microsoft 365.

  • Znajomość pozostałych usług Microsoft 365, takich jak Planner, Viva, Loop, Stream czy Forms.

  • Doświadczenie z Digital Signage, usługami SMTP, integracjami systemowymi lub rozwiązaniami Adobe.

Co oferujemy naszym konsultantom

  • Współpracę w formule B2B opartą na partnerskich zasadach.

  • Możliwość realizacji ambitnych projektów dla klientów z różnych branż.

  • Udział w projektach technologicznych z obszaru AI, data oraz transformacji cyfrowej.

  • Współpracę z organizacją realnie zaangażowaną w zrównoważony rozwój i odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie technologii.

  • Elastyczność w zakresie organizacji i sposobu realizacji zadań projektowych.

  • Dostęp do środowiska ekspertów i wymianę wiedzy w ramach realizowanych przedsięwzięć.

  • Projekty realizowane z wykorzystaniem nowoczesnego stosu technologicznego i najnowszych rozwiązań rynkowych.

  • Poszerzanie doświadczeń poprzez udział w innowacyjnych przedsięwzięciach i wdrożeniach.

Knowit

Knowit to nordycka firma konsultingowa, która pomaga firmom, instytucjom publicznym i organizacjom odnosić sukcesy w transformacji cyfrowej. Dzięki ekspertyzie w obszarze tworzenia oprogramowania, AI, cyberbezpieczeństwa, usług chmurowych, cyfrowych doświadczeń klienta oraz doradztwa zarządczego, tworzymy rozwiązania, które przyczyniają się do bardziej zrównoważonego i skoncentrowanego na człowieku społeczeństwa.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview: Atreides helps organizations transform large and complex multi-modal datasets into information-rich geospatial data subscriptions that can be used across a wide spectrum of use cases.
jobs.description:
Company Overview: Atreides helps organizations transform large and complex multi-modal datasets into information-rich geospatial data subscriptions that can be used across a wide spectrum of use cases. Currently, Atreides focuses on providing high-fidelity data solutions to enable customers to derive insights quickly. 

We are a fast-moving, high-performance startup. We value a diverse team and believe inclusion drives better performance. We trust our team with autonomy, believing it leads to better results and job satisfaction. With a mission-driven mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, we are building something new and helping unlock the power of massive-scale data to make the world safer, stronger, and more prosperous.

Team Overview: We are a mission-driven team of technologists, data scientists, and analysts with backgrounds in operational intelligence, law enforcement, large multinationals, and cybersecurity operations.  We obsess about designing products that will change the way global companies, governments and nonprofits protect themselves from external threats and global adversaries. 

Team Principles:

At Atreides, we believe that teams work best when they:

Remain curious and mission-driven in all aspects of our work

Promote clear, direct, and transparent communication

Embrace the 'measure twice, cut once' philosophy

Value and encourage diverse ideas and technologies

Lead with empathy in all interactions

Position Overview: As a Senior Data Scientist at Atreides, you will lead deep analytical investigations that uncover structure, relationships, and operational insight from complex and high-volume data streams. You’ll architect workflows for pattern identification, anomaly detection, and interaction analysis across disparate data sources — often involving tracked entities, sensor feeds, or behavioral signals. You will also define and implement quality assurance methodologies that ensure analytical outputs are consistent and interpretable, collaborating closely with engineers to embed those checks in production systems. In addition, you’ll take point on high-value and sometimes urgent analytic requests from internal stakeholders, helping translate open-ended questions into reliable, data-driven answers. You’ll use AI tools to accelerate and scale your analysis.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and lead investigations into patterns, trends, and edge cases across filtered datasets.
  • Develop interaction models and fused analyses across multiple entity types and data modalities.
  • Build new machine learning models and support, monitor, and improve existing production models.
  • Design data validation, anomaly sanity checks, and analytical reliability frameworks to ensure analytical outputs, including AI-assisted work, behave correctly across varied data inputs.
  • Partner with solutions and data engineering to embed analytic logic into data pipelines and services, and contribute to testing and performance optimization.
  • Document software architecture, technical designs, and engineering decisions.
  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis and development, while maintaining code quality and security.
  • Conduct bespoke, high-complexity analysis in support of customer-facing or operational needs.
  • Provide technical leadership on projects and workstreams, guiding team best practices in Spark SQL usage, exploratory reproducibility, and effective use of AI tools.

Desired Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, applied analytics, machine learning, or analytical R&D.
  • Advanced expertise in Python and distributed compute frameworks (e.g., Spark), including strong proficiency in Spark SQL.
  • Hands-on experience building, evaluating, deploying, and supporting machine learning models in production, including monitoring and retraining.
  • Strong background in statistical inference, anomaly detection, clustering, interaction modeling, or other analytical methods suited to large and heterogeneous datasets.
  • Experience working with large, complex, multi-source, semi-structured, geospatial, or entity-centric data, with a strong ability to derive insight from complex operational environments.
  • Demonstrated success building data quality, validation, or reliability frameworks, particularly for analytical workflows or model-adjacent processes.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous analytical problems into structured, reproducible investigation plans.
  • Excellent communication, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to explain AI-assisted results and their limitations to non-technical audiences.

Work Pattern:

Remote, with flexible hours. Includes participation in an on-call rotation and occasional early or late meetings to collaborate with international teams.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive salary, annual bonus, and equity package
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Pension contribution; Life, disability, and AD&D insurance
  • Flexible work environment and flexible hours
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive paid time off and company holidays
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Opportunities for travel and professional growth

While meeting all of these criteria would be ideal, we understand that some candidates may meet most, but not all. If you're mission-driven, curious and ready to "work smart and get things done," we'd love to hear from you

jobs.description:
Summary:

The Director of Benefits will own YA's benefits function end to end, from day-to-day administration to long-term strategy, across all insurance and non-insurance benefits and retirement plan, ensuring YA's programs are competitive, cost-effective and compliant. This leader will build scalable benefit programs and evolve processes and compliance infrastructure for a high-growth, private equity-backed, multi-state organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Benefits Strategy & Financial Management

Develop and execute a multi-year total benefits strategy aligned with YA's business Own the benefits budget, employee contribution strategy and plan design changes, and present recommendations to the Head of HR and senior leadership. Use claims, utilization and benchmarking data to measure program effectiveness and guide decisions. Lead the benefits workstream for acquisitions, from due diligence through post-close integration.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Responsibility for the health and welfare plans and voluntary benefits. Plan and lead open enrollment including system configuration, employee communications, education sessions and post-enrollment audits. Oversee qualifying life events, eligibility, COBRA and escalated claim issues. Act as the final escalation point for employees.

Retirement Plans

Manage the plan in partnership with the recordkeeper, advisor and ERISA counsel, and support the committee's fiduciary governance, including meeting materials, minutes and investment and fee reviews. Oversee plan administration, nondiscrimination testing, the annual audit, and Form 5500 filing. Manage plan amendments, plan mergers or terminations, blackout notices and participant communications tied to acquisitions.

Non-Insurance Benefits, Time Off & Leave of Absence

Administer the PTO, sick leave, paid holidays and other paid time off policies that comply with state and local regulations. Administer all leaves of absence including: FMLA, state family and medical leave, state paid family and medical leave insurance programs, parental leave, military leave, and other state-mandated leaves. Partner with HR and managers on ADA accommodations and the interactive process. Coordinate leave with disability, workers' compensation and return-to-work. Recommend new programs that strengthen YA's employee value proposition.

Compliance & Governance

As plan sponsor of a self-funded plan, oversee plan documents, claims and appeals fiduciary responsibilities, HIPAA privacy and security obligations, Section 105(h) nondiscrimination testing and PCORI fees. Ensure compliance with federal and state requirements and testing. Maintain plan documents, SPDs, SBCs, wrap documents and required employee notices. Monitor changing federal, state and local legislation and implement required changes.

Benefits Operations & Vendor Management

Ensure accurate eligibility, deductions and payroll integration. Reconcile carrier and vendor invoices against enrollment and payroll deductions on a regular basis. Build scalable processes, SLAs, controls and documentation that support rapid growth and new acquisitions. Manage relationships and service performance with the broker, carriers, TPAs, recordkeeper and leave administrator.

Communication & Employee Experience

Develop clear, year-round benefits communications, including total rewards statements, guides, new hire orientation and manager resources. Make benefits easy for employees to understand and use. Gather feedback to improve programs.

Work Environment

Remote role. Periodic travel (10%) for acquisition integrations, open enrollment and team meetings.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance or a related field preferred. 10+ years of progressive benefits experience, with 5+ years leading benefits programs and/or teams. End-to-end experience across health and welfare, retirement, leave and non-insurance benefits, from hands-on administration to strategy. Demonstrated M&A experience. Experience in a high-growth, multi-state organization. Private equity-backed experience is strongly preferred. Deep working knowledge of federal, state and local requirements for leaves of absence, paid sick leave, PTO and paid family and medical leave. Strong knowledge of ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, Section 125 and 401(k) compliance. Strong financial acumen, with experience in renewals, plan funding models, cost modeling and budget ownership. Excellent communicator who can explain complex benefit topics simply and influence at all levels of the organization.

Who We Are:

YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation.

What We Offer:

Employee-focused culture Strong commitment to work-life balance Remote work Flexible vacation & Paid holidays Paid family care/sick leave Parental leave Medical, Dental, Vision + more 401k w/match

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:

Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding your application will come from or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us directly at .

Disclosures:

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist—rather than replace—human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.

Job Description:

The Center for Survey Statistics and Methodology (CSSM) within The College of Liberal Arts and Science is seeking a qualified Part-Time Systems Analyst III. CSSM specializes in the research and practice of sample surveys.

CSSM has functioned as a collaborator for federal and state agencies, nonprofit organizations, and other campus units. Building on the expertise of Iowa State University’s Department of Statistics, CSSM has developed extensive capabilities in the technical and operational aspects of data science and sample survey research. Its cross-disciplinary workforce includes statisticians, data collectors, data analysts, software developers, GIS specialists, IT service and infrastructure personnel, communication specialists, and technical writers, who work across two branches: Data Science Services (DSS) and Survey Research Services (SRS).

DSS primarily collaborates with the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Natural Resources Conservation Service (USDA-NRCS) on projects such as the National Resources Inventory (NRI) and the Conservation Effects Assessment Project (CEAP), as well as with the U.S. Department of the Interior’s Bureau of Land Management on rangeland surveys. SRS conducts data collection for surveys across a range of formats and modes, including the Iowa Farm and Rural Life Poll and the Housing Provider Study.

jobs.excerpt: CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy.
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Manager, Remote Care Navigation leads the Remote Care Navigator (RCN) team supporting CareDx remote patient monitoring programs. This role is responsible for day-to-day team leadership, clinical operations, quality, workflow consistency, customer support, and scalable execution across transplant center accounts.

The Manager provides leadership and oversight to RCNs while partnering cross-functionally to ensure high-quality patient support, consistent program execution, appropriate clinical escalation, and successful implementation and growth of remote monitoring programs. The manager will also have a patient load approx. 50% compared to staff.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and manage the Remote Care Navigator team, including workload allocation, coverage, coaching, development, and day-to-day operational support.
  • Establish clear expectations, roles, and standardized ways of working across the RCN team.
  • Support onboarding, training, and ongoing development of new and existing RCNs.
  • Ensure appropriate staffing and coverage as patient volume and acct needs evolve.

Clinical & Patient Operations

  • Oversee delivery of remote patient monitoring services across supported transplant programs.
  • Ensure RCNs consistently review patient data, conduct clinical assessments, educate patients, coordinate care, and escalate concerns according to established protocols.
  • Provide leadership support for complex patient, clinical, or workflow escalations.
  • Ensure consistent patient engagement and follow-up practices across accounts.

Quality, Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Establish and monitor quality standards for clinical documentation, patient engagement, escalation, and operational workflows.
  • Conduct or oversee clinical quality audits and drive corrective actions and process improvements.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation supporting RPM billing and patient eligibility requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable company policies, training requirements, and established customer protocols.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, standardization, and scalability.

Account & Program Management

  • Partner with transplant center teams to support effective execution of remote monitoring programs.
  • Serve as an escalation point for operational and clinical workflow issues.
  • Support onboarding and implementation of new AlloHome accounts.
  • Partner with customers to refine workflows and ensure successful ongoing program execution.
  • Review program performance, compliance reporting, patient engagement trends, and operational needs with internal and external stakeholders.

Growth & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholders to support program growth.
  • Translate frontline clinical and customer insights into recommendations for workflow and product improvement.
  • Support product demonstrations, implementations, and customer education as appropriate.
  • Identify resource and staffing requirements needed to scale the Remote Care Navigation model.
  • Help communicate clinical value, patient outcomes, and success stories internally and with customers.

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge (Required): 

  • Registered Nurse (RN) required. (registered in at least 1 US state)
  • 6+ years’ experience in transplant, specialty care, remote patient monitoring, care management, or a related clinical environment strongly preferred.
  • 2+ years’ prior experience with people leadership, clinical team leadership, or demonstrated experience leading clinical workflows preferred.
  • Strong understanding of clinical operations, patient engagement, documentation, quality, and escalation processes.
  • Experience working across clinical, operational, commercial, and technology teams.
  • Strong communication and relationship-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop processes, improve workflows, and scale clinical operations.

Additional Details:

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

jobs.title: Contracts Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Description Quantum Sky is searching for a Contracts Specialist to join a team of dedicated Contracts professionals to support a dynamic portfolio of federal government contracts and subcontracts.
jobs.description:
Description

Quantum Sky is searching for a Contracts Specialist to join a team of dedicated Contracts professionals to support a dynamic portfolio of federal government contracts and subcontracts. The Contracts Specialist will provide critical contractual guidance, risk assessment, and operational support across the full contract lifecycle portfolio of projects. The Contracts Specialist will own the direct touch relationships with our Government and prime contracting counterparts, and leverage this experience to provide insight and analysis to the Business Development organization for new business pursuits.

The successful candidate is a detail-oriented, self-motivated professional individual contributor who thrives complexity, possesses exceptional people skills, swift and sound business judgment, and outstanding attention to detail. He or she is professional in all situations, but possesses an ability to speak truth to power, enabled by a confidence in one’s knowledge, research, and experience, with the ultimate objective of being a consensus builder. This individual will play a key role in protecting the company’s interests while enabling successful program execution, growth and relationship builder.

The Contracts team uniquely sits at the intersection of Business Development, Operations, and Finance and is called upon constantly to perceive and balance the business’s priorities at any given time, and assist with navigating process to get things done. To this end, the Contracts Specialist must be a superior communicator who keeps our “internal customers” in mind.

Responsibilities:

Contract Administration & Execution

  • Administer and manage multiple active contracts and/or subcontracts, serving as a primary point of contact for internal teams and external customers.
  • Support the full contract lifecycle, including proposal participation, award, modification, execution, and closeout.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, including FAR, DFARS, and agency-specific requirements.

Drafting, Negotiation & Risk Management

  • Review, and negotiate a wide range of agreements, including:
  • Subcontracts, Teaming Agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements and other various agreements.
  • Perform detailed redline reviews, identify risks, and propose mitigation strategies to protect company interests.
  • Assist in resolving contractual issues arising during performance.

Proposal Support

  • Support proposals led by both the proposal and business group teams.
  • Participate in and contribute to color team proposal reviews.
  • Ability to track and meet deadlines as needed.

Business Partnership & Advisory

  • Partner closely with Operations to address contractual matters impacting program execution.
  • Provide contractual guidance, risk analysis, and strategy support to Business Development, Proposals, Pricing, and Engineering teams on active and pipeline opportunities.
  • Support concurrent business pursuits with contract strategy and compliance insight.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure all contractual documents are accurate, approved, executed, and properly filed.
  • Maintain complete contract records and support audits, including ISO and internal compliance reviews.
  • Review Statements of Work (SOWs), task orders, and modifications to ensure alignment with governing agreements and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform duties in accordance with company policies and procedures as required.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a liaison between internal departments and external partners, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution of issues.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with government customers, prime contractors, subcontractors and internal customers.
  • Provide backup support to Contracts team members as needed.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience
  • 3–6 years of experience in government contracts, subcontracts, proposals or related roles
  • Strong working knowledge of:
    • FAR, DFARS, and federal contracting principles
    • Contract types: FFP, CPFF, T&M, Cost-Reimbursable, IDIQ, BPA
    • Various Government portals (CHESS IT, PIEE, etc)
  • Working knowledge of GSA MAS and GWAC Vehicles
  • Proficient at drafting and negotiating contracts, subcontracts, teaming agreements, non-disclosure agreements and other agreement types
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, and contract management systems
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and analytical skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • US. Citizenship required
  • Ability to balance risk mitigation with business objectives
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the confidence to advise and influence stakeholders
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • A collaborative mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality work

Desired:

  • Experience supporting federal IT, cybersecurity, or professional services contracts
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial data analysis
  • Familiarity with procurement systems and government portals (e.g., SAM, Wide Area Workflow)

Clearance:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret Security Clearance

Location:

  • Remote - Must work eastern time zone hours - considering candidates in EST and Central time zones.

About Quantum Sky

Compensation:

  • Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically between $90,000-$115,000. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above-stated range.

Benefits:

  • Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and parental leave.

The world the mission operates in is going post-quantum, contested, and machine-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join #TeamQuantumSky?

Quantum Sky Engineering LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, [sexual orientation, gender identity,] national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: WHAT DOES A SR PROJECT MANAGER DO?  The Senior Project Manager (SPM) plays a pivotal role in leading the internal day-to-day operations and delivery for a set of strategic, creative and medium-to-high complexity tactical projects, from inception to completion, within a brand or multiple brands.
jobs.description:
WHAT DOES A SR PROJECT MANAGER DO?

The Senior Project Manager (SPM) plays a pivotal role in leading the internal day-to-day operations and delivery for a set of strategic, creative and medium-to-high complexity tactical projects, from inception to completion, within a brand or multiple brands. The SPM has expert-level project management skills which allow them to lead any type of project or program, with limited supervision, and is considered the primary internal nucleus for their projects. 

  • Full lifecycle delivery and management of complex, technical, strategic and creative projects  

  • Develops and actively manages project timelines, estimates, risk registers, communication plans, burn reports and change logs with minimal oversight 

  • Leads the estimation process and provides project budget and staff plan parameters with minimal supervision 

  • Leads the project timeline creation process in close partnership with internal and external stakeholders with minimal supervision 

  • Leads project kickoffs and status meetings 

  • Creates and/or reviews and distributes meeting recaps; oversees and evolves Project Managers (PM) and Project Coordinators (PC) in their ability to write actionable recaps 

  • In partnership with AD and GPD, develops financial forecasts for proactive financial management  

  • In partnership with AD, Finance and Account, facilitates monthly billing, analysis and action 

  • In partnership with Account Services, AD and GPD, assists with the development of annual and project-based SOWs 

  • In partnership with ADs and GPD, provides input to program Gantt Charts 

  • In partnership with Account Services, AD and GPD, assists with change order creation and management 

  • Actively works with project stakeholders to identify, evaluate, log, communicate and mitigate project-level risks 

  • Works closely with Project Management Office (PMO) leadership to identify and mitigate program-level risks 

  • Identifies project staff needs and works with resource managers and PCs to ensure accuracy and updates of resource plans 

  • Resolves conflicts, including scope, schedule, resources, budget, quality and communication with minimal oversight 

  • Ensures all project artifacts (FRD, BRD, etc.) are properly stored within enterprise systems (Workfront, TFS, etc.) 

  • Accountable for application of Intouch delivery processes and PMO standards across their projects 

  • Actively mentors and supports training efforts for Project Managers and Project Coordinators 

  • Acts as first touchpoint of escalation for Project Managers and PCs 

  • Keeps direct manager informed; asks for help when needed; knows when to escalate issues/concerns to leadership; brings solutions 

  • Participates in candidate interviews as needed 

  • Effectively senses team morale and understands how to address issues 

  • modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education plus professional experience required  

  • Three to five years of experience in a PMO role 

  • Pharmaceutical or advertising experience preferred (AOR or DAOR) 

  • Advanced understanding and applications of PMO standards and processes 

  • Experience leading the delivery of complex, technology, strategy and creative based projects 

  • Ability to develop a creative, strategic or technical heavy project plan 

  • Ability to tailor and flex process to provide solutions to proactively facilitate a project 

  • Experience leading a wide range of different functional groups and project teams 

  • Comprehension of project forecasting and reforecasting throughout lifecycle of project 

  • Expert project and program burn analysis and remediation 

  • Excellent scope and change management tracking and adherence 

  • Comfortable with client-facing communication 

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate, assess and mitigate risk 

  • Ability to build trust, negotiate and influence decision-making with Account, SMEs, Clients, Partner Agencies and third-party vendors 

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability 

  • Strong decision-making and implementation, especially when faced with uncertainty 

  • Experience working with Project Management Information Systems such as Workfront, Workfront Proof, Smartsheet, MS Project 

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel 

  • Launch experience a plus 

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Innehåll

Kursen behandlar metoder för riskidentifiering, riskanalys och riskhantering samt operativ krisberedskap, krisledning och kriskommunikation. Kursen omfattar affärsdriven och operativ kontinuitetsplanering, konsekvensanalys (BIA), övningsverksamhet samt upprättande av risk-kris- och kontinuitetsplaner. Fokus ligger på operativa åtgärder, samt operativ samordning i kris för att begränsa skador, återställa funktioner och säkerställa säkerhet.

Kursen leder till specialiserade kunskaper inom risk-, kris- och kontinuitetshantering samt ger färdigheter i att genomföra analyser, planera åtgärder och samordna operativ krishantering i yrkesrollen som Säkerhets- och beredskapssamordnare.

Utbildningsmoment

Riskhanteringsprocessen: identifiering, analys, värdering och åtgärdsplanering

Risk- och sårbarhetsanalys (RSA)

Konsekvensanalys och identifiering av kritiska verksamhetsprocesser (BIA)

Krisberedskap och operativ krisledning

Kriskommunikation och samverkan

Krispsykologi och mänskliga faktorer

Kontinuitetsplanering på operativ nivå

Framtagande av kris- och kontinuitetsplaner

Planering, genomförande och utvärdering av övningar

Tillämpning av relevanta ISO-standarder som metodstöd

Digitala verktyg för risk- och kontinuitetsanalys

Lärandemål

Kunskaper att

    • Redogöra för riskhanteringsprocessens olika steg och dess praktiska tillämpning.

    • Beskriva metoder för risk- och sårbarhetsanalys samt konsekvensanalys (BIA).

    • Förklara principerna för operativ krisberedskap och krisledning.

    • Redogöra för grundläggande principer inom kontinuitetsplanering.

    • Beskriva hur relevanta ISO-standarder används som stöd i risk- och kontinuitetsarbete.

    • Förklara krispsykologiska faktorers påverkan på beslutsfattande och ledarskap.

      Färdigheter i att

    • Genomföra och dokumentera risk- och sårbarhetsanalyser med vedertagna metoder.

    • Identifiera kritiska verksamhetsprocesser och analysera konsekvenser vid avbrott.

    • Utforma kris- och kontinuitetsplaner utifrån verksamhetens behov.

    • Planera och genomföra krisövningar samt utvärdera dessa.

    • Tillämpa strukturerade metoder för beslutsfattande under press.

    • Använda digitala verktyg för analys och uppföljning.

      Kompetens att

    • Självständigt planera och genomföra operativt risk-, kris- och kontinuitetsarbete inom givna organisatoriska ramar.

    • Självständigt samordna krishantering inom ramen för organisationens operativa funktioner.

    • Bidra till utveckling av organisationens risk- och kontinuitetsarbete genom analys och förbättringsförslag.

Former för kunskapskontroll

Den studerandes kunskaper och färdigheter bedöms utifrån resultatet av följande kunskapskontroller:

Your role in our mission

We are seeking a Sr. Application Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will be a critical partner to engineering, product, and SRE teams, helping to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will drive security by design, shape our product security standards, and ensure vulnerabilities are identified, tracked, and resolved efficiently.

This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll lead secure architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and penetration testing, and you’ll be a core part of how Prosper builds and uses AI securely. That covers threat modeling agentic systems, red teaming AI applications, building AI defenses, and assessing AI risk across internal tools and vendors.

The expected working hours for this role are based in Pacific Time.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to define and implement security requirements for applications, APIs, microservices, and AI systems (AI platform foundations, AI agents, MCP/tool integrations) during design and architecture reviews.

  • Conduct in-house penetration testing, secure code reviews, and threat modeling for high-impact features, including AI-specific threat models covering models, retrieval, tools, identity, and data flows.

  • Plan and execute AI red teaming: prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, data exfiltration through tools, excessive agency, and output abuse.

  • Design and implement AI defenses such as guardrails, input/output filtering, gateway controls, least-privilege tool scopes, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, logging, and kill switches.

  • Lead application vulnerability management, including triaging and driving the remediation of security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration tests.

  • Consult and advise cross-functional teams (engineering, SRE, product) on secure coding practices, security architecture, and remediation strategies.

  • Establish and maintain application security and secure AI development standards, guidelines, and best practices, aligned with OWASP, NIST, ISO, and industry frameworks.

  • Stay up-to-date on emerging security threats, especially the fast-moving AI attack landscape, to continuously improve Prosper’s security posture.

Skills that will help you thrive

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, with 8+ years of relevant experience (or Master’s degree with 6+ years).

  • Strong hands-on experience in application security, secure coding, and penetration testing.

  • Development background with expertise in Java/Python, SQL, JavaScript, including scripting against model APIs to build test harnesses and automation

  • Experience working with modern web application frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET, J2EE, Rails, REST, SOAP).

  • In-depth understanding of web and API security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, CWE).

  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization protocols (e.g., OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).

  • Knowledge of application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST) and methodologies.

  • Proven experience working with DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, integrating security tools and automation.

  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and regulatory frameworks (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, SOC 2).

Extra credit

  • Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Security experience in Agile, CI/CD, and fast-paced product development environments.

  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, GWAPT, CEH, GPEN, CISSP.

  • Familiarity with mobile application security testing and API security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Postman, ZAP, Insomnia).

  • Knowledge of network security, infrastructure security, and microservices architecture.

  • Experience driving secure SDLC initiatives and developer security education.

Resources to help you prosper

The Opportunity

CACI is seeking experienced Project Managers to support BlueForge Alliance’s (BFA) Enterprise System Architecture (ESA) team through our Submarine Industrial Base Support Program. These assignments provide dedicated project management for the Solutions Marketplace Manager (SMM) OT Data Integrator initiative and Costpoint integration and optimization with Lexell Blue.

You will independently drive project execution, maintain integrated schedules, coordinate stakeholders, and hold action owners accountable for commitments. Your work will give leadership clear visibility into progress and reduce the need for day-to-day coordination by technical leadership. Technical teams retain responsibility for solution design, development, and implementation. Responsibilities below apply according to the assigned initiative.

Responsibilities

Project Management and Delivery

  • Own integrated project plans, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), schedules, milestones, and deliverable trackers. Define task owners and coordinate resource needs and cost estimates with responsible stakeholders.
  • Coordinate requirements gathering, working sessions, technical handoffs, testing, validation, and production deployment with business owners, technical teams, and implementation partners.
  • Maintain action and decision logs, proactively obtain outstanding requirements, and follow through on commitments. Address blockers promptly and escalate unresolved issues with recommended next steps.
  • Manage dependencies and sequencing across concurrent workstreams, balancing resource availability and competing timelines while maintaining progress against agreed priorities.
  • Identify project risks and assess the schedule, resource, and cost impacts of issues or proposed changes. Coordinate mitigation actions and obtain decisions from the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Use Jira, Smartsheet, and Confluence to organize work, track delivery, and maintain accessible project documentation and decision records.
  • Provide consolidated status reporting to leadership and customer stakeholders, highlighting progress, upcoming milestones, schedule impacts, risks, and decisions or escalation support required.

SMM OT Data Integrator Assignment

Manage the integration of SMM awardee and shipbuilder data into the Submarine Industrial Base’s (SIB) Independence Foundry environment. The initiative includes seven awardees and two shipbuilders, totaling nine individual integration efforts across three phases.

  • Maintain an individual project plan, WBS, schedule, milestones, and deliverable tracker for each performer, supported by a consolidated program roadmap and cross-performer dependency tracking.
  • Phase 1 Assessment and Planning: Coordinate kickoffs, stakeholder engagement, Foundry access, requirements gathering, and technical assessments. Oversee preparation of Phase 2 integration scopes and Phase 3 sustainment scopes, including resources, schedules, cost estimates, risks, and dependencies.
  • Phase 2 Integration Execution: Coordinate technical integration activities, monitor performer schedules and deliverables, resolve delivery blockers, and track progress against approved scopes.
  • Phase 3 Sustainment: Coordinate support requirements and service expectations, track ongoing issues, and monitor sustainment performance with responsible technical and support teams.
  • Coordinate SIB, awardees, shipbuilders, and ESA teams to resolve cross-performer dependencies and provide consolidated progress reporting.

Costpoint Integration and Optimization Assignment

Manage the integrated Costpoint modernization effort across BFA and Lexell Blue. The assignment covers six identified workstreams: Foundry integration, requisitions, workforce, and three additional workstreams awaiting kickoff.

  • Maintain one integrated execution plan covering current development and upcoming workstreams. Sequence planning and resource commitments so new efforts can begin requirements work while others move into development.
  • Foundry Integration: Coordinate business rules, data flow requirements, API mapping, and working sessions between BFA and Lexell Blue. Establish development schedules once the required inputs are defined.
  • Requisitions: Track approval threshold decisions, workflow configuration, and Deltek defect resolution. Coordinate owners and dependencies and monitor progress against agreed development milestones.
  • Workforce: Obtain outstanding specification requirements, organize follow-up sessions, and coordinate development estimates and completion forecasts with the responsible teams.
  • Additional Workstreams: Coordinate the kickoff and requirements planning for three new workstreams, confirm resource availability, and incorporate their milestones and dependencies into the integrated schedule.

Required

  • 5–10 years of relevant project management experience with a Bachelor’s Degree; additional years of experience may substitute for the degree requirement.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the delivery of complex technical projects involving multiple concurrent workstreams, external partners, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, drive schedules and commitments, obtain stakeholder decisions, and escalate delivery risks without continuous intervention from technical leadership.
  • Experience developing integrated project plans, WBS, schedules, cost estimates, and milestone and deliverable trackers, and managing resource and dependency constraints.
  • Experience using Jira, Smartsheet, and Confluence for project coordination, progress tracking, issue management, and documentation.
  • Working knowledge of requirements management, systems or data integration, testing, validation, deployment, and transition to ongoing support.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to translate technical discussions into clear actions and explain delivery status and decisions to diverse stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of Deltek Costpoint and experience coordinating enterprise systems or business workflow enhancements.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management credentials.

Desired

  • Experience coordinating Foundry data integration projects, external data providers, or technical delivery across multiple performer organizations.
  • Experience managing Costpoint or other enterprise resource planning (ERP) integrations, workflow configuration, and vendor-led development initiatives.
  • Familiarity with API and data mapping requirements, approval workflows, or requisition and workforce processes sufficient to coordinate technical and business stakeholders.

About Us

Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.

Job Summary:

By leading with electrified fleets & Electrification-as-a-Service, Highland is expanding the breadth and reach of its product offering to utilize municipal sites and existing power to provide energy storage and edge computing. The Director, Business Development – Compute will define who Highland partners with, what it deploys, and what it signs as it builds out its Compute business. Compute adds on-site power at Highland’s electric school bus depots to host modular edge computing hardware.

This role owns two connected questions: which hardware form factors and suppliers Highland should deploy, and which edge compute customers and counterparties Highland should target, on what contract terms, to secure high-quality, durable revenue. It is a strategy-level role that shapes the pipeline and partner landscape that project-level origination then executes against. The Director works closely with Compute project development, Commercial, Legal, Finance, and Supply Chain, and with external hardware vendors, edge compute buyers, and advisors.

This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer and requires approximately 40% travel.

Overview:

  • Build and maintain a market map of edge and modular compute hardware providers, assessing form factor, power and cooling requirements, deployability at depot sites, supply capacity, and vendor viability
  • Source, evaluate, and qualify alternative and additional hardware partners to reduce single-supplier dependency and support Highland’s deployment pace
  • Define the criteria Highland uses to select equipment for its sites, working with project development, engineering, and interconnection teams on site fit and power requirements
  • Identify and prioritize target compute customers and counterparties (e.g. AI inference buyers, cloud and network operators, compute marketplaces), and set the company’s targeting strategy
  • Develop Highland’s point of view on revenue quality: counterparty credit, contract tenor, pricing structures, utilization and offtake commitments, and risk allocation
  • Shape customer-centric contracting frameworks and term sheets with Legal and Finance, so Highland understands and controls what it signs rather than relying on partners’ paper
  • Lead early-stage negotiations and partnership discussions with hardware vendors and compute counterparties, then hand qualified opportunities to origination for project-level execution
  • Brief executives on market developments, partner options, and recommended commercial strategy
  • Document form factor standards and vendor relationships to support an eventual transition of equipment sourcing to Supply Chain

Qualifications:

    Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent 12+ years of related experience
  • 8+ years of experience in business development, strategy, or commercial roles in data center, AI/cloud infrastructure, or edge compute
  • Working knowledge of compute hardware and deployment (servers, inference nodes, modular or containerized data centers), including power and cooling requirements
  • Experience structuring or evaluating compute or colocation contracts, with a clear view of counterparty credit, tenor, pricing, and risk allocation
  • Established network across hardware vendors, compute buyers, and infrastructure investors or operators
  • Ability to operate in an early-stage, ambiguous business and turn open questions into clear recommendations for executives

    • Preferred

  • Experience sourcing or qualifying hardware suppliers, or managing vendor diversification for a scaling deployment
  • Background in energy infrastructure, distributed power, or behind-the-meter projects
  • Experience with startups or early-stage hardware partners

Junior Project Manager

This is a growth role with real responsibility: you will manage approximately $0.5M–$1.5M in annual billings, contribute to proposals and business development, and help shape the standards and processes our project teams work by.   • Support business development, including project interviews, technical writing for proposals, and fee proposals, under the direction of senior staff

  • Maintain up-to-date documentation and records of applicable standards and codes, and support the development of and adherence to company-wide standards and processes

What you Bring to the Role

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Registered Architect (AIA), required
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, or a related field preferred
  • Minimum of 5-10 years of post-degree experience working for an MEP engineering firm or an AE firm

  • Knowledge of Revit and AutoCAD, and of applying WBS and EVM frameworks
  • Familiarity with applying PMI methodologies
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and Microsoft Project

  • Strong work ethic; able to work independently/self-motivated, as well as in a collaborative team setting, highly organized, and detail oriented

Nice to have: PMI PMP certification, or actively pursuing it.

We are a faith-based AEC firm built around a simple idea: continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God. Our mission is to demonstrate the love of Jesus Christ by empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service. Four values guide how we work: Christian Values, Uncompromising Quality, Buffalo (running toward challenges rather than away from them), and Extreme Team. Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Scaled Client Engagement & Success Manager to our Wellbeing Engagement Regional team in the US (Remote)!

You will play a central role in growing subscription across our SMB segment, our main metric, by owning Client Engagement across a wide portfolio of clients from end to end. Reporting to the Client Engagement Director, you will connect the teams and channels that drive subscribers into one coordinated plan. Client Engagement reaches these clients primarily through one-to-many scaled programs and communication channels, while balancing direct outreach where it makes a difference.

You will use client data to find where engagement can have the greatest impact, then deliver timely, relevant experiences through scaled programs and selective personalized outreach.

Engagement is the lens. Our main focus is getting clients to engage their employees with the resources Wellhub offers. We support Client Success Managers who have a specific portfolio of clients and need help, and otherwise we own our channel and work with other teams to drive paid subscriptions.

The successful candidate is a program owner who thrives in ambiguity: someone who can read a portfolio in the data, build repeatable programs, use AI to scale them, and hold a credible conversation with an HR leader when needed. The playbook is still being written, and you will be trusted to design it, test it, and scale what works.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own adoption, client health, and renewal readiness across a wide client portfolio, using lifecycle, usage, engagement, sentiment, and retention signals to prioritize action and grow paid subscribers.
  • Own the Wellbeing Engagement channel, strategy, and program calendar, from design through launch, measurement, and iteration. Run the always-on programs (the monthly Wellhub Insider email, campaigns and moments, launch materials and webinars, and toolkits) and targeted touchpoints that help clients adopt key capabilities, engage their employees, and address common risks at the right moments.
  • Build repeatable playbooks, processes, and agentic workflows that partner teams can use as they are, such as launch, relaunch, retention, new hire, and nurture plays. Use AI to do the first pass on a defined input, with a person reviewing the result and owning every output.
  • Use data to segment clients, identify patterns, test engagement strategies, measure impact, and continuously improve playbooks, content, workflows, and automation.
  • Serve as the coordination point across the teams responsible for the paid subscribers OKR, including Customer Success, Client Marketing, and User Growth. Consolidate ownership of the overall plan, plug each team's methods into one cross-functional plan, set clear ownership and coordinated save plays for clients at risk, and identify client-backed growth levers such as broader adoption, higher activation among eligible employees, or additional product fit. Lead a regular joint review of results.
  • Provide focused engagement for a priority group of clients, partnering with Client Success Managers who have a specific portfolio and need help. Join CSM-led calls or engage clients directly when a 1:1 conversation or presentation will help validate a signal, understand sentiment, address risk, or lead launch, relaunch, and retention conversations with HR teams. For accounts with no CSM, decide case by case whether a 1:1 conversation or a scaled play serves the client better.
  • Deliver regular, executive-level portfolio and forecast updates for top accounts and for SMB leadership.
  • Own engagement-related client conversations and requests that reach the team, triaging questions and routing them to CX or other partners where it makes sense, with clear follow-through.
  • Synthesize client voice across the portfolio and share actionable insights with Product, Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Experience partners to improve the product and the client journey.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 4+ years of experience in program management, lifecycle or digital customer success, B2B2C marketing, or a comparable post-sale role, ideally in SaaS, corporate wellness, or HR tech.
  • Demonstrated success owning outcomes across a broad, high-volume portfolio through one-to-many programs and targeted 1:1 engagement, including designing lifecycle, adoption, or engagement campaigns and measuring their impact.
  • Analytical fluency in Looker, Metabase, or a similar platform. You can read adoption, engagement, and subscription metrics, spot where a cohort is stalling, and connect programs to paid subscriber results.
  • Experience building scalable programs that leverage AI tools and systems, including guiding a roadmap that is still being developed and selecting best-in-class solutions. You know where automation should replace a manual step, where a person should stay in the loop, and how to verify the output.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including clear client-facing content and the presence to present to HR audiences and lead discovery or feedback conversations.
  • Comfort in high ambiguity. You take end-to-end ownership, make independent priority calls, and adapt when SMB priorities shift.
  • Strong cross-functional influence. You align teams and senior cross-functional leaders around shared goals and push back constructively on requests that don't scale.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Paid Media Strategy
jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders?
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you.
In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000. Back then, our focus was strictly  on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded  to serve high-earning professionals in many  other industries, providing all with leading-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks.
Today, BHG Financial has firmly established  its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.
From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy.

Who You Are

You are an experienced performance marketing professional who is passionate about building paid media strategies that generate high-quality customers and measurable business growth. You understand how to optimize the entire acquisition funnel, moving beyond impressions, clicks, and lead volume to improve application, approval, funding, revenue, and profitability outcomes.

You bring experience across paid social, digital video, Connected TV, and emerging acquisition channels, with a strong understanding of how consumers make complex, high-value financial decisions. You are an analytical and forward-thinking leader who uses performance data, customer insights, and testing to identify scalable opportunities. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can build channel strategy, develop a team, challenge assumptions, and influence how marketing investments are allocated.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and own the paid media acquisition strategy across Meta, including Facebook and Instagram, YouTube, Connected TV, and future growth channels.
  • Build long-term channel roadmaps aligned with high-quality lead generation, funded loan growth, profitability, and broader portfolio objectives.
  • Manage and develop a team responsible for campaign strategy, campaign execution, optimization, and performance analysis.
  • Optimize campaigns across the full customer journey, balancing upper-funnel performance indicators with downstream outcomes such as completed applications, approval rates, funded loans, revenue, contribution margin, and customer lifetime value.
  • Develop strategies for reaching and converting consumers considering high-value financial products, including products valued at approximately $50,000 to $100,000 or more.
  • Create testing roadmaps across audience targeting, creative, messaging, placements, bidding strategies, and channel expansion.
  • Partner with Analytics to evaluate channel efficiency, lead quality, attribution, incrementality, and overall media effectiveness.
  • Identify high-intent customer signals and translate customer insights into actionable audience, channel, creative, and messaging strategies.
  • Develop audience expansion, retargeting, and lookalike strategies that support growth without sacrificing customer quality or profitability.
  • Evaluate emerging acquisition opportunities across AI-powered discovery and advertising platforms, streaming environments, creator partnerships, Reddit, programmatic media, and other developing digital ecosystems.
  • Build business cases for new and existing media investments, including projected impact, resource requirements, testing plans, risks, and success measures.
  • Monitor evolving platform algorithms, privacy requirements, advertising regulations, and measurement methodologies that may affect campaign performance.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Product, Credit Risk, Sales, Analytics, Compliance, and other Marketing teams to align channel strategies with business objectives.
  • Lead agency partners, platform representatives, and media vendors while holding external partners accountable for campaign execution and business outcomes.
  • Translate complex performance data into clear recommendations for senior and executive leadership.
  • Influence budget allocation and investment decisions using performance data, customer economics, and expected business impact.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Need

  • 10+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, customer acquisition, or a related discipline, including at least 5 years leading paid acquisition strategy.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and optimizing paid media strategies across channels such as Meta, including Facebook and Instagram, YouTube, Connected TV, programmatic media, or other emerging digital platforms.
  • Experience managing campaigns against full-funnel business outcomes rather than relying exclusively on impressions, clicks, or lead volume.
  • Experience marketing financial services or lending products, such as personal loans, debt consolidation loans, HELOCs, mortgages, credit cards, insurance products, fintech solutions, or other related offerings.
  • Experience developing acquisition strategies for high-value products or services with longer consideration and decision cycles, ideally involving transactions of approximately $50,000 to $100,000 or more.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing analytics, customer acquisition funnels, customer economics, and profitability.
  • Experience evaluating campaign performance using measures such as cost per acquisition, approval rates, funded balances, return on ad spend, contribution margin, lead quality, and customer lifetime value.
  • Knowledge of attribution methodologies, experimentation, incrementality testing, and the limitations of platform-reported performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop audience targeting, segmentation, retargeting, and lookalike strategies while protecting lead and customer quality.
  • Experience operating within a regulated industry and an understanding of the compliance considerations associated with financial services marketing.
  • People-management experience, including the ability to coach and develop employees responsible for campaign management and performance analysis.
  • Experience managing agency partners, media vendors, and cross-functional relationships.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with the ability to turn complex findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions across Marketing, Analytics, Finance, Product, Credit Risk, Sales, and Compliance.
  • A strategic and curious mindset with the ability to evaluate new channels, challenge platform-reported results, and identify scalable acquisition opportunities.
  • Travel requirement: Within the first 6 months of employment, all employees will travel to attend the BHG All Oars Experience. Following this event, ongoing travel is minimal—approximately 5% annually—for team on-sites, meetings, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Work Authorization: This role is not eligible for employer-provided immigration sponsorship. To be considered, applicants must already possess valid U.S. work authorization that will not require sponsorship now or in the future.

Life at BHG Financial

At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. Since the beginning, our core values of PMA (positive mental attitude), team player, and loyalty have been the driving force behind every interaction we have between each other and our customers. We have a healthy respect for the daily grind, yet we value work/life balance. We believe that all employees should have the opportunity to lead and that good ideas can come from anyone. From the top down, our leaders are actively involved not only in strategic oversight and running the business, but also in the well-being and growth of all employees. We consider people our #1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development.

Why You Should Join BHG Financial

We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include:
•Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members
•Competitive PTO and vacation policies
•1 Friday off each month for Wellness Weekends
•Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year
•Company-sponsored training and certification opportunities
•Quarterly award ceremonies where top achievers are celebrated and receive additional bonuses
•Ongoing volunteer opportunities to give back to the community through our BHG Cares program
If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team-player mindset, apply today!
