jobs.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Overview DecisionPoint seeks a Cybersecurity and Data Protection Engineer to provide cybersecurity expertise supporting AI integration and data analysis under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Cybersecurity and Data Protection Engineer to provide cybersecurity expertise supporting AI integration and data analysis under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior-level position will advise project teams on secure data pipelines, database security, data governance, and security considerations for AI-enabled workflows and outputs. The engineer will help teams identify risks and incorporate appropriate protections throughout design, implementation, testing, and ongoing operations. The Cybersecurity and Data Protection Engineer will collaborate with Government cybersecurity representatives, AI engineers, data engineers, database administrators, governance personnel, developers, and testers to translate security requirements into practical technical recommendations and traceable corrective actions.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Cybersecurity and Data Protection Engineer will:

  • Provide cybersecurity guidance for AI integration, data analysis, database, and data pipeline activities.
  • Review proposed architectures, data flows, integrations, and workflows to identify security risks and control gaps.
  • Advise teams on protecting data during ingestion, transfer, processing, storage, retrieval, and reporting.
  • Recommend appropriate authentication, authorization, least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, and audit logging controls.
  • Review database security configurations, privileged access, service accounts, and data-access arrangements.
  • Coordinate with data governance personnel on classification, approved uses, access restrictions, retention, and authoritative-source considerations.
  • Assess security considerations for AI-enabled workflows, including sensitive-data exposure, unauthorized retrieval, prompt manipulation, excessive tool permissions, and insecure outputs.
  • Recommend human-review checkpoints, approval requirements, operating boundaries, and escalation paths for AI-assisted activities.
  • Review safeguards intended to prevent AI tools and reporting capabilities from exposing information beyond a user’s authorized access.
  • Support security reviews of APIs, application integrations, data pipelines, and automated agents.
  • Translate technical findings into actionable risk recommendations for project teams and Government stakeholders.
  • Coordinate remediation ownership, priorities, milestones, and closure evidence with responsible technical teams.
  • Support security-control documentation, authorization evidence, and continuous-monitoring activities.
  • Collaborate with testers to define security validation criteria and review evidence of implemented protections.
  • Support investigation of security issues affecting AI capabilities, databases, analytical environments, and data exchanges.
  • Review proposed changes for effects on data protection, access, logging, and existing security controls.
  • Maintain security recommendations, risk records, review findings, and corrective-action documentation.
  • Prepare briefings and technical guidance explaining security risks, recommended safeguards, and unresolved decisions.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • Ability to provide cybersecurity expertise supporting AI integration and data analysis.
  • Ability to advise technical teams on secure data pipelines, database security, and data governance.
  • Ability to evaluate security considerations for AI-enabled workflows and outputs.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC).
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense cybersecurity programs.
  • Experience securing data pipelines, databases, warehouses, analytical platforms, or cloud data services.
  • Familiarity with AI security risks and safeguards for knowledge assistants, retrieval workflows, and automated agents.
  • Experience reviewing identity, access controls, encryption, secrets management, and audit logging.
  • Familiarity with DoD RMF, security-control assessments, authorization documentation, and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience supporting data governance, approved-use controls, sensitive-data protection, and access reviews.
  • Experience coordinating vulnerability remediation and maintaining corrective-action evidence.
  • Strong risk analysis, technical documentation, stakeholder communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

jobs.excerpt: Description Sprout Social is looking to hire a GTM AI Engineer to the Sales & Customer Experience team.
jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a GTM AI Engineer to the Sales & Customer Experience team.

You’ll build and ship the AI agents, automations and integrations that take admin work off our reps and managers and help our revenue teams sell, forecast and renew with more insight. You’ll sit in GTM Systems & Applied AI, work inside our AI Center of Excellence for GTM, and partner closely with Salesforce IT and the business teams who use what you build.

Why join Sprout’s Revenue Operations, Sales & Customer Experience team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

As the strategic engine of our go-to-market organization, Revenue Operations builds the infrastructure that turns data into action. We specialize in architecting world-class processes and delivering the operational clarity that allows our teams to move with speed, anticipate market shifts, and optimize the entire customer lifecycle for sustainable growth.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build and ship AI agents, automations and integrations for Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Deal Desk and Revenue Operations, taking them from prototype to production.
  • Turn priority use cases from the GTM AI roadmap into working solutions with clear adoption and impact measures, starting with the ones that cut rep admin time.
  • Integrate AI solutions with Salesforce, Gong and other GTM systems, working with Salesforce IT on architecture, security and the release process.
  • Build evaluation, monitoring and guardrails so AI outputs are accurate, auditable and safe to use in revenue workflows.
  • Partner with the Business Analyst on requirements, test scenarios and UAT, and with Sales Enablement on rollout and adoption.
  • Contribute to AI Center of Excellence governance: technical standards, documentation, data access, and build-versus-buy reviews of tools and vendors.
  • Identify data quality and process gaps that limit AI performance, and help close them with RevOps and Salesforce IT.
  • Stay current on a fast-moving field, use AI coding tools in your own work, and share what works with the team.

What you’ll bring

You’re an engineer who ships. You’re comfortable owning a problem from idea through production, you care about whether AI outputs are actually right, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data or machine learning engineering, or applied AI, including shipping production software.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications: prompting, tool or function calling, retrieval, agents and evaluation.
  • Strong programming skills (Python or similar) and experience building APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to scope problems and deliver solutions independently.
  • Sound judgment on data security, privacy and access control when AI touches customer and revenue data.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Experience integrating with Salesforce (APIs, Apex or flows) or a strong understanding of CRM data models.
  • Experience working with Gong or other conversation intelligence data.
  • Experience in a sales, revenue operations or go-to-market environment.
  • Experience with agent or workflow automation frameworks and AI evaluation tooling.
  • Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions for AI tools.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, plant goalposts for your career, and learn about Sprout’s approach to building and governing AI for go-to-market teams.
  • Learn our GTM stack, the Salesforce and Gong data available to build on, and how Salesforce IT handles security and releases.
  • Ship a small prototype or quick win with a pilot group.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Build connections with members from other teams through active networking and community building.
  • Ship your first AI solution to a pilot group with defined success measures.
  • Set up the evaluation and monitoring approach for your solutions with the Director of GTM Systems & Applied AI.
  • Agree on integration and security patterns with Salesforce IT.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Have your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth.
  • Move at least one solution into production at scale, with adoption and impact measured.
  • Contribute to the AI Center of Excellence standards and documentation.
  • Work with the Business Analyst to make requirements and UAT part of every AI release.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.
  • Own a portfolio of AI use cases from roadmap through adoption, with a clear record of time saved or revenue impact.
  • Shape build-versus-buy decisions for GTM AI tools.
  • Raise the technical bar for the team through standards, reusable components and shared practices.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

A posição exige conhecimento técnico em APIs, integração de sistemas e arquitetura de software, permitindo compreender os ambientes tecnológicos dos clientes, conduzir discussões técnicas, realizar sessões de discovery, identificar desafios de integração e apoiar o desenho de soluções funcionais utilizando as capacidades da plataforma Sensedia.

Além disso, será responsável por conduzir demonstrações, workshops técnicos e capacitações, traduzindo conceitos e soluções tecnológicas para diferentes públicos, desde equipes de desenvolvimento e arquitetura até stakeholders de negócio.

Na frente de Customer Success, deverá gerenciar sua carteira de forma consultiva e proativa, acompanhando indicadores de saúde, adoção e satisfação, identificando riscos e construindo planos de ação para retenção, reversão de churn e oportunidades de expansão.

Atuará em colaboração com os times de Produto, Suporte e Vendas, conectando as necessidades técnicas e estratégicas dos clientes às soluções Sensedia, contribuindo para a satisfação, retenção e crescimento sustentável da receita.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes, compreendendo seus objetivos de negócio, desafios técnicos e necessidades de integração, construindo planos de sucesso que garantam a adoção e evolução das soluções Sensedia.

  • Consultoria Técnica em APIs e Integrações: Atuar como referência técnica funcional para os clientes, apoiando discussões sobre APIs REST, integrações de sistemas, Swagger/OpenAPI, segurança de APIs e conceitos de arquitetura de software, como microsserviços.

  • Discovery Técnico e Desenho de Soluções: Conduzir sessões de levantamento de requisitos técnicos e de negócio, compreender os ambientes e desafios dos clientes e propor soluções funcionais utilizando as capacidades da plataforma Sensedia.

  • Capacitação e Evangelização Técnica: Realizar workshops, demonstrações de produtos e treinamentos técnicos, orientando os clientes sobre a utilização das soluções e boas práticas de integração e consumo de APIs.

  • Condução de Reuniões Estratégicas (QBRs): Liderar reuniões de acompanhamento com stakeholders técnicos e executivos, apresentando indicadores de performance, resultados alcançados, retorno sobre investimento (ROI) e oportunidades de evolução.

  • Monitoramento de Indicadores e Saúde da Carteira: Acompanhar métricas como Health Score, NPS, churn, NDR e utilização dos produtos, identificando riscos de forma antecipada e estruturando planos de ação para retenção e reversão de churn.

  • Identificação de Oportunidades de Expansão: Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell a partir das necessidades técnicas e estratégicas dos clientes, atuando em parceria com o time Comercial para apoiar a expansão das contas.

  • Resolução e Orquestração de Desafios Técnicos: Atuar como elo entre clientes e equipes internas de Produto, Suporte, Engenharia e Vendas, acompanhando desafios relacionados às soluções e integrações, mobilizando as áreas responsáveis e garantindo alinhamento e evolução das demandas.

  • Melhoria Contínua da Experiência do Cliente: Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na jornada técnica e na utilização das soluções, contribuindo para aumentar a autonomia dos clientes, a satisfação, a retenção e a geração de valor para o negócio.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência em Customer Success ou Gestão de Contas: Vivência em relacionamento consultivo com clientes de tecnologia, preferencialmente em ambientes SaaS/PaaS, com foco em adoção de soluções, retenção e geração de valor.

  • Conhecimento Técnico em APIs e Integrações: Conhecimento consistente sobre APIs REST, integração entre sistemas, protocolos HTTP, métodos de requisição, autenticação e consumo de APIs, com capacidade de participar de discussões técnicas com clientes.

  • Documentação e Segurança de APIs: Familiaridade com Swagger/OpenAPI, conceitos de segurança de APIs, autenticação e autorização, incluindo OAuth 2.0 e tokens.

  • Arquitetura de Software: Compreensão das diferenças entre arquiteturas monolíticas e microsserviços, além de conceitos relacionados à comunicação e integração entre aplicações.

  • Discovery e Consultoria Técnica: Capacidade de compreender necessidades técnicas e de negócio, realizar levantamento de requisitos, identificar desafios de integração e apoiar a definição de soluções funcionais.

  • Indicadores de Customer Success: Experiência no acompanhamento de métricas como NPS, Health Score, churn, retenção e NDR, utilizando dados para identificar riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

  • Comunicação Técnica e Executiva: Habilidade para conduzir reuniões com diferentes públicos, incluindo desenvolvedores, arquitetos, gestores e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo conceitos técnicos de forma clara e consultiva.

  • Apresentações e Capacitações: Experiência na condução de apresentações, demonstrações de soluções, treinamentos ou workshops para clientes.

  • Gestão Proativa de Relacionamento: Capacidade de gerenciar uma carteira de clientes com autonomia, antecipar necessidades, estruturar planos de ação e articular soluções em conjunto com diferentes áreas internas.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com Clientes Enterprise: Vivência no gerenciamento de contas estratégicas e clientes de grande porte, especialmente em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

  • Experiência com Upsell e Cross-sell: Participação na identificação de oportunidades de expansão de contas, ampliação do uso de soluções e geração de novas oportunidades de negócio.

  • Conhecimento em Open Finance e Open Banking: Familiaridade com o ecossistema brasileiro de Open Finance, suas APIs, integrações, padrões de segurança e regulamentações.

  • Experiência Prática com Desenvolvimento e Integração de Sistemas: Vivência anterior com desenvolvimento, implementação, configuração, testes ou consumo de APIs, contribuindo para uma atuação consultiva com maior profundidade técnica.

  • Inglês Avançado: Capacidade de participar de reuniões, apresentações e discussões técnicas em inglês, interagindo com clientes e stakeholders internacionais.

Insight Generation & Strategic Influence

Performance Measurement & ROI Analytics

jobs.title: Senior Staff DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About SailPoint SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise.
jobs.description:
About SailPoint

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving customers unmatched visibility into their digital workforce and ensuring workers have the right access — no more, no less.

Built on a foundation of AI and machine learning, our Identity Security Cloud (Atlas) platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time — matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud-oriented enterprise. SailPoint is all-in on the AI revolution, and our engineers have access to the latest frontier models and agentic frameworks.

About the Role

As a Senior Staff DevOps Engineer on the Infrastructure Platform team, you will be a technical leader responsible for designing, building, and operating SailPoint’s global Identity Security Cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will partner with engineering teams across India, the US, EMEA, and APAC to deliver a resilient, secure platform. You will be a key contributor to our AI-assisted and agentic automation and tooling.

You will serve as a Kubernetes platform leader for the team — guiding engineers on EKS and AKS operations, service mesh, and cloud-native deployment patterns across our production environments. You will also play a key role in supporting SailPoint’s PCI compliance initiative, helping ensure our platform infrastructure meets PCI DSS requirements.

This is a fully remote position for candidates based in India. The role carries significant technical influence across the organization — setting architecture direction, mentoring engineers, and driving operational excellence without requiring people management.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in complex, fast-paced SaaS environments, enjoys solving hard infrastructure problems, brings expert-level Kubernetes, AWS platform, and modern AI knowledge, values quality and reliability, and is excited to thrive on an AI enabled team.

About the Team

The Infrastructure Platform Team designs and operates the foundational cloud infrastructure that powers SailPoint’s Identity Security Cloud. Our platform runs on a mature, cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture on AWS, with Kubernetes, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code at the core. We also support smaller environments in Azure and GCP.

Engineers in India work closely with global peers in the US, the UK, Israel, the UAE, and Mexico. The team owns all SailPoint’s cloud infrastructure, compute capabilities, and operational practices for a 24×7 SaaS environment serving large enterprises worldwide. We focus on GitOps and Infrastructure as Code, agentic automation, and managing web platforms that serves millions of concurrent requests.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Account AWS Operations

  • Design, build, and maintain a resilient, secure, and cost-efficient multi-account AWS SaaS platform that meets established SLAs and uptime targets.
  • Design and evolve multi-account AWS architectures, guardrails, and IaC patterns.

Kubernetes Platform Leadership

  • Serve as a technical lead on Kubernetes for the Infrastructure Platform team — our platform is heavily Kubernetes-based, and this role requires deep, hands-on expertise.
  • Design, operate, and optimize production Kubernetes clusters at scale on AWS (EKS) and Azure (AKS), including cluster architecture, upgrades, node management, networking, storage, and multi-tenant isolation patterns.
  • Design, implement, and operate a service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, or AWS App Mesh) for microservices communication — including mTLS, traffic management, observability, resilience patterns, and progressive delivery across environments.
  • Define and drive Kubernetes and service mesh standards and best practices across teams — workload design, resource management, security hardening (RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies), Helm/chart conventions, and deployment patterns.
  • Guide and mentor engineers on Kubernetes and service mesh troubleshooting, performance tuning, capacity planning, and production incident resolution for containerized microservices.

Platform Architecture

  • Design and scale infrastructure to meet rapidly increasing customer demand, data sovereignty requirements, and regional expansion.
  • Define standards for AWS and Azure networking, IAM, secrets management, AWS Organizations governance, and cross-account connectivity.
  • Automate deployment, monitoring, incident response, and capacity management using GitOps and CI/CD best practices.
  • Develop and improve operational practices, runbooks, and platform engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with development teams to bring new features and services into production safely and efficiently.
  • Proactively meet information security and compliance standards (e.g.,PCI DSS), including supporting SailPoint’s PCI compliance initiative through secure platform design, controls implementation, and audit readiness.
  • Participate in and help improve the on-call rotation; drive post-incident reviews and systemic fixes.

AI & Agentic Workflow Innovation

  • Champion AI-assisted and agentic workflows across DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering — integrating LLM-based tooling, AI code assistants, and autonomous agents into day-to-day operations.
  • Design and operationalize agentic automation on AWS using services such as Amazon Bedrock, including model selection, prompt/orchestration patterns, and integration with operational tooling for tasks such as infrastructure code generation/validation, incident triage, root-cause analysis, deployment troubleshooting, compliance checks, and repetitive operational runbooks.
  • Establish guardrails, observability, cost controls, and human-in-the-loop practices for safe adoption of Bedrock-powered and AI-driven automation in production environments.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to define a roadmap for AI-native platform operations on AWS and measure productivity, reliability, and cost impact.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Develop and document cutting-edge techniques, patterns, and best practices; mentor Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers.
  • Manage cross-functional requirements with Engineering, Product, Services, and Security teams across time zones.
  • Influence engineers and teams who are not direct reports — setting process, raising the bar, and driving consensus on technical direction.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert during critical escalations and architecture reviews.

Background & Experience

Required

  • Strong interpersonal and teaming skills — ability to set and enforce process and influence engineers across teams and geographies.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an agile, entrepreneurial environment with global stakeholders.
  • Prior experience as a technical lead or Staff+ IC in a global engineering organization.
  • 12+ years of experience in 24×7 production operations, supporting highly available SaaS or cloud service environments.
  • 12+ years of experience with containerization, virtualization, and configuration management technologies.
  • 5+ years of experience with multi-account AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production at scale.
  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform (IaC), managing infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and regions.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, especially for Terraform, Kubernetes, and microservices.
  • 5+ years of experience with scripting/programming languages (Python, Go, or similar) and strong shell scripting proficiency.
  • Strong understanding of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and production troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and operating a service mesh in production Kubernetes environments (Istio, Linkerd, or AWS App Mesh).
  • Experience designing and operating multi-account AWS environments with AWS Account Factory, and organizational guardrails (SCPs, preventive/detective controls, landing-zone standards).
  • Experience applying AI tools on AWS (e.g., Amazon Bedrock or equivalent) to improve engineering productivity, automation, or operational efficiency.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch or equivalent).
  • Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g., ArgoCD, Kargo, Flux).
  • Strong understanding of SRE principles — SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and observability.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience implementing Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) or similar automated account vending and baseline provisioning at scale.
  • Experience designing or operating agentic workflows on AWS using Amazon Bedrock, LLM agents, AI-driven runbook automation, or intelligent incident response systems in enterprise production contexts.
  • Experience supporting regional/sovereign AWS deployments (e.g., UAE, EU, India data residency requirements).
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks in regulated enterprise SaaS, including PCI DSS and FedRAMP-adjacent practices — with experience implementing or operating platforms subject to PCI compliance requirements preferred.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Onboard into the role; learn Identity Security Cloud architecture, platform tooling, and team processes.
  • Build relationships with peers and stakeholders across India and global DevOps/SRE teams.
  • Join team ceremonies, contribute to in-flight projects, and begin participating in on-call shadowing.

First 90 Days

  • Own significant platform initiatives; contribute to architecture decisions and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to or improve multi-account guardrails and Account Factory patterns within the AWS organization.
  • Integrate AI-assisted tooling into at least one team workflow (e.g., IaC review, incident triage, deployment validation).
  • Join the on-call rotation; become proficient in core services, escalation paths, and runbooks.
  • Mentor engineers and document at least one new platform pattern or operational standard.

First 6 Months

  • Lead cross-functional projects to improve platform reliability, deployment velocity, or multi-account AWS consistency and standardization.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in automation, incident response time, or operational toil reduction — including through agentic workflow pilots.
  • Become a recognized SME on platform services; independently handle complex production escalations.
  • Influence roadmap and engineering practices across the broader Infrastructure organization.

First 12 Months

  • Drive a strategic initiative that advances SailPoint’s multi-account, AI-enabled platform operations vision.
  • Establish durable standards, guardrails, and documentation adopted by multiple teams.
  • Lead or significantly advance service mesh adoption and standardization — including security controls, observability integration, and documented patterns adopted by engineering teams.
  • Demonstrate sustained impact on uptime, deployment success rate, cost efficiency, or engineering productivity.

Work Model

This is a fully remote position for candidates based in India. Candidates must be eligible to work in India and available for collaboration with global teams across US, EMEA, and APAC time zones. Participation in an on-call rotation is required.

Education

Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical experience.

Description

This position in Sargent & Lundy’s Consulting group will require you to focus on our utility planning and advisory projects, such as the following:

  • Transmission system planning and analysis, including studies in load flow, stability, short circuit, and electromagnetic transients (EMT), to support a variety of clients such as ISO/RTO and electric utilities.
  • Preparing new generator interconnection applications, including development of conceptual single line diagram, verification of compliance with reactive power requirements, and development of steady-state, dynamic, and short circuit models to support the applications.
  • Reviewing ISO feasibility and system impact studies to provide guidance to our clients, who are ISO Interconnection Customers.

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering and sufficient industry experience is considered in lieu of an advanced degree
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant power systems engineering experience with utility or consultant
  • Experience in load flow and contingency analysis to identify transmission thermal and voltage constraints and to identify transfer capability limits
  • Experience using transmission planning software for load flow modeling, contingency analysis, and stability analysis using PSS/E, PSLF, TARA

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Experience in stability analysis to identify critical clearing times, identify voltage constraints and analyze power system damping
  • Experience in electromagnetic transient analysis using PSCAD
  • Experience in short circuit analysis and using software programs CAPE or ASPEN

WAN, Check Point Firewall & Azure Networking Engineer

Contract Duration: 3 month contract

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced WAN, Check Point Firewall & Azure Networking Engineer to join our technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting and optimisation of enterprise network and security environments.

The role requires strong hands-on experience across WAN technologies, Check Point firewalls and Microsoft Azure networking, with a focus on network availability, performance, security and resilience.

Key Responsibilities

WAN & Network Infrastructure

  • Design, configure and support enterprise WAN and LAN network environments.
  • Manage WAN connectivity, routing and network performance.
  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Configure and manage routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
  • Monitor network availability, capacity and performance.
  • Work with service providers to resolve connectivity and circuit-related incidents.
  • Support network changes, upgrades and migrations.
  • Ensure network infrastructure meets availability, performance and security requirements.

Check Point Firewall

  • Install, configure, administer and maintain Check Point firewalls.
  • Manage firewall policies, NAT, VPNs, access rules and security configurations.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews and optimisation.
  • Troubleshoot firewall and network security incidents.
  • Monitor firewall performance, logs and security events.
  • Implement security changes in accordance with change management processes.
  • Support high-availability firewall environments.
  • Ensure firewall configurations comply with organisational security standards.

Azure Networking

  • Design, implement and support Microsoft Azure networking environments.
  • Configure and manage:
  • Azure Virtual Networks (VNet)
  • Subnets
  • Network Security Groups (NSGs)
  • Azure Firewall
  • Route Tables / UDRs
  • VPN Gateway
  • ExpressRoute
  • Load Balancers
  • Private Endpoints
  • VNet Peering
  • Support hybrid connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and Azure.
  • Troubleshoot Azure network connectivity and routing issues.
  • Assist with Azure network migrations and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Implement secure and scalable Azure network architectures.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with WAN technologies and enterprise networking.
  • Strong Check Point Firewall administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure Networking experience.
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN and network security.
  • Experience with BGP, OSPF and routing protocols.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery principles.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of network security principles and best practices.

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Relevant degree, diploma or technical qualification in IT, Networking or a related field.
  • Check Point certification such as CCSA/CCSE would be advantageous.
  • Microsoft Azure networking certification such as AZ-700 would be advantageous.
  • Cisco certification such as CCNA/CCNP would be beneficial.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a production environment.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and change management processes.
  • Excellent attention to detail and security awareness.

Experience

  • 8+ years' experience in enterprise networking and infrastructure.
  • Proven experience supporting WAN environments.
  • Strong hands-on Check Point Firewall experience.
  • Strong experience with Azure Networking and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience working in large, complex enterprise environments is advantageous.

Description

We are seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) and Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) engineer in the nuclear industry. We support various nuclear power plants’ license extensions and post license approval implementation activities across the US nuclear power plant fleet.

The ideal candidate would have experience with LR/SLR application or implementation activities, nuclear industry related engineering programs, nuclear power plant work management/scheduling, NRC submittals, and/or NRC inspections.

Example LR/SLR application activities include scoping, screening, aging management reviews, aging management programs, Time Limited Aging Analysis (TLAAs), Further Evaluations, operating experience review, and modification history review as described in NEI 95-10 and NEI 17-01.

Example LR/SLR implementation activities include procedure changes, preventative maintenance basis and frequency development, work order development and review, online and outage work management and scheduling, nuclear program basis document development, NRC commitment closure, NRC Inspection Procedure

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform System Scoping, Screening, and Aging Management Review of nuclear plant systems in support of SLR applications in accordance with NEI 17-01 and current industry best practices
  • Collaborate with engineering and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with NRC regulations and license extension commitments
  • Perform engineering program basis documentation, data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control
  • Roadmap required inspections to comply with NRC regulations and license renewal commitments
  • Review inspection work orders to ensure license renewal criteria is met
  • Interact with clients and/or NRC in a technical expert role
  • Maintain awareness of changes in aging management regulations, approaches, techniques, and operating experience
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, technology forward, and cross-functional collaboration

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Required Qualifications:

  • ABET-accredited Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • 10 or more years of experience in engineering, licensing engineering, program engineering, design engineering, power plant inspection, or AI, ideally within nuclear or within a highly regulated industry
  • Experience delivering accurate, high quality, technical documentation in a highly regulated environment
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation systems, nuclear QA/QC protocols, and configuration management
  • Strong systems thinking skills and ability to balance innovation with compliance, safety, and traceability

Preferred Experience:

  • Nuclear power plant operations, engineering, or design background

  • Prior involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs (involving evaluations for cable insulation and connections, metal enclosure bus, fuse holders, insulators, etc.)

Description

This is a Lead Nuclear Component Engineer position that offers a variety of interesting and challenging opportunities in component qualification engineering and will provide an excellent opportunity to advance your career. You will collaborate with a team including other component qualification engineers, interface with engineers from other disciplines, and guide the work of less experienced project team members.

You will work with an engineering team on projects for new nuclear facilities and upgrades and modifications to nuclear power plants in the following areas:

  • This position will offer you the ability to directly apply your knowledge of component seismic and environmental qualification, structural mechanics, foundation load and component mounting analysis, and ASME Code calculations for Section III and Section VIII vessels, valves and pumps.
  • As a member of an engineering team, you will work on a wide range of projects for various clients. You will prepare and review design calculations, review test/analysis qualification reports from vendors, develop specifications, revise client design basis documents and support designers with drawing development
  • Perform the structural analysis and design of steel panels/cabinets, connections, equipment foundation loads and equipment supports including the effects from seismic loads
  • Conduct primary containment penetration design and analysis for design conditions including fatigue effects
  • Perform Seismic Qualification activities involving review of seismic test reports and preparation/review of analyses which include seismic loading
  • Perform Environmental Qualification life assessments using the Arrhenius method and updates to other qualification documentation
  • There is the potential for travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for construction coordination and field verification of designs.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) in engineering degree with emphasis in Structural or Mechanical Engineering from an ABET-accredited program
  • Ten or more years of experience related to component qualification activities in the nuclear power plant industry
  • Proficiency with structural mechanics analysis using Mathcad software
  • Familiarity with design codes and standards such as AISC, AISI, ASCE, ANSI and ASTM
  • Familiarity with Regulatory Guides, IEEE Standards and EPRI Documents associated with Seismic and Environmental Qualification
  • Experience completing ASME Section III design reports and/or design specifications
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications

WE ARE HIRING: Technical Business Analyst

Location: Sri Lanka
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: Software Development / Data Analytics / Financial & Brand Intelligence

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Technical Business Analyst to join a growing Software Engineering team responsible for developing and enhancing complex business-critical software platforms. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, analysts, project managers, and software engineers. The successful candidate will be responsible for gathering requirements, analyzing business processes, documenting system functionality, creating user stories, and translating business needs into clear technical specifications that support software development initiatives. The ideal candidate will combine strong business analysis expertise with technical understanding, enabling them to work confidently across system architecture, APIs, database structures, business logic, and software development processes.

Role Impact

As a Technical Business Analyst, you will become a subject matter expert on a highly specialized software platform that supports data collection, analysis, valuation modelling, reporting, and strategic business insights. You will play a critical role in ensuring alignment between business users and technical delivery teams while helping drive product improvements and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

  • Act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and software engineering teams.
  • Engage with users and business stakeholders to understand challenges, objectives, and operational requirements.
  • Gather, analyze, validate, and document detailed business and functional requirements.
  • Identify gaps, ambiguities, risks, and opportunities within requested changes and business processes.
  • Challenge assumptions and recommend practical and effective solutions.
  • Create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and functional specifications.
  • Ensure requirements are accurately interpreted and delivered by development teams.
  • Participate in requirement workshops, stakeholder discussions, and solution reviews.

User Story Development & Agile Delivery

  • Triaging incoming requests and enhancement requirements from users and stakeholders.
  • Convert business requirements into structured development-ready user stories.
  • Support prioritization activities and sprint planning processes.
  • Represent the user perspective throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Work closely with developers and technical leads to clarify functionality and technical requirements.
  • Support Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies where appropriate.
  • Participate in sprint reviews, backlog grooming sessions, and project planning activities.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create, maintain, and enhance user documentation, system guides, process documentation, and knowledge resources.
  • Document website features, workflows, business processes, and operational procedures.
  • Develop user-focused documentation that supports training and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineers and technical teams to document architecture, database structures, and technical workflows.
  • Maintain technical documentation, process maps, and system models as the platform evolves.
  • Ensure all documentation remains accurate, structured, accessible, and up to date.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with software engineers, analysts, project managers, consultants, and leadership teams.
  • Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.
  • Support decision-making through effective communication and stakeholder alignment.
  • Build trusted relationships across international and cross-functional teams.

Future-Focused Contributions

  • Contribute to interface design discussions and user journey improvements.
  • Support creation of wireframes, mockups, and prototypes when necessary.
  • Assist with implementing data-driven decision-making frameworks and analytics initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system usability, efficiency, and user experience.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across products, processes, and services.

Candidate Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst working on complex software systems.
  • Proven experience gathering requirements and supporting software development projects.
  • Strong technical literacy and ability to understand complex business systems.
  • Experience working directly with software development and engineering teams.
  • Ability to read and understand APIs, database schemas, process flows, technical specifications, and system documentation.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience writing user stories, functional specifications, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Comfortable working within Agile and/or Waterfall environments.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives.
  • Comfortable working within evolving, fast-paced, and growth-oriented environments.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and related business tools.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Exposure to Finance, Accounting, Valuation, Analytics, or Data-Driven Business Domains.
  • Experience documenting complex systems and business processes.
  • Previous experience working with international stakeholders and distributed technology teams.
  • Exposure to wireframing, workflow design, or UX-related activities will be an advantage.

Job Title: Supply Chain Senior Manager - Global Supply Chain Lead

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States|Netherlands|Ireland|Puerto Rico

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Supply Chain Senior Manager – Global Supply Chain Lead

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the end-to-end supply chain for a product portfolio, with a strong focus on reliable patient supply, long-term value, and cross-functional alignment. Working across functions, you will anticipate risks and opportunities, turn insights into clear plans, and enable timely decisions that protect continuity of supply. You will also help shape supply chain and lifecycle choices that strengthen resilience and improve financial performance. The role sits within a multinational and multicultural environment that offers strong opportunities for collaboration, learning, and professional growth.

Responsibilities:

Strategy:

  • Provide thought leadership in shaping end-to-end product supply strategies, orchestrating long-range and monthly planning cycles, and driving business-critical lifecycle management decisions and implementation of product strategies.

  • Ensure every patient, every time by proactively anticipate risks and opportunities, leading cross-functional Supply Chain Teams to develop mitigation plans to protect continuity of supply.

  • Represent Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain in cross-functional product teams, driving alignment on the end-to-end product supply strategy, key risks, opportunities and lifecycle decisions.

  • Advise on manufacturing site selection, network evaluations and business cases by translating end-to-end supply chain insights and scenarios into clear recommendations that influence supply chain design.

  • Lead and support strategic Global Supply Chain initiatives, including acquisitions, integrations and transformations, to enable continued growth.

Execution:

  • Ensure global demand and supply plans are aligned with the agreed product supply strategy and provide a reliable basis for decision making through the planning cycle.

  • Monitor product supply and inventory performance against agreed targets and guardrails, using metrics and exceptions to identify issues and drive timely corrective actions.

  • Set and maintain appropriate inventory targets and guardrails for assigned products, working with manufacturing sites, network planning and Finance to maintain a healthy supply plan and protect continuity of supply. Consider cost and financial impact in product supply and inventory decisions, while keeping continuity of supply and patient service as key priorities.

  • Maintain an end-to-end understanding of the product supply chain, including lead times, critical raw materials, capacity and other key planning assumptions, and ensure these are reflected in supply decisions.

  • Share and develop best practices across the Global Supply Chain network through initiatives that improve supply chain processes, systems and ways of working.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience OR

  • Master’s degree and 4 years of Supply Chain, Operations directly or related experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of Supply Chain, Operations directly or related experience OR

  • Associate degree and 10 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience OR

  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge and experience in applying advanced planning techniques as it relates to demand, supply, inventory planning, financials, and Mfg. network planning.

  • Excellent communication capabilities and must be comfortable and confident dealing with all levels of management within the organization.

  • Strong digital mindset, with demonstrated ability to leverage digital tools, data, and automation to improve supply chain planning insights and decision making.

  • Demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes across a matrix organization.

  • 7 plus years of experience in global pharmaceutical, biotech or any other industry.

  • Solid understanding of demand/supply planning, Supply Chain principles and logistics.

  • Ability to perform system-based advanced supply planning and scenario analysis.

  • Diligent with strong business analytical skills and company-wide knowledge.

  • Process-oriented mentality with leadership experience to identify gaps and seek solutions.

  • Perseverance and independent problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge and understanding of COGM, COGS and NPV analyses.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Job Title: Principal, Regulatory Science and Strategy - Real World Solutions

Job Location: London, Greater London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

IQVIA is focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding career in Life Sciences Consulting, with opportunities to address diverse and challenging client problems, contribute to cross-geography engagements, interact with senior client leaders, and gain exposure to a multicultural and collaborative work environment.

About our team – Regulatory Science and Strategy (RSS)

The Regulatory Science and Strategy (RSS) group sits within IQVIA's Real World Solutions business and supports life sciences clients in using real world evidence (RWE) more widely and effectively for regulatory purposes. RSS sells and delivers as a unified team, partnering with clients on regulatory strategy, study design, and submission planning across drugs, biologics, and devices. Our work spans externally controlled trials, post-marketing requirements (PMRs/PMCs), post-authorization safety studies (PASS), drug utilization studies (DUS), and emerging regulatory technology.

We are strategic thinkers, deep subject matter experts, and creative at our core. We are collaborative, intellectually curious, and entrepreneurial.

About the role:

As a Principal (Director-level) within RSS, you will own delivery leadership, drive business development, and serve as a subject matter expert across two connected areas: selling and delivering standalone regulatory strategy engagements and cross-functional RWE studies for regulatory decision-making. Your work will focus primarily on several areas:

First, a Principal is expected to lead high-quality standalone regulatory strategy engagements, build trusted relationships with new and existing clients, and strengthen IQVIA's regulatory science and strategy capabilities.

Second, the Principal acts as a subject matter expert on the use of RWE across the regulatory lifecycle, partnering cross-functionally with IQVIA Real World Solutions teams to shape, sell, and deliver RWE studies from pre-submission strategy through approval and post-market commitments. An in-depth understanding of EMA expectations is essential, with the ability to translate those expectations into study designs and submission strategies that clients can act on.

Specifically, as a member of the RSS team, the Principal participates in regulatory strategy proposal development, advises on regulatory pathways, and supports cross-functional proposal strategy and delivery for externally controlled trials, PASS, DUS, RegTech advisory work, and broader RWE-for-regulatory engagements.

In addition we expect you to make a key Team and operational contributions to RSS, including mentorship and capability building amongst your junior colleagues

Responsibilities

  • Lead sell and delivery of standalone RSS regulatory strategy engagements, owning workstreams end-to-end and supporting team members on complex programs.

  • Support cross-functional IQVIA Real World Solutions teams in selling and delivering RWE generation programs for regulatory audiences, including externally controlled trials, premarket uses of RWE, PASS, and PMR/PMC fulfilment.

  • Contribute to RSS regulatory intelligence activities, monitoring the external regulatory environment and surfacing emerging information relevant to IQVIA's offerings and clients.

  • Act as a day-to-day owner of the regulatory science element of client engagements, with responsibility for client satisfaction and delivery quality.

  • Advise on strategy and delivery plans for RSS services, with a focus on EMA RWE activities and lifecycle management, supported by working knowledge of FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and PMDA.

  • Maintain working familiarity with the activities and outputs of EMA and their impact on global harmonization of RW efforts.

  • Identify follow-on work and new revenue opportunities with existing clients, and support business development efforts with new client organizations.

  • Collaborate across IQVIA when client requirements span regulatory affairs, clinical development, and real world insights.

  • Provide direction, advice, and intellectual leadership to delivery teams and clients.

  • Contribute high-level input to client reports and presentations, and deliver findings to clients directly.

  • Mentor and coach junior consultants, sharing subject matter expertise to build RSS capability.

  • Participate in annual performance review processes and in recruitment of new staff.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have a track record of success across most of the following competencies:

  • Industry and regulatory expertise: Maintains a constant focus on regulators, industry, and client trends in life sciences. Applies this knowledge to active client engagements and to business development.

  • Real world data expertise: Ability to advise on the design of real world studies to meet regulatory requirements, including externally controlled trials, PASS, PMR fulfillment, etc.

  • Regulated medical product experience: Ability to speak with senior client stakeholders about EMA requirements, guidance, and expectations, with working knowledge of FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and PMDA.

  • Client relationship management and delivery: Day-to-day owner of client engagements, focused on client satisfaction and outstanding deliverables, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel.

  • Business development: Active contributor to proposal development and pre-sales meetings for standalone regulatory strategy opportunities and cross-functional RWE study opportunities with new and existing client organizations.

  • Solution selling: Ability to identify client pain points and shape custom solutions for life sciences clients.

  • Communication and executive presence: Expresses ideas clearly and concisely, and tailors messaging to the audience.

  • Cooperative teamwork: Builds supportive relationships within RSS and across IQVIA, based on trust and respect.

  • Management of others: Sets clear direction and develops junior team members by delegating appropriately and creating stretch opportunities.

  • Coping with decision-making, customer focus, flexibility, influencing, initiative, innovation, planning and organizing, strategic vision, and technological orientation.

Qualifications and Other Requirements

  • A strong academic track record in a life science-related discipline or professional equivalent. A relevant graduate degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, MPH, or MS) is preferred.

  • At least 7 years of professional experience, with a meaningful portion focused on regulatory science, regulatory strategy, or product review. Prior experience at EMA or another health authority is highly valued.

  • Previous experience in life sciences consulting or professional services is preferred.

  • Evidence of consistent career progression.

  • A track record of project leadership and people development.

  • Willingness and ability to travel to client locations.

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).

  • Right to live and work in the recruiting country.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

Job Title: Sr. IT Solution Architect, Access Automation

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

About This Role

Biogen is seeking an experienced Solution Architect\Delivery Lead\ IT System Owner to lead the design, architecture, and implementation of enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using the SailPoint platform. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in IAM governance, access certification, role management, provisioning, application onboarding, and integration with enterprise systems.

The position sits within Enterprise IT Services under the Enterprise Application Services organization and exists to strengthen Biogen’s access automation capabilities, application security, and GxP/Quality compliance programs by delivering scalable, secure, and well-governed identity governance solutions. The role translates business, security, and compliance requirements into technical architecture, implementation roadmaps, integrations, and operational processes. It partners closely with other areas within Enterprise IT Services, Cybersecurity, AMS, Infrastructure, application areas in other functions, IT Quality, and business teams to ensure access lifecycle, provisioning, certification, role management, and audit needs are met effectively.

What You’ll Do

Architecture & Solution Design

· Design & implement enterprise-wide Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and ServiceNow as a front end

· Define IAM architecture, standards, and best practices aligned with security and compliance requirements.

· Create high-level and low-level solution designs, architecture diagrams, and implementation roadmaps.

· Evaluate business requirements and translate them into SailPoint technical solutions.

Implementation & Integration

· Lead SailPoint implementation projects from design through deployment.

· Design and oversee integrations with:

  • Active Directory
  • LDAP
  • HR systems (Workday, Fieldglass)
  • ERP systems (Oracle)
  • Cloud applications (ServiceNow, Salesforce, O365, etc.)

· Design provisioning and de-provisioning workflows.

· Configure access certifications, lifecycle events, role management, policy violations, and segregation of duties (SoD).

Leadership & Governance

· Provide technical leadership and guidance to IAM engineers, developers, and administrators.

· Conduct architecture and design reviews.

· Establish governance processes for identity lifecycle management.

· Lead client workshops and requirements gathering sessions.

· Mentor team members and promote IAM best practices.

Security & Compliance

· Ensure solutions comply with regulatory requirements such as GxP, SOX.

· Implement security controls, risk mitigation measures, and audit requirements.

· Support internal and external audits related to identity management.

Stakeholder Management

· Work closely with business, security, infrastructure, and application teams.

· Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and clients.

· Manage technical risks and project dependencies.

Who You Are

You are resourceful and driven IT professional who has a track record of delivering superior customer experience.

Education

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field.

· Master's degree preferred.

Experience

· 10+ years of overall IT experience.

· 6+ years of hands-on SailPoint experience.

· 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Lead Architect role.

· Experience delivering large-scale IAM transformation programs.

Technical Skills

· SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)

· Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)

· Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

· Access Certification & Compliance

· Provisioning & Lifecycle Management

· Application Onboarding

· REST APIs, SCIM, JDBC, LDAP

· Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID

· Java, BeanShell and SailPoint rule development

· Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)

· ServiceNow integration

Preferred Certifications

· SailPoint Certified Identity Security Cloud Engineer

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $133,000.00-$178,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement

  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan

  • Employee Resource Groups participation

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills.
